gist: Channel disclaimer: no promotion of drugs or alcohol, content is for education, follow community guidelines.
Welcome and thanks for joining; today's class is on Shani Maharaj, next week's class will be on how to desire in life.
Many people are stressed about how to desire; everybody is obsessed with manifesting.

hindi: मर्जी से जिंदगी चलती नहीं यह इतना जटिल प्रोसेस है कि दो ही तरीके हैं या आपके पास ज्ञान हो या किसी ज्ञानी की कृपा अन्यथा आपका नसीब ही अच्छा होना चाहिए
says: Life does not run on personal will; the process behind events is too complex to steer, so only three things help: your own knowledge, the grace of a knowledgeable guide, or simply good fate.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical idea of prarabdha (fate) outweighing effort; no specific text cited.

hindi: आज हम नसीब के एस्पेक्ट की बात करेंगे शनि महाराज को लेकर
says: He frames Saturn as the planet that stands for the fate or luck side of life, which is why today's class on Saturn is about naseeb.
classical_check: Saturn as karaka of ayush, karma and hardship is classical; 'fate' is a wider framing but not contradicted.

hindi: शनि ग्रह का विचित्र सा स्वभाव है ये बहुत विचित्र ग्रह है ... इसके बारे में पूर्णता करना असंभव है
says: Saturn's nature is peculiar and unpredictable, so a class cannot cover it fully; he says complete knowledge of Saturn is impossible.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do call Saturn slow and hard to read but give no such caveat.

gist: Astronomy: the Sun is at the centre of the solar system and the planets go round it.
Astronomy: it is actually the Sun that holds and pulls the whole solar system; he calls this a truth.

hindi: हम लोग ज्योतिष को कितना मर्जी सीख ले पूरे ज्योतिषी बन नहीं पाएंगे बड़े से बड़े ज्योतिषी के जीवन में भी त्रुटि आएंगी क्योंकि यह ग्रह ही अलाव करते हैं कि तू इतना रीड कर पा
says: However much jyotish one learns, no one becomes a complete astrologer; even the greatest astrologers make errors because the planets themselves permit only a limited reading.
ambiguity: Caption 'अलाव' is probably 'allow'.
classical_check: Silent; a humility statement, not a rule.

hindi: कोई ये क्लेम करे कि मैं बेस्ट डॉक्टर हूं लेकिन डॉक्टर ऑपरेशन के टाइम क्या कर पाएगा ये उसके ग्रह उस समय की बुद्धि डिसाइड करा के देंगे
says: Using a surgeon analogy: even the best doctor cannot be sure what he will do at the time of an operation, because his planets decide the quality of his judgement in that moment.
ambiguity: No planet is named; the buddhi link would classically point to Mercury, Jupiter and the 5th house, but he does not say so.
classical_check: Silent on this analogy; the idea that dasha and transit govern mental clarity at a given time is classical.

gist: Astronomy: the Sun drags all planets along and keeps us alive.

hindi: यह हमारी धरती है धरती हमारे शरीर में सूर्य का केंद्र यहां है और यह सूर्य धरती यह बुध ये शुक्र इसके ठीक नीचे
says: He lays the planets onto the human body from top to bottom: the Sun's centre sits high in the body, with Mercury and Venus placed just below it; the caption is garbled so the exact organs are not clear.
ambiguity: Garbled caption and he is pointing at his body; exact organ for Sun, Mercury and Venus is unknown. Classically Sun is heart, Mercury throat/nervous system, Venus reproductive/face.
classical_check: Differs from the classical Kalapurusha mapping of signs to body parts; this is a planet-to-body-level scheme of his own.

hindi: ये नाभि पर हमारा मंगल है मंगल ग्रह
says: Mars is placed at the navel in his body map of the planets.
classical_check: Classical texts give Mars the blood, marrow and abdominal fire; navel (manipura, fire) fits broadly, so no clash.

hindi: इसके ठीक नीचे बृहस्पति बृहस्पति ग्रह हमारे नाभि के ठीक नीचे वाटर चक्र के ऊपर है
says: Jupiter sits just below the navel, above the water chakra (swadhisthana), in his body map.
classical_check: Differs from classical Jupiter body links (liver, fat, thighs); this is his own chakra mapping.

hindi: जल ही जीवन है सारा जीवन का हिसाब किताब जो बृहस्पति पर है
says: Water is life, and since Jupiter sits at the water region, the whole account-book of a life rests on Jupiter; he treats Jupiter as the planet of water and life support.
ambiguity: 'Hisab kitab' may mean karmic accounting or just life functions.
classical_check: Jupiter as jeeva karaka is classical, so this agrees broadly; the water link is his own.

hindi: जब शरीर चलता है तो शरीर चलता इसलिए क्योंकि पेट ठीक है और पेट नाभी के नीचे इंटेस्टाइन यह सारे के सारे ठीक है
says: The body keeps functioning only when the stomach and the intestines below the navel are in order; he ties this digestive base to Jupiter's region (a body-function remark, not a diagnosis).
ambiguity: He says 'scientifically proven' but it is a general health remark.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jupiter covers liver and digestion loosely.

hindi: इसके ठीक नीचे हमारा पेल्विक गडल है यह जो हिप बोन होती है जिसके ऊपर हमारी रीढ़ की हड्डी खड़ी है कंधे या टंगे हैं या मुंडी लगी हुई है यह हमारा शनि ग्रह का एरिया
says: Below the intestines is the pelvic girdle, the hip bone that carries the spine, shoulders and head; he assigns this whole supporting area to Saturn.
classical_check: Saturn rules bones and joints classically, and the pelvis as base fits; the exact pelvic placement is his own.

hindi: यह हमारा मूल आधार है मूल का आधार मूल रूट रूट चक्र भी यही है मूल आधार भी यही है मूलाधार
says: This same pelvic base is the root, the mooladhara chakra; so in his scheme Saturn is the planet of the root chakra and of the body's foundation.
classical_check: Chakra-planet links are tantric rather than in Parashara; many modern teachers also give Saturn to mooladhara.

gist: Astronomy: Jupiter is a bit bigger and Saturn smaller, though both are huge gas giants.

hindi: इसके पीछे है इंद्र वरुण और यम
says: Behind Saturn lie the three outer planets Indra, Varuna and Yama (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto), which he counts as part of the Saturn group in his twelve-planet scheme.
ambiguity: 'Behind' means beyond Saturn in the solar system, and also lower in his body map.
classical_check: Classical Parashara texts use only seven planets plus Rahu and Ketu; the outer three are a modern addition.

gist: Astronomy: the Sun is so strongly magnetic that it drags all planets through the Milky Way.

hindi: बृहस्पति अकेला ग्रह है जो इस सूर्य को पीछे की ओर खींच रहा है लेकिन यह इतना छोटा है कि सूर्य को तो नहीं खींच पाता है उल्टा सूर्य इसे घसीट लेता है
says: Jupiter is the only planet that pulls the Sun backward, but it is too small to succeed and the Sun drags it instead; he uses this to cast Jupiter as the counter-force to the Sun.
ambiguity: Astronomical claim used as symbolism; physically Jupiter does shift the Sun-system barycentre but he means it as a story.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical rule.

hindi: ये धरती को इसके अंदर घुसने नहीं देता यानी हमारे जीवन में हम जिंदा है इसीलिए धरती के ऊपर क्योंकि धरती जिंदा है सिर्फ इसलिए क्योंकि बृहस्पति ने खींच रखा है इसीलिए कहते हैं गुरुत्वाकर्षण गुरु की कृपा
says: Jupiter stops the Earth from falling into the Sun, so life on Earth survives only by Jupiter's hold; he links this to the word gurutvakarshan, meaning the pull of the guru's grace.
ambiguity: A pun on 'guru' and gravity, not a technical claim.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as protector is a classical theme but this mechanism is his own.

gist: Astronomy: Earth is a tiny ball, and the asteroid belt exists in space; garbled on what would happen to Earth.
An asteroid once hit Earth and wiped out the dinosaurs.

hindi: ऐसे एस्टड जब धरती पर अटैक करते हैं तो वो खींच लेता है ऐसे में क्या होता है जब भी यहां नीचे गुड़गुड़ाहट लोगों के पेट में तबीयत खराब तो नीचे खींचता है और यह बाहर मल के द्वारा निष्कासन करता है तो बृहस्पति यहां से फेंक देता है
says: As Jupiter pulls attacking asteroids away from Earth, the same Jupiter in the body pulls waste downward and expels it as stool when the stomach is upset; he casts Jupiter as the body's cleaner and ejector (a general remark, not a diagnosis).
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled around 'asteroid'.
classical_check: Silent; classical Jupiter does not own the excretory function.

hindi: बृहस्पति 12 साल में घूमता है धरती के इर्दगिर्द सूर्य के अनुसार एक्चुअली सूर्य के कॉरेस्पोंडेंस सूरज तो वही रहता है तो 12 साल की साइकिल है
says: Jupiter takes about 12 years to go round (measured against the Sun), so Jupiter works on a 12-year cycle.
ambiguity: He mixes geocentric and heliocentric wording; the real period is about 11.86 years.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard roughly 12-year Jupiter cycle used in classical transit and varsha reckoning.

hindi: 12 साल में कुंभ महाना जा माना जाता है कुंभ क्या है यहां एक घड़ा बना हुआ है
says: The great Kumbh festival is held every 12 years, matching Jupiter's cycle; he then asks what 'kumbh' is and starts explaining it as a pot.
ambiguity: 'महाना जा माना' is garbled, likely 'maha parva maana jaata hai'.
classical_check: Agrees: Kumbh Mela dates are fixed by Jupiter's position, classically in Aquarius, Leo or Aries with Sun and Moon placements.

hindi: इस घड़े को कुंड कहा जाता है कुंभ घड़े की आकृति यह जो घड़ा है यहां पर इस कुंड में हमारी शक्ति लीन रहती है इसे कुंडलिनी कहते हैं
says: Kumbh means a pot; the pot-shaped region at the base of the body is the kund, where our energy lies dormant, and that energy is called kundalini.
ambiguity: He might also be hinting at the sign Kumbh (Aquarius) as the pot, but does not say so here.
classical_check: Kundalini sits in mooladhara in yogic texts; the Kumbh word play is his own.

hindi: यानी जुपिटर बृहस्पति और शनि अकेले ग्रह है जिनके कुंड में शक्ति रहती है
says: Only Jupiter and Saturn are the planets whose kund holds this shakti; he sees the kundalini energy as belonging to the Jupiter and Saturn pair.
classical_check: Silent; not found in classical texts.

hindi: सारे के सारे जानवर हम मनुष्य यहां से खड़े जानवर यहीं से नीचे को झुके हुए हैं ... हमारी शक्ति ऊपर की ओर चली जाती है उनकी शक्ति नीचे की ओर ही रहती है
says: Humans stand upright from the pelvis while animals bend forward from it, so the same kund energy rises upward in humans but stays downward in animals.
classical_check: Silent; yogic idea rather than a jyotish rule.

hindi: इसलिए वो मल मूत्र त्याग हैं सेक्स करते हैं बच्चे पैदा करते हैं और ऐसे ही जीवन काट लेते हैं
says: Because their energy stays low, animals live only by excretion, mating and reproducing; he implies that a human whose energy stays at the base lives at that same level.
ambiguity: The link to a planet is implied, not named here.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Animals have no fashion worries about weather clothes, building a house, Gucci or Armani.

hindi: ये कुंड में लीन जो शक्ति है यहीं से उद्गम होता है जीवन का
says: The energy lying in this kund is where life originates; the base region he gives to Saturn is thus the source point of life.
classical_check: Silent; mulaadhara as origin is yogic, not jyotish.

gist: Astronomy wonder: the Sun pulls Jupiter back so Jupiter cannot pull Earth; some unknown power designed this.
Sun tells Jupiter to come back, lest it pull Earth too; the Sun says he would pull upward himself.

hindi: बृहस्पति को भी जिंदा शनि ने अपने एजेंटों के साथ इंद्र वरुण यम के साथ पकड़ रखा है कि थोड़ा तू मुझे खींच तो थोड़ा
says: Saturn, together with his agents Indra, Varuna and Yama, is holding Jupiter in place so that Jupiter stays alive and keeps a counter-pull; he sees Saturn as Jupiter's anchor.
ambiguity: Symbolic, using a tug-of-war picture.
classical_check: Silent; the outer-planet agent idea is his own.

hindi: सबने रस्सा कस्सी खेली होगी बचपन में ... यह रस्सा कशी के अंदर जीवन चला हुआ है
says: Life runs inside a tug of war: the Sun pulls one way while Jupiter and Saturn's group pull the other, like children's rope-pulling.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Astrophysics: in lakhs of years the Sun will turn into a big cooling red ball and swallow the Earth.

hindi: इस शनि ग्रह के पास सबसे बड़ी समस्या क्या है बृहस्पति गुरु ग्रह यह एक तरह से इसी की सेवा में लगा हुआ है तो बृहस्पति के कारण इसके ऊपर सूर्य की किरणें नहीं पड़ती
says: Saturn's biggest problem is that it serves the guru Jupiter, and because Jupiter stands in front, the Sun's rays do not fall on Saturn.
ambiguity: 'इसी की सेवा' could mean Saturn serves the Sun or Jupiter; context suggests Jupiter.
classical_check: Differs from classical view of Saturn as the Sun's son; this is his own symbolic account.

hindi: एक इतना बड़ा व्यक्ति है उसके पीछे छोटा व्यक्ति डाल दो तो अंधेरे में आ गया अंधकार में कैसे दिखेगा इसलिए शनि को
says: Like a small person standing behind a big one, Saturn is in darkness and cannot see well; the sentence is cut off but points to Saturn's blindness or lack of clarity.
ambiguity: Sentence ends mid-thought at the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with Saturn as dark, shadowy and obstructed; explanation is his own.

hindi: अंधकार का देवता कहा जाता है एक आपकी स्पिरिट बॉडी है स्पिरिट एक आपकी डेविल बॉडी है डेविल
says: Saturn is called the god of darkness; he says each person has two bodies, a spirit body and a devil body, and Saturn belongs to the second.
ambiguity: 'Devil body' is his term for the dark, material, instinctive side; not a classical term.
classical_check: Saturn as a dark, shadowy planet is classical; the spirit and devil body split is his own.

hindi: यह डेविल बॉडी है डेविल बॉडी एक प्लस है एक माइनस है यह डेविल बॉडी भी आपके फायदे के लिए रखी गई है
says: The devil body has both a plus and a minus side, and it too has been placed in us for our benefit, so it is not purely bad.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Saturn being both a malefic and a giver of discipline and results.

hindi: हमारे असुर भी होते हैं वास्तु में वो भी हमारे राक्षस जो है काम के हैं उनकी भी जरूरत है हमें
says: In vastu too there are asuras and rakshasas, and they are useful to us and needed; he uses this to say dark forces have a role, linking the devil body to the vastu entities.
ambiguity: Which vastu zones or entities he means is not said here.
classical_check: Vastu Purusha mandala does place asuras on the outer padas; he does not name them here.

hindi: ऐसे ही डेविल बॉडी जो है इसके दम पर चल रहे हैं अब इस डेविल बॉडी का जो प्रमुख है वह शनि ग्रह है शनि ग्रह मूलाधार है
says: We actually run on the strength of the devil body, whose chief is Saturn, and Saturn is the mooladhara or root of the body.
classical_check: Silent; chakra link is non-Parashari.

hindi: आपकी बॉडी कहां चलती है इसी पे चलती है हिप बोन के ऊपर यहीं पर हम खड़े होते हैं इसी पे चलते हैं
says: The whole body moves and stands on the hip bone and legs, so Saturn's area is what carries us when we stand and walk.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn ruling legs, bones and joints in classical body mapping.

hindi: डॉक्टर कहते हैं यह पैर चलाते रहो चलाते रहो यह चलायमान होने चाहिए तो तुम सही धरती पर यानी तुम्हारा वजूद सही रहेगा अन्यथा नहीं रहेगा
says: Doctors say keep the legs moving; he reads this as a Saturn rule that if the legs stay active your existence on earth stays sound, otherwise it does not (a general health remark, not a diagnosis).
classical_check: Silent; walking as a Saturn remedy is a popular modern teaching, not a classical rule.

hindi: कोई भी प्रॉब्लम शरीर के ऊपरी हिस्से की आती है पहले यहां से ठीक करते हैं
says: When a problem shows in the upper body, first set right the base (the Saturn area), because he treats the base as the source; a tradition claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'यहां से' is a gesture; assumed to mean the lower body or mooladhara.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुढ़ापा कहां से आता है सबसे पहले पैरों से आप मृत्यु शया पर लेटे हैं तो भी यह खोपड़ी चलती रहती है टॉप क्योंकि य सूर्य का प्रभाव है अंत तक चलती रहती है
says: Old age begins in the feet first, while the head (skull, ruled by the Sun) keeps working to the very end, even on a deathbed.
ambiguity: Deathbed is an image, not a death prediction.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as karaka of old age and Sun for the head; the order of ageing is his own observation.

hindi: आपके पैर नहीं चलते फिर घुटने नहीं चलते फिर हिप बोन की प्रॉब्लम आती है फिर पता लगा पेट की गड़बड़ ऐसे ऐसे बुढ़ापा ऊपर की ओर चढ़ता है
says: Ageing climbs upward in a sequence: feet fail first, then knees, then hip bone, then stomach trouble; old age travels from the Saturn base upward.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको बूढ़े यदि नहीं होना है तो पैरों का कार्य करो पैरों का कार्य कौन करेगा शनि शनि प्रमुख है
says: To delay ageing, look after the legs; Saturn is the chief that governs the work of the legs, so keeping Saturn well is the way to stay young (a tradition-style remedy, not medical advice).
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as karaka of longevity is classical.

hindi: शनि के साथ इवॉल्व है इंद्र वरुण और यम
says: Saturn is bound together with Indra, Varuna and Yama (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto); the three outer planets evolve with Saturn as one group.
classical_check: Classical texts have no outer planets.

hindi: एक छोटे बच्चे को यदि हम देखें और यह ऐसे बैठा हुआ है ... सूर्य यहां आ गया चंद्रमा यह आ गया बुध शुक्र मंगल यहां बीच में धरती है यह गुरु हो गया अब य शनि है
says: Looking at a small child sitting, he points out where each planet's switch or portal sits in the body: Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars higher up, Earth in the middle, Jupiter below that and Saturn at the base; the exact spots are gestures.
ambiguity: Positions are shown by hand in the video and are not recoverable from the caption.
classical_check: Differs from Kalapurusha (sign-to-body) and is his own planet-to-chakra scheme.

hindi: इस शनि के साथ 11 नंबर राशि प्लूटो की है क्योंकि यहां यह इलाका इस प्रकार शनि के अंतर्गत आता है
says: Next to Saturn, sign number 11 (Aquarius) belongs to Pluto, because this lower-body area falls under the Saturn group; so Aquarius has Pluto as a co-lord with Saturn.
cells_derived_method: Aquarius as lagna or as the sign in a house carries Saturn and Pluto themes: in the 1st house it colours body build and ambition with discipline plus upheaval; in the 7th it colours partners; in the 10th it colours career with structure and sudden transformation. Meaning shifts by house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius lagna gives a self-image of detached discipline with Pluto-style intensity and abrupt personal changes.
Derived: Aquarius in the 7th (lagna Leo) gives unconventional, controlling or transformative partners and partnership turning points.
Derived: Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus) gives a career in systems, labour, research or institutions with sudden restructurings.

ambiguity: '11 नंबर राशि' is read as sign number 11 (Aquarius) per this series; it might also be house 11.
classical_check: Differs: classical lord of Aquarius is Saturn alone; Pluto as co-lord is a modern view he adopts.

hindi: तो यह घुटने सपोर्ट करते हैं यह जांगे सपोर्ट कर रही है आपके शरीर के अंदर जितना भी यह इलाका है
says: The knees and thighs hold the body up, and the whole lower area of the body that does the supporting is the Saturn region.
classical_check: Agrees: classical Saturn rules knees and the legs (Kalapurusha puts knees under Capricorn, shanks under Aquarius).

hindi: यह सारा का सारा एरिया शनि महाराज के अंतर्गत चल रहा है
says: This entire lower region of the body runs under Saturn's authority.
classical_check: Agrees broadly with Saturn ruling the lower limbs.

hindi: राजा सूर्यकांत जब रानी चंद्रकांता को बोलता है कि कोई कार्य करना है गुरुजी घर पर आए हैं तो शनिचर के थ्रू आदेश पारित किया जाता कि हां भाई शनि जितने भी काम कर रहे हैं राजा जी के लिए करने हैं
says: Using a palace story: the King (Sun) tells the Queen (Moon) that the guru (Jupiter) has come home, and the order to serve is passed through Shani as the executor; so Saturn is the worker who carries out the royal order.
ambiguity: Names 'Suryakant' and 'Chandrakanta' are story names for Sun and Moon.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical cabinet where Sun is king, Moon queen, Jupiter minister; Saturn as servant is also classical.

hindi: शनि अपने एजेंटों के थ्रू अपने छोटे-छोटे बच्चों के थ्रू इंद्र वरुण यम राहु और केतु इनके थ्रू कहता है हा भाई सेवा में लग जाओ
says: Saturn passes the order down through his small agents or children, Indra, Varuna, Yama, Rahu and Ketu; so he counts Rahu and Ketu too among Saturn's working team.
classical_check: Classical texts say Rahu acts like Saturn and Ketu like Mars; making all five Saturn's agents is his own scheme.

hindi: शनि काम करता है कराता है औरों से तो शनि क्या काम करता है शनि काम कराने वाला है जैसे राम जी क्या करते हैं राम जी कुछ नहीं कर रहे लेकिन कर राम जी ही रहे हैं क्योंकि हनुमान जी आ गए
says: Saturn gets work done through others: like Ram who does nothing himself yet everything happens because Hanuman acts, Saturn is the commissioner of work and his agents are the doers.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as karaka of servants and labour is classical, this delegate picture is his own.

hindi: हनुमान कब कार्य करेंगे जब राम होंगे हनुमान काम कब नहीं करेंगे जब राम नहीं होंगे तो हनुमान ही मुखिया है जो कार्य कर रहे हैं इसी प्रकार के लिए राहु और केतु मुख्य है जो काम करेंगे
says: Hanuman works only when Ram is present and the real working head is Hanuman, just as Rahu and Ketu are the chief workers who act on Saturn's behalf and work only under his command.
ambiguity: Sentence continues to the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: राहु उस स्थिति को कहते हैं जब सूर्य को ग्रहण लग जाता है और केतु उस स्थिति को कहते हैं जब चंद्रमा को ग्रहण लग जाता है
says: Rahu is the condition when the Sun is eclipsed and Ketu is the condition when the Moon is eclipsed, so he ties Rahu to solar blocking and Ketu to lunar blocking.
classical_check: Differs: classically both nodes cause both eclipses; Rahu as solar and Ketu as lunar eclipse is a popular but non-classical split.

hindi: इतने बड़े रोशनी के मालिक स्पिरिट बॉडी को भी ब्लॉक करके बंद कर देता है
says: The nodes are so powerful that they block and shut down even the great light-givers, which he calls the spirit body; shadow planets can override the luminaries.
ambiguity: 'Spirit body' here is the Sun and Moon pair.
classical_check: Agrees with classical 'Rahu and Ketu afflict Sun and Moon' in eclipse yogas.

hindi: हमारी लाइफ में शनि वो देवता वो ग्रह वो हालात है जिसे कुछ पता नहीं इसको आदेश मिलता है और य अपने आप करता है सेवक
says: In our life Saturn is the deity or circumstance that knows nothing of the why; it simply receives an order and carries it out like a servant, so its effects arrive without explanation.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as servant is classical.

hindi: आपके जीवन में अंधेरा पता ही नहीं यह इलाका अंधेरे का अंधकार का हमारे जीवन में बहुत से ऐसे काम होते हैं जिसके बारे में हमें कभी पता नहीं चलता
says: Saturn's area is the zone of darkness in our lives: many things happen to us whose cause or origin we never come to know.
classical_check: Silent; hidden and unseen matters are classically Saturn, Rahu and the 8th and 12th houses.

hindi: लॉटरी लगती है अचानक बीमारी आती है अचानक नौकरी छूटती है मिलती है अचानक यानी शनि अचानक का देवता है
says: Lottery wins, sudden illness, sudden job loss or a sudden job gain all come from Saturn, whom he calls the god of the sudden; this is a description of unexpected events, not a financial tip.
ambiguity: Classically sudden events are more Rahu, Uranus and Ketu; he assigns them to Saturn's group.
classical_check: Differs: sudden events are classically Rahu or Mars; Saturn is slow, so this stretches Saturn through his agents.

hindi: जब भी आपकी लाइफ में कुछ ऐसा हो रहा है आप कह रहे साला पता ही नहीं चल रहा ... घर में लड़ाई हो रही है समझ नहीं आ रहा व्यापार नहीं चल रहा शादी नहीं हो रही
says: Whenever you say 'I cannot understand what is happening', such as fights at home, a business not running or a marriage not happening, it means the Saturn area is the one active and working on you.
ambiguity: The 'puzzling event' test is an informal diagnostic and not tied to a house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी कि यह एरिया आपका क्रियान्वित है और यह आपका देवता सेट नहीं है जब तक यह इलाका सेट नहीं हो रहा गड़बड़ चल रही है
says: Such puzzling troubles mean the Saturn area is active but its deity is not set right; until that base region is put in order, things will keep going wrong.
ambiguity: 'Set' is vague; could mean chart placement, remedy or vastu setting.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसकी सेटिंग के लिए ताकत किसके पास है बृहस्पति जब गुरुजी आते हैं तो सारे के सारे सेवक ऐसे खड़े हो जाते हैं
says: The power to set Saturn right lies with Jupiter; when the guru arrives all the servants stand to attention, so Jupiter is the controller of Saturn's group.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea that Jupiter's aspect or conjunction softens Saturn.

hindi: शनि महाराज की भी ऐसी तैसी बोल जाती जुपिटर के आगे क्योंकि जुपिटर के पीछे छुपा हुआ है य बृहस्पति के पीछे छुपा हुआ ग्रह है यह और अंधेरे में रहता है
says: Even Saturn is cowed in front of Jupiter because Saturn hides behind Jupiter and lives in the dark; Jupiter overpowers Saturn.
classical_check: Differs in tone from the classical equal friendship of Jupiter and Saturn, but agrees that Jupiter is the stronger benefic.

hindi: हमारा जीवन आधा दिन अंधेरे का है आधा दिन उजाले का है मोटे तौर यानी बहुत चीज तो हमें पता है भैया मुझे यह पता है मुझे यह पता है यार मुझे बाकी पता ही नहीं
says: Life is roughly half darkness and half light: we know some things clearly and the rest we do not know at all.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे जितने भी कार्मिक अकाउंट होते हैं जीवन में प्रारब्ध शब्द वाले यानी हमने पूर्व जन्म में पाप किए पता नहीं किस जन्म में
says: All our karmic accounts, called prarabdha, come from sins done in past births we do not remember; he places this unknown past-life ledger in the dark zone.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical doctrine of prarabdha karma.

gist: Bhishma Pitamah story: a snake thrown a hundred births ago brought thorns, now arrows; Krishna showed him the cause, unknown to Bhishma.

hindi: यह पूर्व जन्म सारे के सारे जन्मों का कर्मों का लेखा जोखा यह सारा शनि के पास है
says: The complete record of karma from all past births is held by Saturn, who is the keeper of our karmic accounts.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the classical karma karaka and karmesh in many traditions.

hindi: यहां पर हमारा क्या होता है भूमि तत्व यहां भूमि तत्व है यहां जल तत्व है यह अग्नि भूमि जल इसके ऊपर अग्नि फिर वायु और यह स्पेस गगन यह पांच तत्व
says: The body's five elements are stacked from the base up: earth at the base, water above it, fire above that, then air, and space at the top; the base (Saturn's seat) is the earth element.
classical_check: Agrees with the yogic element order of the chakras; not a Parashara rule.

hindi: भूमि तत्व ये कितना है 12 पर 12 पर क्या है आपकी जन्म तो आपकी जन्मपत्री के सारे के सारे रहस्य मूलाधार में फसे हुए हैं
says: The earth element at the base is a 12 by 12 area, which is your birth chart; so all the secrets of your janmapatri are lodged in the mooladhara, meaning in Saturn's region.
ambiguity: '12 पर 12' is garbled; read as a 12-by-12 grid, possibly 12 signs by 12 houses, but could be a size remark.
classical_check: Silent; matches no classical statement.

hindi: हमारे पास ऊपर से थॉट आता है यहां से चिंगारी की तरह ... सहसरारा से ऊपर से कोई पोर्टल से कहीं से कुछ विचार आता है पता नहीं कहां से आता है क्या आता है
says: A thought enters from above through the crown (sahasrara) like a spark, from an unknown source, and travels down to touch the Saturn base first.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: य शनि पर टच करता है और टच करने के बाद वहां पर एक बीज डल जाता है वृक्ष उग जाता है
says: Once the thought touches Saturn it becomes a seed there, which then grows into a tree, meaning a thought lodged in the Saturn base grows into real events.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपने पूर्व जन्म के किस कर्म को कैसे ऑन किया य आपकी मर्जी होएगा वही जो सारा का सारा संचित कर्म है संचित कर्म मींस अमलेड कर्म होने वाले कर्म कौन से जिस बटन को आपने दबाया
says: Which past-life karma you switch on is your own choice: the stored sanchit karma is like many buttons, and the one you press is what becomes the karma that happens.
ambiguity: He glosses sanchit as 'unmilled' (amalgamated) karma; the caption is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees with sanchit and prarabdha distinction; the button picture and free choice are his own.

hindi: कई बार हम अच्छे का बटन दबाते ही नहीं क्योंकि हमें आता ही नहीं वह गुरु दबता यानी दूसरा व्यक्ति करवाता है अरे तुझ में यह हुनर भी है जैसे कोई मैराथन रनर तैयार करता है तो कोई गुरु कराता है
says: Often we never press the good button because we do not know it exists; a guru, such as a coach who makes a marathon runner, presses it by showing us a talent we did not know we had.
classical_check: Agrees with the guru-grace theme and Jupiter as teacher.

hindi: गुरु कौन है गुरु यह रहा ऊपर शनि के ऊपर तो शनि को किसकी आवश्यकता सबसे ज्यादा गुरु अर्जुन को सबसे ज्यादा जरूरत किसकी है
says: The guru (Jupiter) sits above Saturn and Saturn needs the guru most, as Arjuna most needed Krishna; the sentence is cut off at the chunk boundary.
ambiguity: Ends mid-thought; the Arjuna comparison is incomplete.
classical_check: Agrees with Jupiter's aspect being the best relief for Saturn.

hindi: अर्जुन को कहां जाना है पता ही नहीं जैसे ही पता नहीं गुरु ने टेकओवर कर लिया सूर्य की रोशनी ऑन हो गई
says: When Arjuna, not knowing where to go, hands control to the guru, the guru takes over and the Sun's light switches on; so surrender to Jupiter lights up the dark Saturn path.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Jupiter's grace relieving Saturn.

hindi: जीवन यूं चला हम सो रहे हमें पता ही नहीं कब अच्छी नींद आती है जब पता ही नहीं
says: Using sleep as an image: we sleep without knowing when sleep comes, and the best sleep comes when we are unaware; life too runs best in the unknown zone of Saturn.
ambiguity: An illustration, and the link to Saturn is implied.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Challenges the audience: we think we know a lot, our skull is busy, try to sleep then.

hindi: आपके जीवन में आपके जितनी चॉइस होंगी वह सारे कार्य सूर्य कराएगा चॉइस जहां नहीं होगी वह सारे काम शनि कराएगा
says: Everything in your life where you have a choice is done through the Sun, and everything where you have no choice is done through Saturn; the Sun is the domain of will and Saturn the domain of compulsion.
classical_check: Agrees with Sun as atma and will, Saturn as karma and constraint.

hindi: बीच में सब रिस्पांसिबल है नीचे वाले भी रिस्पांसिबल है शनि पूरी टीम के साथ चल रहा है
says: The middle planets are all responsible and so are those at the bottom; Saturn does not act alone but goes along with his whole team, so any Saturn reading must include the other planets and his agents.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आज हम क्लास शनि की कर रहे हैं लेकिन अकेला कोई नहीं हो सकता है
says: Although today's class is on Saturn, no planet can be studied in isolation.
classical_check: Agrees with the general rule of reading planets together.

hindi: आपके पास अक्सर जीवन में चॉइस है ही नहीं समझ नहीं आ रहा क्या करें यार लेकिन हम समझने में लगे हुए हैं शनि कह रहा है मैं ठीक कर दूंगा
says: Often there is no real choice in life and we cannot work out what to do, yet we keep trying to understand it; meanwhile Saturn says he will fix it on his own.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गुरुदेव आपने कह दिया सूर्यकांत बाबा भगवान माता रानी चंद्रकांता आपने कह दिया मैं कर दूंगा
says: Saturn answers that since Jupiter the guru, the Sun and the Moon have given the order, he will carry it out; Saturn executes what the higher planets command.
classical_check: Agrees with the king, queen and minister hierarchy used earlier.

hindi: जो हम छोड़ो छोड़ो छोड़ो क्लास में कहते हैं वो शनि को एक्टिव करने के लिए कहते हैं कि शनि को एक्टिव हो लेने दो
says: When he says leave it, leave it, he means it as a way to activate Saturn: let Saturn become active by not holding the controls.
classical_check: Silent; a surrender-style remedy, not classical.

hindi: उसमें उंगली मत करो उसमें पंगे मत करो उसमें किले मत गाड़ो नहीं हम करेंगे हम चलाएंगे
says: Do not interfere with Saturn's work, do not poke a finger in, do not make trouble or hammer in nails; insisting that we will run everything ourselves blocks Saturn.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे जीवन में हमने गाड़ी चलाई कभी एक्सीडेंट नहीं हुआ कभी भी परफेक्ट नहीं चलाई है ... हमने 100% आईडिया से चलाई है तुक्के से बचे तुक्के से एक्सीडेंट बच गया
says: If we say we have driven all our life without an accident, the truth is we never drove perfectly and escaped only by chance; every close escape is luck, not our skill.
ambiguity: Mixed with a mock-quote of the audience, so wording is partly garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भाई तुक्के से ही मेरे बिल्कुल पास में आके ट्रक निकल गया और मैं बच गया तुका सारे तुक्के का देवता शनि है
says: A truck passing within inches and sparing you is a stroke of luck, and Saturn is the lord of all such flukes (tukka).
classical_check: Silent; classically sudden escapes are credited to Jupiter or ayush indications, not Saturn.

hindi: कब काम करेगा जब आपको पता ही नहीं आपने शनि को कार्य सौप दिया अपने घर के वर्कर को काम सौप दिया फिर उससे आप पीछे पीछे घूम रहे हा भाई क्या कर रहा
says: Saturn works only when you do not know what he is doing; once you assign him a task like handing work to a household worker, following him around asking what he is doing spoils it.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वह बदला लेगा वह आपसे बदला लेगा 100% लेगा क्योंकि आप उसे काम नहीं करने दे रहे अब उसको वैसे ही काम आता है
says: If you will not let Saturn do the job his own way, he takes revenge, with certainty; because he only knows his own way of working, interfering brings Saturn's punishment.
ambiguity: 'Revenge' is personifying; no specific event named.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as punisher of the careless is a popular theme.

gist: Story: two boys fighting hard, the teacher calls them over and asks what is happening.
Story: each boy says the other does not listen; teacher puts a ball on the table, one boy sees it white and the other black, they fight, swap places and now both see the opposite colour.

hindi: क्योंकि बॉल दो रंग की है आधी इस तरफ सफेद इस तरफ काली दोनों लोग गलत हैं दोनों ही सही है क्योंकि दोनों को जानकारी अलग है इसलिए लड़ रहे हैं
says: The moral: the ball is two-coloured, so both boys are right and wrong; people fight because each has different information about the same thing.
ambiguity: Not astrology as such; used to introduce the clash between our will and the body or circumstances.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यही पति-पत्नी करते हैं यही हमारा नौकरी और हम करते हैं यही हमारी गाड़ी और हम करते हैं हमारी गाड़ी कहीं जाना नहीं चाहती हम ले जाना चाहते हैं हमारी बॉडी कहीं जाना नहीं चाहती लेकिन हम ले जाना चाहते हैं
says: The same clash happens between husband and wife, between us and our job, and between us and our car or body: the thing does not want to go where we are pushing it, and we force it.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हम कहीं जाना चाहते हैं लेकिन बॉडी को हमने कह रखा ना जाना जैसे हम तैयार हुए आ क्या करना है मामा जी के य जाना यार मन तो है नहीं जाने का लेकिन बॉडी को ले जा रहे हैं बेमन जा रहे हैं हम
says: Example: we get ready to visit an uncle with no wish to go and drag the body along reluctantly; the mind and body are pulling in opposite directions.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब हमारी बॉडी पर चोट लगनी ही है 101 पर यह हमने बेमन काम किया है यानी कि शनि पर छोड़ा नहीं
says: When we do an unwilling task, the body will get hurt for sure, since we forced it and did not leave it to Saturn; acting against the grain invites injury (a tradition claim, not a diagnosis).
ambiguity: '101 पर' means 101 percent.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अर्जुन कृष्ण जी मन कर रहा है इधर की ओर ले जाओ हरत नो बेटा चुप रहो
says: Arjuna wants to steer the chariot his way but Krishna says no, son, stay quiet; leaving direction to the guru instead of the restless mind is the model for letting Saturn work.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे लोग आपने देखे होंगे जो कल्पना से परे हैं या इनको कौन अमीर बना रहा है भाई आदमी गधा है लोग अक्सर कहते हैं भाई आदमी गधा है गधा डचू है ये चौथी फेल है
says: You must have seen people who are beyond imagination: rich though everyone calls them donkeys or fourth-class failures, and people wonder who is making them wealthy.
ambiguity: The setup; the explanation follows in the next sentences.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गांव में पली भड़ी है रानी की तरह रह रही है बात करने की तमीज नहीं अंग्रेजी बोलनी नहीं आती वह रानी बनी कैसे उसने शनि एक्टिव कर रखा है
says: A village woman with no polish or English lives like a queen because she has Saturn active; luck without qualification is credited to an activated Saturn.
ambiguity: 'Active Saturn' is not defined by any placement here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वह बंदा राजा बना कैसे उसने शनि एक्टिव कर रखा है क्या किया हुआ है पता ही नहीं अर्जुन मैं तो कृष्ण पर छोड़ दिया करना धरना ही कुछ नहीं
says: A man became a king because he has Saturn active, though no one knows what he did; like Arjuna he left everything to Krishna and did nothing himself.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप सोचो शनि कितना बड़ा मालिक है शनि हमारा मूलाधार
says: He asks us to realise how great a master Saturn is, since Saturn is our mooladhara, the root.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: धरती के गर्भ से इसको लेकर चलेंगे धरती का जड़ जो है धरती भूमि 12 पर भूमि प्रारब्ध फिक्स बदल ही नहीं सकती धरती कभी बदलती है नहीं उसका स्वरूप बदलता है फिर भी वैसी रहती है
says: Saturn is the root of the earth, and as the earth never changes in essence, only in form, prarabdha is fixed and cannot be altered, though its outward shape may change.
ambiguity: '12 पर भूमि' is the same 12-by-12 earth-element remark as before and is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees with classical prarabdha being fixed, though remedies are classically said to soften it; he is stricter here.

hindi: धरती को जैसा मर्जी बना लो वापस पलट के धरती में घुस जाता है और धरती में से लक्ष्मी निकलती है
says: Whatever you make out of earth goes back into earth, and Lakshmi (wealth) emerges from the earth; he ties wealth to Saturn's land element.
classical_check: Silent; land and property are classically 4th house, Mars and Saturn.

hindi: जितने लोग चिजी बनाना चाहते हैं अमीर बनना चाहते हैं सफल होना चाहते हैं चिजी शनि चीजों का मालिक है गाड़ी लेंगे बंगला लेंगे मकान कहां से निकला है सब जमीन से
says: Anyone who wants possessions, riches or success needs Saturn, the lord of things (chizen): cars, bungalows and houses all come out of the ground.
ambiguity: 'चिजी' is the caption's rendering of 'चीजें' (things).
classical_check: Differs: classically cars are Venus and houses the 4th house or Mars; he assigns material possessions to Saturn.

hindi: ज्ञान लेंगे नो नो नो नो शनि का कोई लेनदेन नहीं है वो अलग ग्रह की बात होगी शनि के पास चिजी है
says: Knowledge is not Saturn's matter, since Saturn has no dealings with knowledge and it belongs to another planet; Saturn holds only material things.
ambiguity: The 'other planet' for knowledge is not named, presumably Jupiter.
classical_check: Agrees with Jupiter as karaka of knowledge, not Saturn.

gist: People are anguished: building not being built, living in a slum; he says dream big and promises how to do it next week.

hindi: सबसे पहले यह समझना है कि हमारे पास एक ऐसा कमाल का ग्रह है जो हमें बैठे बिठाए चिजी का शहनशाह बना देता है
says: The first thing to understand is that we have a remarkable planet, Saturn, who can make us an emperor of possessions while we sit idle.
classical_check: Differs from classical Saturn as the planet of toil and delay; this is his reading of Saturn's grace.

hindi: कैसे बनते हैं लोग इतने बड़े-बड़े अमीर लोग हैं कमाल की चीज उनके पास कहां से आई अहंकार करने वाला कह सकता है अरे मैंने बनाया
says: How do some people become so rich and get wonderful things; an egoist would say he built it himself.
ambiguity: A set-up question; the answer follows.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसा व्यक्ति भी हो सकता है जो मन मैले स्वभाव का हो यार उसी ने दिया उसी ने ले लिया उस पर शनि भयंकर मेहरबान है जिसने यह कह दिया उसम बृहस्पति भी मेहरबान है साथ में वरुण की कृपा भी मिलेगी पर वो सेकेंडरी बात
says: The person who says 'He gave it and He took it' (accepting both gain and loss) has Saturn extremely kind to him, Jupiter kind too, and Neptune (Varuna) also gives grace, though that is secondary.
ambiguity: 'मन मैले स्वभाव' is garbled, possibly 'mast maula' (carefree) rather than 'dirty-minded'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी जन्म पत्रिका में शनि वह ग्रह है जो अंधा ग्रह है
says: In your birth chart Saturn is the blind planet, acting without seeing or reasoning.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as the blind or lame planet is traditional (Shani is called pangu, lame).

hindi: ऐसे लोग हैं जो बिना पढ़े लिखे पास होते हैं ... ऐसे लोग हैं जो बिना मेहनत के अमीर बनते हैं ... वह बच्चे भी देखे जो बिना पढ़े लिखे पास होते हैं
says: Some people pass exams without studying and others become rich without hard work; he has seen it and attributes such effortless results to Saturn.
classical_check: Silent; classically effortless gain is 11th house or Jupiter and Rahu, not Saturn.

hindi: ऐसी लड़कियां है भाई तस्ती में परोस के लड़का आया है शादी के लिए पिक एंड चूज घर बैठे रिश्ता आया घर बैठे नौकरी आई है घर बैठे घर आया है ऐसा होता है लोगों के साथ
says: Some girls get marriage proposals served on a platter to choose from, and some people get a job or a house coming to them while sitting at home; such effortless matches, jobs and homes are the outcome he links to Saturn.
ambiguity: Linkage to Saturn is by the surrounding argument, not a direct statement here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: किनके साथ होता है जिन्होंने अपने शनि को पहचान लिया चाहे जाने चाहे अनजाने चाहे गुरु कृपा से
says: It happens to those who have recognised their Saturn, whether knowingly, unknowingly or by the guru's grace.
ambiguity: 'Recognising Saturn' is not defined here; later lectures may explain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चाहे है ही ऐसे गधे इग्नोर इज अ ब्लिस
says: Or they may just be donkeys, since ignorance is bliss; unaware simple people also receive Saturn's gifts.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Asks the audience whether they are foolish, then mimics them saying we are very clever, educated and in good jobs.

hindi: एक करोड़ दो करोड़ महीने साल की तनखा है देता कौन रहा है जो आपसे शायद कम पढ़ा लिखा है तो यार अल्लाह उस पर मेहरबान है अल्लाह मेहरबान तो गधा पहलवान
says: A highly educated salaried person earns a crore or two yet the money comes from someone less educated on whom fortune smiles; fortune does not follow cleverness, as the saying goes, when God is kind even a donkey becomes a wrestler.
ambiguity: No salary figure is a prediction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी गधों की किस्मत है गधा बनना नहीं आता हम इतने समझदार है सबको राय देते हैं सबको राय देने वाला व्यक्ति गधा नहीं है पक्की गारंटी
says: This is the luck of donkeys; we cannot play the donkey because we are too clever and give advice to everybody, and a person who advises everyone is certainly not a donkey, so he misses that luck.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए उसके पास आने वाले लोग राजा बन जाएंगे वो वही रहेगा वजीर की जरूरत राजा को होती है पर बुद्धिमान कौन है वजीर पर राजा बना कौन जो कम बुद्धिमान है
says: So the people who come to a wise advisor become kings while he stays where he is; a king needs a wazir, and the wazir is the clever one, yet the one who becomes king is the less clever.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Asks if you are less clever, answers for the audience that we are very clever, then says no one is.

hindi: लेकिन हमारा अहंकार कहता है जैसे ही अहंकार आया बृहस्पति इसकी कब्र खोद देता है और ऐसी तैसी फेर देता है फिर कहता है नीचे को मर परे कर
says: Our ego claims cleverness, and as soon as ego appears Jupiter digs its grave and ruins it; pride in intelligence brings Jupiter's downfall for the person.
ambiguity: Sentence trails off at the chunk end.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as the planet of humility or pride-cutting is not a classical rule.

hindi: जुपिटर के आगे बृहस्पति के आगे कोई कुछ नहीं बोल सकता क्योंकि यही सर्वाइवल है
says: Nobody, not even Saturn, can speak against Jupiter, because Jupiter is what keeps us alive; Jupiter's authority is final.
classical_check: Agrees with Jupiter as jeeva karaka and the strongest benefic.

gist: Moving on to understand Saturn properly and asks what Saturn's negative impacts are.

hindi: शनि का नाम है शनिचर शनिचर नाम है इसका शन चलने वाला चर धीरे-धीरे
says: The name Shanaishchara means the slow mover (shanai slowly, chara moving), so slowness is the core of Saturn's nature.
classical_check: Agrees: Shani is Shanaishchara, the slow-moving one.

hindi: 30 साल में यह 12 राशियां घूमता है ढाई साल एक राशि में जाता है
says: Saturn goes through all 12 signs in about 30 years, staying roughly two and a half years in each sign.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard Saturn period of about 29.5 years and 2.5 years per sign.

hindi: 10 नंबर राशि का प्रमुख मालिक 11 नंबर का कच्चा मालिक 10 हो गई मकर यह हो गई कुंभ कुंभ घड़ा
says: Saturn is the main lord of sign number 10 (Capricorn) and only the weaker or raw lord of sign number 11 (Aquarius, the pot), so the Capricorn is his proper home and Aquarius is shared with Pluto.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's strength as lord changes with the house the sign falls in: Capricorn in a house gives full Saturn results for that house's matters, while Aquarius gives milder Saturn plus Pluto or modern flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) is Saturn's main sign on the career house, giving slow, structured, duty-bound career results.
Derived: Aquarius in the 4th (lagna Scorpio) is Saturn's weaker sign on home and mother, giving detached or unconventional domestic life.
Derived: Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer) gives a sober, delayed or older partner themes under Saturn's main lordship.

ambiguity: '10 नंबर' and '11 नंबर' are sign numbers (Capricorn, Aquarius) per this series; the weaker lord on 11 is read as Pluto's shared claim.
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn owns both Capricorn and Aquarius fully, with Aquarius as the moolatrikona.

hindi: मकर संक्रांति यानी सूरज भी यहीं से कहता है अब ऊपर को उठूंगा भैया शनि का टाइम गया
says: At Makar Sankranti, when the Sun enters sign 10 (Capricorn), the Sun starts to rise toward the north; Saturn's season is over and the Sun's season begins.
ambiguity: Mixes the Sun's northward turn (Uttarayana) with Saturn's own sign Capricorn.
classical_check: Agrees with Makar Sankranti being the Sun's entry into Capricorn and the start of Uttarayana.

hindi: देव शहनी ए कादिया खत्म देव सोए होते हैं मकर क्रांति के बाद पो का महीना भी गया पितरों को भी कृपा दे ले डाली उनसे उनको भी प्रणाम कर लिया
says: The gods sleep from Devshayani Ekadashi and that period ends; after Makar Sankranti the month of Pausha is also gone, and we have received the ancestors' grace and paid respects to them.
ambiguity: Caption garbled around 'देव शहनी ए कादिया'; read as Devshayani Ekadashi.
classical_check: Calendar tradition; not a Parashara rule.

hindi: अब किसके पास है अब सूर्य के पास समय आ गया जब उत्तरायण में भीष्म ने भी शरीर छोड़ा तब तक वेट किया कि शनि के टाइम में नहीं जाऊंगा
says: Now the time belongs to the Sun; Bhishma waited for Uttarayana before leaving his body because he did not want to go during Saturn's time, a mythic claim about the departure season (no individual dates are implied).
classical_check: Agrees with the Mahabharata story of Bhishma choosing Uttarayana.

hindi: पता नहीं कहां जाऊंगा क्योंकि यमलोक ले जाएगा यह क्या करेगा नर्क पहुंचाएगा
says: Within Saturn's time one may not know where one goes, since Saturn, as Yama's brother, may lead to Yamaloka or hell; he states this as a mythic belief about the afterlife, not as a prediction for any chart.
classical_check: Silent; a puranic belief rather than a jyotish rule.

hindi: 30 साल के अंदर शनि चलता है यानी कुंडली के 12 खानों में ढाई ढाई वर्ष एक एक राशि में गोलगोल घूमता है
says: Saturn takes 30 years to go round the 12 compartments of the kundali, two and a half years in each, so he spends a fixed time in every sign or house in turn.
ambiguity: He uses 'खाना' (box, house) and 'राशि' (sign) as the same thing; for a lagna chart a sign sits in a house and the two differ.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn's transit of about 2.5 years per sign.

hindi: क्योंकि बहुत ज्यादा लंबा घेरा है बाकी प्लेनेट का और भी ज्यादा बड़ा है 80 160 250 ऐसे चलते हैं अगले 80 साल 150 साल और 250 साल अप्रॉक्स यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो
says: The orbits of the planets beyond Saturn are even larger: Uranus takes about 80 years, Neptune about 160 and Pluto about 250, so those outer planets stay very long in a sign.
ambiguity: Approximate figures; real periods are about 84, 165 and 248 years.
classical_check: Classical texts do not cover these planets.

hindi: शनि बार-बार पीछे की ओर आता रहता है आगे को आगे पीछे नहीं जाता वक्री कहते हैं इसे यानी सूर्य के अनुसार ... धरती के परिपेक्ष से
says: Saturn repeatedly seems to move backward, which is called vakri or retrograde; he notes it is only an apparent backward motion as seen from the Earth, since the Sun stays in place.
ambiguity: He first says 'according to the Sun' then corrects to Earth's viewpoint.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard definition of vakri as apparent retrograde motion.

hindi: यह इतना धीमे चलता है कि जितने भी धीमे काम होते हैं कचहरी चल रही है बीमारी चल रही है परेशानी चल रही है मकान ढूंढ रहे हैं अमीर बनने की वेट हो रही है
says: Saturn is so slow that everything slow comes under him: court cases, long illness, ongoing trouble, house-hunting and waiting to become rich; he governs matters that drag on.
ambiguity: The illness mention is a general theme, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as karaka of delay, litigation, chronic ailments and property hunting.

hindi: लेकिन यह तुक्के का शहनशाह है तो जब बनोगे अमीर कैसे बनोगे तुक्के से कब होगी शादी तुक्के से कब मिलेगी नौकरी तुक्के से प्रमोशन कब होगी तुक्के से
says: Though slow, Saturn is also the emperor of flukes, so when riches, marriage, a job or a promotion finally comes it arrives suddenly by a stroke of luck, not through effort or planning.
classical_check: Differs from the classical view of Saturn's results as earned through delay and labour.

hindi: शनि जब देता है तो अरे यह तो हमने सोचा ही नहीं था यह मेंटालिटी होती है
says: When Saturn gives, it comes as something we never even thought of; that sense of surprise is the hallmark of his gifts.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अदर वाइज शनि घसीट घसीट रगड़ रगड़ के जंग लगा देता है लोहे पर
says: If not, Saturn drags and grinds you down slowly and lets rust form on iron; his other mode is erosion and wearing away.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as iron and the planet of wear and decay.

hindi: आप जिस बीमारी को ठीक करने के लिए मरे जा रहे हैं यह तो मैं ठीक करके छोडूंगा वो और बढ़ेगी यह आपका प्रारब्ध है शनि के पास आपका प्रारब्ध है
says: A condition you are desperately trying to force-cure will worsen under your pressure because it belongs to your prarabdha, which Saturn holds; this is a tradition claim about forcing Saturn matters, not medical advice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके पास मुन्ना है यह प्रीव करता है यह सूर्य का पुत्र है सूर्य जितना शक्तिशाली कोई नहीं लेकिन यह बहुत ताकतवर है
says: Saturn is the Sun's son; nobody is as powerful as the Sun but Saturn too is very powerful.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' and 'प्रीव' are garbled.
classical_check: Agrees: Shani is Surya's son, though classically Sun and Saturn are enemies.

hindi: अब इसके आगे जुपिटर है इसलिए ये सीधा नहीं देखता बहुत छोटी दृष्टि है सीधा देखने की इसलिए टेढ़ा टेढ़ देखता है
says: Because Jupiter stands in front of Saturn, he cannot see straight and has only a very small direct line of sight, so he looks at things at an angle.
classical_check: Silent; this is his explanation for Saturn's unusual aspects.

hindi: शनि की दृष्टि कही जाती है टेढ़ी दृष्टि एक तीन सात और 10 यह इसकी दृष्टि है
says: Saturn's glance is called the crooked glance and he sees through four points: 1, 3, 7 and 10, counted from where he sits, meaning his own house plus the 3rd, 7th and 10th from it.
cells_derived_method: Counting from Saturn's house H: he works on H itself and on the 3rd, 7th and 10th from it, so the four houses touched change with H, and the sign on each of those houses decides the flavour. Example counts: H=1 touches 1,3,7,10; H=6 touches 6,8,12,3; H=10 touches 10,12,4,7.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 1st in Capricorn (lagna Capricorn) touches houses 1, 3, 7 and 10, so self, courage, partnership and career all carry Saturn's weight.
Derived: Saturn in the 6th in Virgo (lagna Aries) touches houses 6, 8, 12 and 3, loading work, hidden matters, losses and effort with Saturn.
Derived: Saturn in the 10th in Aries (debilitated; lagna Cancer) touches houses 10, 12, 4 and 7, pressing career, expenses, home and partnership.

ambiguity: 'एक' is read as the seated house itself; classical Saturn aspects are 3rd, 7th and 10th from the seat, so the '1' may be conjunction.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn's special aspects on the 3rd, 7th and 10th; counting the seat as the fourth place is his addition.

hindi: इन खानों में शनि ने चार जगह काम करना ही है चाहे कुछ भी कर लो यह शनि महाराज अगर यहां बैठे हैं तो यह य भी काम कर रहे हैं यहां भी काम कर रहे हैं
says: Whatever you do, Saturn must work in four houses of the chart at once: the one he sits in and the three he aspects.
cells_derived_method: For Saturn in house H the four affected houses are H, H+2, H+6 and H+9 (mod 12). Example: Saturn in 2nd touches 2, 4, 8, 11.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 2nd in Aquarius (lagna Capricorn) works on houses 2, 4, 8 and 11: wealth and family, home, hidden matters and gains.
Derived: Saturn in the 8th in Libra (exalted; lagna Pisces) works on houses 8, 10, 2 and 5.

classical_check: Agrees with Saturn's three aspects; the 'four places' count includes the seat.

hindi: कहते हैं शनि की वक्र दृष्टि आपके जीवन को नष्ट कर देती है बर्बाद कर देती है टेढ़ी दृष्टि पहले तो टेढ़ी और दूसरी वक्र उल्टी चलती हुई
says: It is said that Saturn's vakra drishti ruins one's life; he reads the word two ways, as crooked (tedhi) and as backward-moving (retrograde).
ambiguity: Two meanings of vakra deliberately blended.
classical_check: Classically a retrograde Saturn is considered stronger, not necessarily more harmful; 'ruins life' is a popular saying.

hindi: ढाई साल में 20वीं बार उल्टा हो सकता है बसवी बार नहीं होता चार पांच बार है पर उल्टा चलता है
says: In a stretch of two and a half years Saturn turns retrograde several times, about four or five at most and not twenty; the number in the caption is garbled but the point is that he does go backward repeatedly.
ambiguity: Number words are garbled; in reality Saturn goes retrograde once a year, so 2 or 3 times in 2.5 years.
classical_check: Differs from real motion (one retrograde per year).

hindi: इसलिए आपके अच्छे दिन अचानक उल्टे हो जाते हैं अचानक झटके से प्यार मिल जाता है नाक झटके से छिन जाता है
says: Because Saturn reverses course, good days suddenly turn bad, and love may suddenly arrive and just as suddenly be snatched away.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये अंधकार का मालिक है इसके पास न्याय प्रणाली है
says: Saturn is the lord of darkness and holds the system of justice, meaning the machinery that delivers consequences.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as Dharmaraja, the dispenser of justice.

hindi: आप यह मान के चल ले कि शनि महाराज का भाई है यमराज यमराज का भाई है यह न्याय का मालिक है न्याय आपके जीवन में न्याय करेगा यह फैसला
says: Take it that Yamraj is Saturn's brother and Saturn is the lord of justice who will pass judgment in your life.
ambiguity: Yama is also his name for Pluto in this scheme; here the mythic Yamraj is meant.
classical_check: Agrees: Yama and Shani are both sons of Surya.

hindi: आपने जरा सा कोई कुछ करके बृहस्पति को डिस्टर्ब किया जिसके साथ रहता है उसी टाइम बृहस्पति इसको तोड़ देगा अहंकार नहीं करने देगा और तोड़ के खत्म करेगा
says: If you disturb Jupiter even slightly, then Jupiter at that very time breaks the person Saturn favoured, does not allow ego and finishes him off; Jupiter's displeasure overrides Saturn's gifts.
ambiguity: Unclear what 'disturbing Jupiter' means in action: disrespecting a guru, elders or teachers is implied.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति को जीवन में तुक्के से जो मिला है अगर उसने अहंकार किया पिटेगा आप बाहर जाकर लंबी लंबी छोड़ रहे हैं आपको फुकरा बना देगा
says: Whoever has received something by a stroke of luck and then grows proud will be beaten down; boasting outside will turn you into a nobody.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बड़े बुजुर्ग क्या कह गए चुप रखो गुप्त रखो मुंह से मत बोलो गुप्त दान नहीं होता दान तो दान होता है लेकिन बखान मत करो
says: The elders said to keep gains quiet and secret, do not speak of them; donate, but do not announce it, which is why secret donation (gupt daan) is praised.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical teaching that secret charity gives the greater merit.

hindi: बताते ही शनि इंपैक्ट छोड़ देगा और न्याय करेगा शनि कहता है फैसला करूंगा मैं
says: The moment you tell others about your luck or charity, Saturn releases his impact and delivers judgment; Saturn says he will decide the matter himself.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: राहु जो होता है यह वह ग्रह है जो आपका चालान कट गया तो आपके लिए सम्मन भेजता है शनि बैठा है जज मैं फैसला करके दूंगा
says: With Saturn as the judge, Rahu is the planet that sends the summons once a challan is cut against you, the process-server of Saturn's court.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as the agent of sudden legal and official troubles is a modern popular view.

hindi: केतु आपका वकील है जो कहता है जी हजूर मैं बताता हूं हजूर को एक्चुअली क्या हुआ हजूर देखिए ऐसा करना था वैसा करना था वो एक्सप्लेनेशन
says: Ketu is your lawyer in Saturn's court who explains to the judge what actually happened and argues in your defence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: राहु और केतु इसके एजेंट है लेकिन राहु पनिशर है वो सूर्य को भी ढाक देता है केतु जो है वो प्रोटेक्ट भी करता है पनिश भी करता है लेकिन प्रोटेक्टर ज्यादा है क्योंकि वो पीछे का हिस्सा है
says: Rahu and Ketu are both Saturn's agents; Rahu is the punisher who even covers the Sun, while Ketu both protects and punishes but is mostly a protector because he is the rear part.
classical_check: Differs: classically both nodes are malefic; calling Ketu mainly protective is a modern or Ketu-as-moksha view.

hindi: राहु मुंडी है केतु शरीर है पूंछ है पूरी सांप की और सांप शनि है
says: Rahu is the head and Ketu the body and tail of one whole snake, and that snake is Saturn; so the two nodes together are Saturn's serpent form.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical Rahu as head and Ketu as body split; making the whole snake equal Saturn is his own.

hindi: आपके जीवन में यदि अचानक से कोई डस ले दोस्त ने डस लिया भाई ने डस लिया पत्नी ने पति ने बच्चे ने मतलब कृपा तो नहीं है शनि का इफेक्ट है
says: If someone close, a friend, brother, spouse or child, suddenly bites you like a snake, it is not grace but Saturn's effect.
classical_check: Silent; betrayal by close persons is classically Rahu or the 6th and 12th houses.

hindi: आपका शनि जहां बैठ गया वहां से आपके जीवन में वहां आपको अंधकार दे देगा
says: Wherever Saturn sits in your chart, he gives darkness in that part of life; the house he occupies shows where you are in the dark.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's house sets the life area made opaque, and the sign adds how: the 3rd gives darkness about siblings and efforts, the 7th about partners, the 10th about career direction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 3rd in Scorpio (lagna Virgo) gives murky matters around siblings, effort and communication, with intense hidden dealings.
Derived: Saturn in the 7th in Gemini (lagna Sagittarius) leaves one unclear about partner and contracts, with talkative or changeable partners.
Derived: Saturn in the 10th in Libra (exalted; lagna Capricorn) gives darkness about career direction, though the exalted sign eventually brings steady status.

classical_check: Silent on 'darkness'; Saturn in a house is classically said to delay and burden that house's matters.

hindi: उदाहरणार्थ ले लीजिए आपके शनि ये नौवा भाव होता है शनि का नव घर में बैठा भाव नहीं नौवें घर में शनि बैठा राशि बाद की बात होगी क्योंकि कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है
says: As an example he takes Saturn in the 9th house, giving the house only and not the sign, because adding the sign is more complicated and will come later.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 9th touches houses 9, 11, 3 and 6; the sign on the 9th decides tone: Saturn in Aries (debilitated) in the 9th is lagna Leo, in Libra (exalted) lagna Aquarius, in Capricorn lagna Taurus.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) pressures fortune, dharma and father with rash, abrupt setbacks.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) gives mature, disciplined fortune and respect for dharma.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जहां जहां बैठा वहां वहां काम कर रहा है अब चार जगह तो यहीं से काम कर रहा है एक बैठा और तीन दृष्टि फिर पता लगा यहां भी खिसक गया तो 4 दनी आ 12 में से आठ तो इसीने पकड़ लिए
says: Saturn works wherever he sits: four places at once, one by sitting and three by aspect, and when he moves on to the next sign he covers four more, so in two placements he has gripped eight of the twelve houses and put many areas in darkness.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in H touches H, H+2, H+6, H+9; one sign later it touches H+1, H+3, H+7, H+10, so the union is eight houses unless they overlap.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 9th in Capricorn (lagna Taurus) touches 9, 11, 3, 6 and, after moving to Aquarius in the 10th, touches 10, 12, 4, 7; together eight houses, leaving 1, 2, 5, 8 free.
Derived: Saturn in the 1st in Capricorn (lagna Capricorn) touches 1, 3, 7, 10 and, after moving to Aquarius in the 2nd, touches 2, 4, 8, 11; leaving 5, 6, 9, 12 free.

ambiguity: Assumes a move to the next sign shifts every touched house by one.
classical_check: Consistent with how aspects shift with transit; the 'eight of twelve' count is his own arithmetic.

hindi: अब ये नौवां घर अगर इसके बारे में आप अंधकार में रहोगे बिल्कुल अंधेरा कर दिया शनि ने तो यह रॉकेट की तरह काम करेगा और पॉजिटिव करेगा
says: If Saturn has made you completely ignorant about the 9th house (fortune), then he will work like a rocket and deliver positive results; staying in the dark and not interfering lets Saturn in the 9th work well.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house stands for fortune, father, dharma and long journeys; Saturn's unseen working there changes with the sign, e.g. Cancer gives emotional luck, Sagittarius gives teacher-led luck.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 9th in Sagittarius (lagna Aries) gives fortune through teachers and travel that arrives without planning.
Derived: Saturn in the 9th in Pisces (lagna Cancer) gives fortune through faith, foreign places or spiritual figures, unseen and unplanned.

ambiguity: 'पॉजिटिव' may refer to the chart reading of Saturn.
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn in the 9th is a delay for fortune; this is his reading of non-interference.

hindi: अगर ये 12 पर में नेगेटिव लिखा है नीच का ही है तो टांग तोड़ सकता है पैर मार सकता है लेकिन फिर बचा भी देगा क्योंकि 12 से ऊपर नहीं
says: If Saturn is debilitated it may break a leg or strike hard but would also save the person, because it cannot go beyond a limit; the caption around '12 पर' is garbled and only the debilitated Saturn warning is clear.
cells_derived_method: Saturn debilitated in Aries gives injury-type setbacks in the body area of the house: in the 9th, hips and thighs and father; in the 6th, daily-work injuries; in the 1st, whole body build.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries) pressures the body and self-image, with rash accidents but a later recovery.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) pressures fortune and father, with a rough patch that does not end in total loss.

ambiguity: 'नीच का' read as debilitated Saturn in Aries; garbled caption could mean other sign claims. Injury is a tradition reading, not a medical prediction.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is debilitated in Aries.

hindi: अक्सर लोग ऐसे हैं पता ही नहीं चल रहा भाई जिंदगी कट रही है पता नहीं कैसे कटेंगे आपके शनि ने यहां बैठ कर के भाग्य को अंधकार में डाल दिया
says: Many people say they do not know how life is passing or how it will pass; Saturn sitting in the 9th has put their fortune in darkness.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 9th leaves fortune unclear in every sign, but the cause differs: Capricorn gives slow duty-based luck, Libra a balanced but delayed luck, Aries a restless, setback-prone luck.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus) gives luck that is slow, structured and tied to work or duty.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) gives luck with delay but eventual fairness and standing.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) gives luck with obstacles and impatience around beliefs.

classical_check: Agrees with classical 'Saturn in the 9th troubles fortune and father'.

hindi: अगर आपने पता करने की कोशिश की कि मेरे भाग्य में क्या होगा तो आपको खून के रुलाएगा कि तूने पता कैसे कर लिया
says: If you try to find out what is in your fortune, Saturn will make you weep blood, as if asking how you dared to find out; probing fortune with Saturn in the 9th invites his anger (sentence cut at the chunk end).
ambiguity: Cut off at the end of the chunk; may be a figure of speech about anxiety over predictions.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Example of a wife repeatedly pressing her husband to tell, leading to a fight, police and court over how he did something.

hindi: बहुत बड़े-बड़े लोगों के बारे में मशहूर है ... यह बताते ही नहीं भाई अगर आप ऐसे हैं कि बताते नहीं शनि आपके ऊपर मेहरबान रहेगा
says: Very successful people are famous for never revealing how they did it, and a person who does not tell keeps Saturn favourable.
classical_check: Silent; secrecy as protection is a general tradition.

hindi: शनि न्याय का देवता है जज है आपके हक में फैसला देगा आपने बता दिया आपके विरोध में फैसला देगा
says: Saturn is the judge and god of justice: if you stay quiet he rules in your favour, but if you tell people about your gains he rules against you.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as the dispenser of justice; the secrecy link is his own.

hindi: अगर आपने लंबी लंबी छोड़ी तो आपको कूट देगा इसीलिए आपको अंधकार में रहना है
says: If you boast Saturn will thrash you, which is why you should stay in the dark about your own affairs and not broadcast them.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब ऐसा व्यक्ति है नौवे घर में नौवा घर पिता का होता है यह किससे दूर करेगा भाग्य से दूर करेगा पिता से भी दूर कर देगा
says: Take a person with Saturn in the 9th house, the house of the father: Saturn keeps him away from fortune and from his father.
cells_derived_method: The 9th stands for father and fortune; the sign on the 9th changes how the separation shows: a fire sign gives sharp quarrels, an earth sign gives duty-bound distance, a water sign gives emotional distance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus) gives a stern, duty-bound father and distance through workload or rules.
Derived: Saturn in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) gives emotional coldness with the father and a sense of unprotected fortune.
Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer) gives a distant or absent father and belief-based fortune that is hard to grasp.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 9th is classically said to trouble father and fortune.

hindi: अपने आप ही बच्चा पिता से दूर होगा पढ़ने चाहे बाहर चला जाए बाप से बनेगी भी नहीं पूछेगा भी नहीं
says: Such a child drifts away from the father on his own, whether by going away to study or simply by not getting along or not even enquiring about him.
ambiguity: Assumes the Saturn in the 9th setting just described.
classical_check: Agrees broadly with Saturn in the 9th giving distance from the father.

hindi: कई लोग कहेंगे जी हमारी बनती है शनि प्लेस नहीं या फिर खिसका है अगर है तो किसी और ग्रह की राशि और दृष्टि है
says: If someone says he gets along fine with his father, then either Saturn is not placed in the 9th, or Saturn has moved on, or he sits in another planet's sign and under another planet's aspect, which softens the result.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 9th in a friendly sign such as Libra (exalted) or Gemini or Aquarius, or aspected by Jupiter, gives milder results than in Aries (debilitated).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) can give a fair, respectful bond with a disciplined father.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) shows the father bond at its strained worst.

classical_check: Agrees with the principle that sign, aspects and dignity modify a placement.

hindi: यह हम मोटा स्वभाव समझ रहे हैं एक ग्रह के जानने से ज्योतिष नहीं आता
says: This is only a crude general nature of Saturn; knowing one planet does not give you jyotish, so one placement is never a complete reading.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical need to weigh the whole chart.

gist: A child studies 20 years to become a graduate and still gets a low job; so jyotish cannot be learnt in four or five classes.

hindi: जिन माता-पिता को बच्चों का सुख नहीं मिलता उनका यह हाल है अगर शनि यहां बैठा हुआ है तो इसकी दृष्टि है यहां यह व्यक्ति खुद अपने पिता से अलग ही होगा
says: Parents who do not get happiness from their children usually have Saturn placed in the 9th with his aspect falling on the child's house; such a person is himself separate from his own father.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 9th aspects the 11th, 3rd and 6th, so the 5th is not hit from the 9th; he is likely pointing at a separate placement for the child house. In Saturn's own case the 9th placement gives the father separation and a 5th-house hit gives the child separation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus) makes the person distant from the father; the 5th house (Virgo) is untouched by aspect from here.

ambiguity: He gestures at a diagram, so which house the aspect lands on is not recoverable; the 5th is inferred from 'child'.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn on or aspecting the 5th troubles children; father separation is from the 9th placement.

hindi: यह पिता है यह बच्चा है शनि यहां बैठा है ... इसकी दृष्टि घूम के यहां है इस व्यक्ति का बच्चा इससे दूर ही होगा होना ही है चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए
says: With Saturn in one house and his aspect travelling round to the child's house (the 5th), the person's child will be distant from him, and this must happen whatever he does.
cells_derived_method: Saturn hits the 5th from the 3rd (3rd aspect), the 11th (7th aspect), the 8th (10th aspect), or by sitting in the 5th. The sign on the 5th flavours how the distance arises.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 3rd in Scorpio (lagna Virgo) aspects the 5th house, Capricorn, and distances the child through effort and secrecy.
Derived: Saturn in the 11th in Taurus (lagna Cancer) aspects the 5th house, Scorpio, with intense separation from children.
Derived: Saturn in the 8th in Gemini (lagna Scorpio) aspects the 5th house, Pisces, with distance through hidden or emotional barriers.

ambiguity: Diagram is gestured, not described; the houses 3, 11, 8 are computed from his aspect rule 3, 7, 10 rather than read from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn aspecting the 5th gives delay or separation with children, but 'must happen whatever' is stronger than classical texts.

hindi: शनि की दृष्टि इस घर के ऊपर है यहां से यहां हो सकती है तीसरी यहां से यहां हो सकती है शनि यहां हो सकता है खिसक के आया हो
says: Saturn's aspect on the house can come from different seats, one by the third aspect and others from elsewhere, and Saturn may also have slid into place by transit, so all those placements count.
ambiguity: Gesture-heavy; the transit remark means a current Saturn position also acts like a natal one.
classical_check: Agrees that transit Saturn aspects activate natal houses.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति को पढ़ाई में जैसे ही पता चलेगा मैं तो यह करूंगा लाइन चेंज मम्मा मैं तो पायलट बनूंगा अब नहीं बन सकता पायलट लिख के दे दो
says: A student who announces a chosen path, such as becoming a pilot or changing the line, will not be able to follow it when Saturn blocks that area; he states he can say so in writing.
ambiguity: The house he means (education, 4th or 5th) is not named.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit that Saturn on the education houses blocks plans; no specific rule.

hindi: बच्चे से पूछ लो बेटा क्या करोगे बेबी मैं तो सीए बनूंगा लिख दो सीए नहीं बन सकता तू पैर पकड़ेगा
says: Ask the child what he will be; if he says CA, he writes that this will not happen and that the parent will later hold his feet and ask how he knew; Saturn's block on a goal can be named in advance.
ambiguity: Career outcomes stated as sure; he does not give a chart condition.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mimics the parent asking how he knew and answers that Saturn is seated in the chart; why ask, what is the use, break the dream.
Anticipates people saying this will break hearts.

hindi: जहां जहां शनि बैठा वहां ना चाहे जहां चाहना उसकी क्लास कराएंगे कैसे चाहना शनि के मुद्दे पर
says: Where Saturn sits one should not desire, because wanting in that area is exactly what Saturn defeats; how to desire correctly in Saturn's matters will be a separate class.
cells_derived_method: The house holding Saturn is where wishing fails: in the 7th, wishing for a partner; in the 10th, wishing for a career peak; in the 2nd, wishing for wealth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 7th in Gemini (lagna Sagittarius) means pushing for a partner or deal tends to backfire.
Derived: Saturn in the 10th in Leo (lagna Scorpio) means forcing a career ambition tends to be blocked.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 2nd (lagna Virgo) means chasing wealth head-on delays it, while a patient approach works.
