hindi: पत्नी हमेशा बदनाम है इस चीज के लिए कि पति को पूछती रहती कहां गए थे कहां गए थे और पति है कमीना बताता नहीं ... पति भी बार बार पूछे पत्नी से उसको भी आग लग जाती है
says: Wives are always blamed for asking where the husband went, and husbands who do not say get blamed too, but a husband who keeps asking his wife gets the same reaction; constant questioning of a partner provokes anger because it intrudes on the Saturn zone.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: फ्रीडम सबको चाहिए यानी माय टाइम शनि के पास माय टाइम है
says: Everyone wants freedom, 'my time', and that private time and space belongs to Saturn.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as karaka of solitude is traditional.

gist: Aside about people nursing a small drink for two hours who do not know they are enjoying life's nectar.

hindi: जो लोग अध्यात्म में चकते हैं और पता ही नहीं किसको पूज रहे शायद नास्तिक है वो शनि उनके ऊपर मेहरबान है
says: People who go into spirituality without knowing whom they are worshipping, maybe even atheists, have Saturn kind to them; not knowing is again Saturn's favoured state.
ambiguity: 'चकते' is garbled; read as 'being drawn' or 'immersed'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां बैठा हुआ शनि डार्कनेस काला अंधकार आ गया रात का अंधेरा कैसा होता है ... रात के अंधेरे में कुछ नहीं दिखता यानी जहां जहां शनि ने देख ली दृष्टि वहां पता नहीं होगा
says: Like the night, where nothing can be seen, every house Saturn looks at will be unknown to you; his aspect houses are as hidden as his seat.
cells_derived_method: Aspected houses are 3rd, 7th and 10th from Saturn: the topics hidden follow those houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 1st in Capricorn (lagna Capricorn) aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th, so efforts, partner and career are unclear.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 6th (lagna Scorpio) aspects the 8th, 12th and 3rd, hiding upheavals, losses and efforts.

classical_check: Agrees that Saturn's aspect delays and veils the matters of the houses it sees.

hindi: आपको पता ही नहीं किस देवता को पूछना है शायद आप नास्तिक ही है शनि महाराज के लिए उपाय की बात नहीं है आपके शनि की प्लेसमेंट कैसी है आपका ग्रह कैसा है
says: Where you do not know which deity to turn to, a remedy for Saturn is not a blanket matter; what matters is how your Saturn is placed and what kind of planet he is for you.
ambiguity: 'शनि महाराज पैक के लिए' is garbled and read as 'upay (remedy) for Saturn'.
classical_check: Agrees that remedies should depend on the chart placement.

hindi: जो पीला तेल है वो बृहस्पति रूपी शनि है जो हरा तेल है वो बुद्ध रूपी शनि है अभी बात आएगी ये तेल भी चढ़ाते
says: Yellow oil offered to Saturn suits the Jupiter-type Saturn and green oil suits the Mercury-type Saturn; the oil offering depends on which character Saturn has in the chart (to be explained later).
ambiguity: 'बुद्ध' is Mercury (Budh); how to decide Jupiter-type or Mercury-type Saturn is not given here.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts prescribe sesame or mustard oil for Saturn; coloured oils are his own scheme.

gist: Says remedies for Saturn will be taught and he will start them later.

hindi: जहां सूर्य आ गया वहां क्या हुआ उजाला आ गया ना अगर आपका सूर्य मान लो यहां बैठा तो आपको पता होगा कौन सी प्रॉपर्टी खरीद रहे क्या खरीद रहे जैसी डिग्री होगी डिग्री के हिसाब से होता है
says: Where the Sun is, there is light: if your Sun sits in the property house you will know which property you are buying and what, with the clarity depending on the Sun's degree.
cells_derived_method: Sun in a house gives clarity about that house's matters, more so in his own or exalted signs: in the 4th it clarifies property, in the 5th children, in the 10th career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 4th (lagna Capricorn) gives full clarity about home and property decisions.
Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus) gives confident, clear property choices tied to status.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn) gives a clear but compromised sight of the career.

ambiguity: The 'property house' is gestured; read as the 4th.
classical_check: Agrees with Sun giving visibility and authority; degree-based strength matches the classical shadbala.

hindi: यह शनि बैठा है आपको पता नहीं होगा कैसी होगी आप यूं ही घूमते रहोगे यहां शनि की दृष्टि है या बैठा है यह प्रॉपर्टी का इलाका है आप पैसा लेकर घूमते रहोगे मैं यह वाली लूंगा
says: If Saturn sits on or aspects the property area, you will wander around with money not knowing what you will get, saying you will take this one, and you will not get what you chose.
cells_derived_method: Saturn on or aspecting the 4th blocks one's preferred property; Saturn hits the 4th from the 4th itself, the 2nd (3rd aspect), the 10th (7th aspect) and the 7th (10th aspect). The sign colours the blockage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer) gets property in the end, but not the one first chosen.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 4th (lagna Capricorn) gives repeated failed property deals and hasty choices.
Derived: Saturn in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra) aspects the 4th by his 7th aspect, so property decisions are obstructed through career duties.

ambiguity: The property house is read as the 4th.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn on or aspecting the 4th delays property.

hindi: आंख मूंद के कह दो भाई तेरी चॉइस की नहीं मिलेगी तू मरता मर जा चॉइस की नहीं मिलेगी
says: With Saturn there you can say with eyes shut that you will not get the one of your choice however hard you try; what comes will not be what you picked.
ambiguity: Stated as certain, with no chart condition beyond Saturn's seat or aspect.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि की यहां दृष्टि है या बैठा है यह लड़की हो लड़का हो अफेयर कर कर के मर जाएंगे ढेर देता है जैसे ही चॉइस बनाई हाय तो मुझे पसंद है मैं तुझे प्यार करता हूं या करती हूं गायब
says: If Saturn sits on or aspects the house of love, boys and girls will have many affairs and die trying, because he supplies many options but whenever a choice is made and love declared, the partner disappears.
cells_derived_method: Love and affairs are the 5th and 7th houses; Saturn hits the 5th from the 3rd, 5th, 8th or 11th and the 7th from the 5th, 7th, 1st or 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Gemini in the 5th (lagna Aquarius) gives many light, talkative romances that vanish on commitment.
Derived: Saturn in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) gives plenty of partners but each one slips away when chosen.

ambiguity: The love house is gestured: could be the 5th (romance) or the 7th (partner). 'Die trying' is hyperbole.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts say Saturn in these houses delays or restricts, not 'many options'.

hindi: दुनिया में सिर्फ एक परसेंट के भी सैकड़ों हिस्से को घटा लो डेसीमल पॉइंट पर उन लोगों से मेनिफेस्टेशन होती है बाकी से क्यों नहीं होती क्योंकि वह या तो आट जान गए हैं या वह उस श्रेणी में पड़ते हैं कि शनि वहां पर है नहीं
says: Manifestation works for only a tiny fraction of people, a decimal point of one percent; the rest fail because the successful ones either know the method or fall in the group where Saturn is not placed on that matter.
ambiguity: The figure is rhetorical. 'आट जान गए' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: किसी ने मेनिफेस्ट कर ली कार लेकिन जॉब नहीं कर पाया तो वो कार का ही तड़ी मारता रहता है ... बंगला मैंने मेनिफेस्ट किया था बच्चे उसकी सुनते नहीं भाई बच्चे को नहीं मेनिफेस्ट कर पा रहा क्योंकि यह शनि का कहीं ना कहीं लिंक है
says: Someone who manifests a car but cannot hold a job, or a bungalow while his children do not listen, shows that success in one area does not carry to others; the failing area is where Saturn has a link.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बीवी से तेरी बनती नहीं बिल्डिंग तूने मेनिफेस्ट कर ली बिल गेट्स का तलाक हो गया और वैसे वो दुनिया का अमीर आदमी है ... बाकी क्यों नहीं करता
says: He cites a famous billionaire whose divorce happened despite great wealth to show that manifesting a building does not fix a failing marriage; wealth areas and the spouse area work separately (an anecdote about a real person, not verified).
ambiguity: Real public figure named in a story; no chart given.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसको एक गलतफहमी उसने मेनिफेस्ट की है वो इस शक में लगा हुआ कि मैंने किया है वहां शनि महाराज ने छोड़ा हुआ है
says: The misunderstanding is that the person thinks he manifested it himself, while in fact Saturn left that result to him; credit for a Saturn gift is wrongly claimed as one's own doing.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जहां बृहस्पति आ गया ज्ञान के द्वारा बुद्ध आ गया वाणी के द्वारा मंगल पुरुषार्थ के द्वारा शनि आ गया बिना पता किए मैनिफेस्टो होगा
says: Where Jupiter acts through knowledge, Mercury through speech and Mars through effort, you get results by doing; where Saturn comes in, things manifest without your finding out how.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the classical roles of Jupiter, Mercury and Mars.

hindi: इस लड़के की या लड़की की शादी कैसे होगी प्रकट होगा रिश्ता प्रकट अगर वो बिल्कुल ब्लैंक ब्लैंक है 27 दिन से 29 दिन की साइकिल होती है चंद्रमा की इतने दिन में शादी होगी यह रिश्ता आया और महीने में शादी भी हो गई
says: How will a boy or girl marry? If he or she stays completely blank and does not probe, the match appears on its own, and within one Moon cycle of 27 to 29 days the wedding can happen; a timing claim by him with no chart rule given.
ambiguity: Not clear whether the Moon cycle is a promise or an example; the 27 to 29 days is the Moon's sidereal and synodic range.
classical_check: Silent; classical marriage timing uses dasha and Jupiter transit.

hindi: लोग कहते हैं कब प्रकट हुए देवता हमें पता ना चला विष्णु जी आए थे लक्ष्मी को ले गए हमें पता ही नहीं चला बच्चे का एडमिशन कैसे हो गया अरे हंसते खेलते पेपर देके आए थे
says: When Saturn works unseen, people later say the deity appeared and they never knew, a wedding or a child's admission happened while they laughed and played, without any struggle; unseen success is Saturn's signature.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Starts a sentence about some people saying they are working very hard; cut off at the end of the chunk.
Student claims he studies day and night to clear the paper, setting up a contrast story.

hindi: फेल पास कौन हुआ जो गर्लफ्रेंड के साथ स्कूटी पर घूमता रहता था पिक्चर भी देखता वो पास हो गया क्योंकि उसके शनि ने छेड़खानी नहीं पाई
says: He says the hard-working student failed while the carefree one who roamed with his girlfriend passed, because the carefree one's Saturn was not disturbed. Result depends on Saturn's state, not on effort alone.
ambiguity: 'Chhedkhani' (teasing/disturbing) of Saturn is not defined; could mean affliction by other planets or by the native's own actions.
classical_check: Classical texts make exam success depend on 4th/5th houses and Mercury/Jupiter; Saturn-only cause is not classical.

hindi: हम सबके जीवन में लटिया लगती है हम सबके लगती है कोई ना कोई लगती है
says: Everyone gets a 'screwing' (Saturn-type setback) in life at some point; nobody escapes it.
ambiguity: He does not name Saturn in this sentence; continuing context is Saturn.
classical_check: Silent; generic Saturn-as-trouble idea is consistent with tradition.

hindi: ना समझ के लाइफ में ज्यादा लगती है जो बहुत समझदार है और वाणी से अधिक बोलता है उसकी लाइफ में कम लगती है
says: Setbacks hit the naive more; a very wise person who speaks a lot (verbally expressive) suffers fewer of them.
ambiguity: Caption could mean 'talks more' as a good thing or merely 'talks openly'; the next sentence contradicts this later (don't announce plans).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो भग देता है कि पहले तो पोस्टर छाप लो अब तो यह करने वाला हूं मैं होता ही नहीं किसी हालत में नहीं होगा
says: A person who loudly announces a plan in advance (print the posters, I am going to do this) will not get it done in any circumstance; advance announcement kills the outcome.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled ('bhag deta hai'); meaning inferred from the following passage about not planning or discussing.
classical_check: Silent; secrecy of plans is a folk idea, not a classical Saturn rule.

hindi: आपके जीवन में शनि महाराज ने जहां दृष्टि डाल दी या बैठे हैं वह अंधकार का इलाका है उसके बारे में पता मत करो
says: The life area where Saturn sits or casts aspect is a dark zone; do not probe or inquire into it, because probing it brings trouble.
cells_derived_method: Take the houses Saturn occupies or aspects (3rd, 7th, 10th from it) and read their topics as the dark areas: 4th = home peace, 7th = spouse and partners, 10th = career. Sign nature colours how: a fire sign makes it a loud dark zone, a water sign a hidden one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in 7th in Libra (Aries lagna) makes marriage and partnerships the dark area; asking too much about partner matters brings friction.
Derived: Saturn in 10th in Aries (Capricorn lagna) makes career the dark zone; probing it or boasting about it spoils results.
Derived: Saturn in 4th in Scorpio (Aquarius lagna) makes home and mother the dark zone; prying into family property matters stirs trouble.

ambiguity: 'Dark area' may mean dark in the sense of unknown/hidden, not just bad.
classical_check: Saturn aspects 3rd, 7th, 10th classically; the 'do not probe' advice is his own.

gist: Describes a person who keeps crying about how to pay next month's instalment, repeating the worry.

hindi: उसके शरीर शनि के पास सारे नर्व्स है
says: In the body, Saturn holds all the nerves; nerve system is Saturn's territory.
classical_check: Classical texts give Saturn nerves, sinews, bones and joints; agrees.

hindi: स्नायु रोग आपकी नसे कमजोर कर देगा अधरंग ये देता है पैरालिसिस ये देता है
says: A bad Saturn weakens the nerves and can give nerve disorders, hemiplegia and paralysis. Medical outcome recorded as his tradition claim only, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Adhrang' is half-body paralysis; he does not say which houses or signs trigger it.
classical_check: Classical texts link afflicted Saturn to paralysis and vata disorders; agrees.

hindi: हड्डियां खराब ये करता है हिप बोन हिप बोन से नीचे के सारे रोग देता है
says: Afflicted Saturn damages bones, specifically the hip bone and all ailments from the hip downward (legs). Recorded as tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Classical: Saturn rules bones and legs; the hip cut-off is his own framing.

hindi: स्पाइनल इंजरी देता है स्पाइनल कॉर्ड में प्रॉब्लम देगा
says: Saturn can give spinal injury and spinal cord problems when afflicted. Tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Classical texts mention Saturn for bones and back; spinal cord specifically is a modern gloss.

hindi: आंख के अंदर ऑप्टिकल वेन ऑप्टिकल नर्व वीक कर देता है
says: Saturn weakens the optic nerve inside the eye. Tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Classical texts give eyes to Sun/Moon and 2nd/12th houses; Saturn-optic nerve is his nerve-based extension.

gist: Quips that Saturn's aspect is fun, like a cannon that will fire.

hindi: शनि की दूसरे घर पर दृष्टि है बंदे को बोल दो तेरी ऑप्टिकल वेन में प्रॉब्लम है वो चरण धोने लग जाएगा
says: If Saturn aspects the 2nd house (the eye/face house), you can tell the native he has an optic-nerve problem and he will be astonished by the accuracy.
cells_derived_method: Saturn reaches the 2nd by 7th aspect from the 8th, by 3rd aspect from the 12th, or by 10th aspect from the 5th. The lagna and the 2nd-house sign change which eye-linked sign is hit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in 8th in Aquarius (Cancer lagna) aspects the 2nd house Leo by 7th aspect; Leo is the Sun's sign, so the nerve-weakness reading falls on the right eye or face.
Derived: Saturn in 12th in Capricorn (Aquarius lagna) aspects the 2nd house Pisces by 3rd aspect; the 12th and 2nd together touch both eyes.
Derived: Saturn exalted in 5th in Libra (Gemini lagna) aspects the 2nd Cancer by 10th aspect; the Moon-ruled sign gets a strong Saturn gaze on the eye and face.

ambiguity: 'Yahan par' could also mean Saturn sitting in the 2nd, not aspecting it; he says drishti so aspect is taken.
classical_check: Classical: 2nd house is the face and right eye; agrees on the house, the optic-nerve link is his.

hindi: क्या आपको पता कैसे भाई साहब एक पर शनि की दृष्टि है एक पर नहीं उसकी एक आंख में स्फेरिकल विजन होगी एक में सिलेंडरकल
says: If Saturn aspects one eye-house but not the other, the two eyes differ: one eye has a spherical power and the other a cylindrical power. This is how he explains his prediction.
cells_derived_method: Right eye is the 2nd house and left eye the 12th. Which houses Saturn aspects depends on its position; the sign in the aspected house shows which eye is the weak one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in 8th in Taurus (Scorpio lagna) aspects the 2nd (Sagittarius) by 7th aspect and not the 12th (Libra); only the right eye is affected.
Derived: Saturn in 10th in Pisces (Sagittarius lagna) aspects the 12th (Scorpio) by 3rd aspect and not the 2nd (Capricorn); only the left eye is affected.

ambiguity: He does not say which two houses are the eye houses; 2nd and 12th are assumed.
classical_check: Classical: 2nd right eye, 12th left eye; agrees. Spherical versus cylindrical power is a modern optical term, not classical.

gist: Says even the doctor will fold his hands in respect at the accuracy.

hindi: क्योंकि शनि महाराज ने ब्लैक करना ही है ग्लूकोमा इसके पास है
says: Saturn is the one who blacks things out, so glaucoma-type vision loss is among his gifts; he links Saturn's darkness to loss of sight. Medical claim recorded as tradition, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Caption 'black' may refer to blackout or to the planet's colour.
classical_check: Saturn as darkness is classical; glaucoma is a modern disease label.

hindi: शनि कौन है सूर्य का बेटा
says: Saturn is the son of the Sun.
classical_check: Puranic: Shani is the son of Surya; agrees.

hindi: शनि प्रसन्न रखो अपने बेटे प्रसन्न रखो बेटों का खून ना पियो
says: Remedy: keep Saturn pleased by keeping your own sons happy and not draining them (do not torment or exploit your sons).
ambiguity: 'Bete' is plural sons; for a daughter-only family it is unclear whether children in general are meant.
classical_check: Silent; putra-karaka is Jupiter classically, his link is via Saturn being the Sun's son.

hindi: आपका शनि ठीक हो जाएगा उसका ध्यान दो प्रेम करो शांति लो
says: If you give your son attention and love, and take peace in it, your Saturn will become fine.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और यह सोचो वो आपकी सेवा करेगा नेवर आप पिता होने के नाते अपने पुत्र को प्रेम कर रहे हैं बेटा अपने बेटे को करेगा
says: Do not expect your son to serve you in return; as a father you love your son, and your son will in turn love his own son. Love passes down the generations, not back up.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य के सामने शनि गायब लेकिन शनि का वजूद बाप की वजह से ही है
says: Before the Sun, Saturn vanishes (Sun overpowers him), yet Saturn exists only because of his father the Sun.
ambiguity: Could be about combustion (Saturn near Sun) or just a mythic statement.
classical_check: Sun and Saturn are mutual enemies classically; combustion orb applies. His mythic framing is not a rule.

hindi: इसलिए पिता का भी आदर बच्चा नहीं करेगा तो वो भी मरा गया उसका सूर्य खराब हो जाएगा
says: If a child does not respect his father, he is finished; his own Sun goes bad. Disrespect to the father spoils the Sun in the child's chart.
ambiguity: 'Mara gaya' is figurative, not a death claim.
classical_check: Sun as father is classical; the behavioural cause is traditional lore.

hindi: और सूर्य कुंडली में यदि खराब कहीं बैठा है तो उस अंग पर चोट मार देगा
says: An afflicted Sun strikes the body part ruled by the house it sits in; the house placement shows which limb or organ gets hurt.
cells_derived_method: Map the Sun's house to the body part of that house (1st head, 2nd face and eyes, 4th chest, 5th stomach, 8th genitals, 12th feet) and the sign's body-part mapping modifies it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: bad Sun (debilitated) in 2nd in Libra (Virgo lagna) hits the face and eyes.
Derived: bad Sun in 4th in Aries (Capricorn lagna) hits the chest and heart area.
Derived: bad Sun in 8th in Leo (Capricorn lagna) hits deep or hidden organs and the lower abdomen.

ambiguity: 'Kharab' is not defined; affliction by Saturn, Rahu or lordship is assumed.
classical_check: Kalapurusha body mapping is classical; the injury-timing claim is his.

hindi: सूर्य के पास किडनी स्टोन होता है हार्ट अटैक होता है हड्डियां होती है आंखें होती है बहुत कुछ है
says: Sun's body significations listed: kidney stones, heart attack, bones, eyes and more. Medical items are tradition claims only.
classical_check: Classical: Sun rules heart, bones, eyes, head; kidney stones is a modern addition not in classical texts.

gist: Says today's focus is mainly Saturn and asks what to do for Saturn issues.

hindi: आप ज्यादा समझाने बैठ गए पत्नी को शनि का सातवें घर पर लिंक है आपको सुनती ही नहीं है
says: You keep explaining at length to your wife and she does not listen to you: Saturn is linked to the 7th house (marriage house), which makes the spouse unresponsive.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's link with the 7th (sitting there, or aspecting it from the 1st, 5th or 10th) makes the spouse hard to influence; the 7th-house sign shows the spouse's style of ignoring.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in 7th in Libra (Aries lagna) gives a stable but cold and slow-to-respond spouse.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in 7th in Aries (Libra lagna) gives a spouse who reacts sharply and ignores advice.
Derived: Saturn in 7th in Capricorn (Cancer lagna) gives a serious, duty-bound spouse who hears only practical words.

ambiguity: The caption starts with a garbled filler word; the speaker is addressing a husband whose wife ignores him.
classical_check: Classical: Saturn in 7th gives delay, coldness, older or serious spouse; not-listening is his gloss.

hindi: जिस लड़के या लड़की के शनि का सातवें घर में लिंक हो गया कि यहां शनि महाराज का लिंक है चाहे दृष्टि है
says: For a boy or a girl alike, 'link' of Saturn with the 7th house counts whether Saturn sits there or only aspects it.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 7th from the 1st (7th aspect), the 5th (3rd aspect) and the 10th (10th aspect) on top of sitting in the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in 1st in Capricorn (lagna Capricorn) aspects the 7th Cancer by 7th aspect, so the link comes by aspect alone.
Derived: Saturn in 10th in Scorpio (Aquarius lagna) aspects the 7th Leo by 10th aspect.
Derived: Saturn exalted in 5th in Libra (Gemini lagna) aspects the 7th Sagittarius by 3rd aspect.

classical_check: Classical Saturn aspects: 3rd, 7th and 10th; agrees. Lagna 1 aspect to 7th is also classical.

hindi: मजेदार डायलॉग होता है लेडी आती है उसको बोलो हां जी तो आपके पति आपके अनुसार सुनते नहीं है बिल्कुल सही कह रहे आप
says: Consultation line for a woman client with Saturn linked to the 7th: tell her that her husband does not listen to her, and she will confirm it is exactly right.
cells_derived_method: Same as the Saturn-7th link; for a female chart the 7th shows the husband, and Saturn's link makes him unresponsive.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in 7th in Gemini (Sagittarius lagna) gives a husband who hears but argues and intellectualises.
Derived: Saturn in 7th in Scorpio (Taurus lagna) gives a secretive husband who hears but never answers.

ambiguity: Presented as a conversational trick; no condition on Saturn's dignity is stated.
classical_check: Silent on this specific line.

gist: Doctor-uncle joke continues, then a skit of a wife asking husband to read Gita and he asks for beer; wife says she will drink beer too and he refuses.

hindi: आप जो चाहते हो वो उसको उल्टा चाहेगा इसलिए आपको उल्टा चाहना सीखना है
says: With a Saturn-linked partner, whatever you want he wants the opposite; so you must learn to want the opposite of what you really want.
ambiguity: Whether this applies only to the 7th-house link or to every Saturn-affected relationship is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पति वही चाहेगा जो आप चाहते हो इसे रिवर्स साइकोलॉजी कहते हैं
says: When you deliberately express the opposite wish, the husband ends up wanting what you actually wanted; he names this reverse psychology. He says how to train the wanting comes next week.
ambiguity: Garbled opening about how to want next week, taken as a teaser for a later session.
classical_check: Silent; it is a behavioural trick, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: आपने अपने बच्चे के साथ ऑब्जर्व करना है लाइफ में कुछ लोग ऐसे हैं कि मेरे से उल्टा ही चलते हैं
says: Observe your child, and the people around you: in every life there are people who always run opposite to you. These contrary people are the sign of the Saturn pattern.
ambiguity: He does not say Saturn in this sentence; the link is from the context of the lecture.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मैं काम करने ऑफिस में गया वर्क प्लेस पर गया जो मैं चाहता हूं उसका ही उल्टा होता है तो आपको उल्टा चाहना सीखना है
says: At the workplace too, the outcome is the opposite of what you want; the remedy is the same, learn to want the opposite.
cells_derived_method: Workplace results fall under the 10th house; if Saturn links to the 10th (sitting or aspect) the reverse outcome shows in career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in 10th in Aries (Capricorn lagna) gives sharp reversals at work when you push openly.
Derived: Saturn exalted in 10th in Libra (Cancer lagna) gives slow but steady career where wanting the opposite smooths negotiations.

ambiguity: He speaks of the office but names no house; 10th is my assumption.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके मुन्ना को पता नहीं लगने देना है कितने पैसे जेब में पड़े पता नहीं लगने दिया मुन्ना को
says: Do not let your son know how much money is in your pocket; keep him unaware.
ambiguity: 'Munna' is a pet word for son; it may stand for Saturn-type contrary persons in general.
classical_check: Silent; advice, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: डिस्कशन मत किया करो ज्यादा प्लान मत करो खुद को मत पता लगने दो मुन्ना को कंफ्यूज रखो तो मुन्ना ही कहता है मैं कराऊं पापा मैं कराऊं
says: Do not discuss or plan much, do not reveal yourself, keep the contrary person confused; then he himself volunteers to do the work, asking to do it for you.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके जीवन में आपने खुद ही जिस चीज के बारे में पता किया जहां जहां शनि बैठा वही करेगा बाकी नहीं वो चीजें फ्लॉप हो जाएंगी
says: Matters you yourself inquire about or plan in the area where Saturn sits will flop; only that Saturn-house area reacts this way, others do not.
cells_derived_method: Read the house where Saturn sits as the life area where open planning backfires; sign nature shows how.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in 3rd in Aquarius (Sagittarius lagna) makes announced ventures, writing and short travel flop.
Derived: Saturn in 5th in Capricorn (Scorpio lagna) makes announced investments or exam plans flop.
Derived: Saturn in 9th in Taurus (Capricorn lagna) makes announced pilgrimages and higher-study plans flop.

ambiguity: Caption is run-on; the 'sits' could also include aspect.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Sets up scenario: you are going for a job interview and say 'God, give me the job'.

hindi: यदि शनि का माइनर सा भी इन्फ्लुएंस आ गया और ग्रहों भी काम करेंगे ये यूनिवर्सल रूल है लेकिन कॉमिनेशन पे डिपेंड करता है
says: Even a minor Saturn influence is enough; other planets work the same way. This is a universal rule, but the result depends on the planetary combination.
ambiguity: 'Influence' not defined; could be conjunction, aspect or rulership.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो आप भगवान से प्रार्थना करके जाओगे अब जॉब नहीं लगेगी शनि का नवम भाव पर दृष्टि हो गई मान लो सातवें से
says: If you pray to God and then go to the interview, you will not get the job when Saturn aspects the 9th house (his example: Saturn sitting in the 7th aspecting the 9th). Asking luck from God kills the result.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in 7th casts 3rd aspect on the 9th (fortune house); the 9th is also reached by Saturn from the 3rd (7th aspect) and from the 12th (10th aspect). The 9th-house sign shows what luck fails.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in 7th in Libra (Aries lagna) aspects the 9th Sagittarius; job luck and guru support fail when asked through prayer.
Derived: Saturn in 7th in Cancer (Capricorn lagna) aspects the 9th Pisces; luck is blocked by emotional dependence.

ambiguity: 'Mann lo satve se' read as 'suppose from the 7th'.
classical_check: Saturn 3rd aspect from 7th reaches the 9th; agrees. The prayer claim is his own.

hindi: कमाई होते ही भगवान के मंदिर में जाके मस्जिद में कहीं भी पैसा चढ़ा दिया आपके दिन डाउन हो गए
says: If you offer money at a temple or mosque as soon as you earn it, your fortunes go down (applied to a Saturn-affected native). Donating freshly earned money invites bad days.
ambiguity: Not stated whether this applies only with Saturn on 9th or for all natives.
classical_check: Classical remedy texts prescribe donation (daan) for Saturn, so this contradicts them.

hindi: ऐसे लोग हैं जो कहते हैं यार जब भी माता के दरबार से लौट के आते हैं बुरे दिन शुरू हो जाते हैं
says: He cites people who report that each time they return from the Mother Goddess's shrine, bad days begin.
ambiguity: Anecdotal; no chart condition given.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि वहां जाकर वो मांग आते हैं चीजें ये दिला दे वो दिला दे वो बता दे तो आपने बताया है बोला है चाहे भगवान की मूर्ति को चाहे स्वयं को लेकिन बोल दिया वो काम नहीं होगा
says: The reason is that they ask for things at the shrine; once you tell your wish, whether to the idol or to yourself, that thing will not happen. Verbalising a desire under Saturn blocks it.
ambiguity: Seems to apply only to Saturn-influenced natives, not stated.
classical_check: Silent; contradicts the usual advice of sankalp and prayer.

gist: Says the blind crowds go for years, and that atheists may be those who got their wish on the first ask and never returned.
Grocery-store story: customer keeps going to the shop for black lentils, told to come tomorrow, and the visit becomes a habit even though the lentils never come.
Applies the shop-habit story: people who go to the temple daily are those with troubles in life; sentence cut off at the chunk end.
Continues the dal-shop analogy: God gave yellow lentils but not black, maybe for the good.
Neighbour Gupta ji got black lentils on the first request; the speaker never saw him at the shop or at the temple.
Such a person would return only after a year or two, asking for a new car, and again gets it at once.
Poses the puzzle of why one man gets his wish at the first ask while another struggles, and God keeps giving to some for a whole life.

hindi: उनको मंदिर जाने की जरूरत ही नहीं वो इतने बिजी है उन पर टाइम ही नहीं है ऐसे लोग खाना खाने का टाइम नहीं है
says: The people who are blessed need not go to temples; they are so busy that they have no time even to eat. Abundance of work and commitments is the sign of those whom Saturn favours.
ambiguity: He does not name Saturn; linked by context of workers and busyness.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसा थोड़ी है लोगों को बोरे में नोट रखने का शौक है उन पे जगह ही नहीं है कितने लोग पैसे का हिसाब ही नहीं रखते वो रख पाते ही नहीं ऐसे हालात बन जाते हैं
says: Prosperous people do not keep sacks of cash from hobby; they simply have no space, and many cannot even keep an account of their money. Circumstances become such that wealth outruns record-keeping.
ambiguity: The wealth link to a good Saturn is implied by the next sentence, not stated here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्या आप अपने वर्कर्स को अपने पुत्र को खुश रख पाते हैं आपका शनि मेहरबान हो जाएगा
says: If you can keep your workers and your son happy, your Saturn becomes kind to you.
ambiguity: Contradicted later in this slice, where he says do not try to please workers or son.
classical_check: Classical Saturn remedies include serving servants and the poor; agrees on workers, differs on the son link.

hindi: साथ में राहु केतु इंद्र वरुण यम देगा
says: Along with Saturn, a pleased Saturn-side also brings the favour of Rahu, Ketu, Indra (Uranus), Varuna (Neptune) and Yama (Pluto); the five outer and shadow planets come together with Saturn's goodwill.
ambiguity: Subject of 'dega' is unclear; read as Saturn along with those five giving results.
classical_check: Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are not in classical texts; this is his own 12-planet scheme.

hindi: आप सड़क पर चलते भिखारी से लड़ते हो आप घर में कलह कचहरी मचा लेते हो
says: Fighting with a roadside beggar and creating quarrels and court-like drama at home is behaviour that angers Saturn and its group, so those natives lose Saturn's favour.
ambiguity: Said as an accusation; it is a do-not list implied.
classical_check: Classical: Saturn rules the poor and servants, so harassing them offends him; agrees.

hindi: यह खास तौर से सूर्य शनि का लफड़ा है चंद्रमा और शनि का नहीं है
says: The special conflict is between Sun and Saturn; there is no such conflict between Moon and Saturn.
classical_check: Classical: Sun-Saturn are mutual enemies; Moon treats Saturn as neutral and Saturn treats Moon as enemy; he differs on Moon-Saturn.

hindi: क्योंकि रात के अंधकार में चंदा मामा जबरदस्त चमकते हैं
says: Reason: the Moon shines most brightly in the darkness of night, so Saturn's darkness suits the Moon and does not hurt it.
classical_check: Silent; poetic reasoning.

hindi: शनि अलाव करता है रानी के लिए कि रानी माता जब पापा चले जाएंगे यानी सूर्य देवता राजा चला जाएगा तो आप मेरे अंधकार में चमकोगी
says: Saturn invites the Moon (queen, mother): when father Sun goes away, the king leaves, you will shine in my darkness. Saturn allows the Moon her own time.
ambiguity: 'Alaav' read as 'allows/offers'; caption is noisy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कभी भी हो नहीं सकता कि सूर्य के रहते चंद्रमा चमक जाए भाई सेकंड इन कमांड तो सेकंड इन कमांड ही है बॉस तो बॉस ही है
says: The Moon can never outshine the Sun while the Sun is present; the Moon stays second in command, and the Sun stays the boss.
classical_check: Classical: Sun is king and Moon is queen in the planetary cabinet; agrees.

hindi: तो सूरज के प्रकाश से ही उसे रानी कहा जाता है लेकिन रात के अंधकार में पूर्ण रूप से चंद्रमा अपनी रोशनी बिखेरता है
says: The Moon gets the title of queen only through the Sun's light, yet in night darkness he spreads his own full light; his shining depends on the Sun by day and is independent at night.
classical_check: Classical: the Moon's strength rises with distance from the Sun (paksha bala); agrees in spirit.

hindi: तो चंदा मामा का लफड़ा नहीं है सूरज का लफड़ा है इसलिए माता पुत्र का झंझट नहीं है
says: So the quarrel is not with the Moon, it is with the Sun; therefore there is no friction between mother and son, only between father and son.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए माए बेटों को बड़ा प्यार करती है और बेटे मां के खिलाफ नहीं होते वो चांद को चमकने देते हैं
says: Mothers love their sons greatly and sons do not turn against the mother, because they let the Moon shine. The mother-son bond is free of Saturn's conflict.
classical_check: Silent; a broad generalisation.

hindi: अंधेरा कहता है सूरज को नहीं टिकने दूंगा सूरज कहता है अंधेरे को नहीं टिकने दूंगा अगर उनकी विसिनिटी साथ है
says: Darkness (Saturn) says it will not let the Sun stay, and the Sun says it will not let darkness stay; when the two are in the same vicinity (close together) they fight each other.
cells_derived_method: Sun and Saturn in the same house and sign trigger the strife; the house shows what life area the father-son war hits and the sign shows whose turf it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Saturn together in 4th in Libra (Cancer lagna). Saturn is exalted there. The Sun is debilitated there. They fight at home; the mother's property and the house become the battlefield.
Derived: Sun and Saturn together in 10th in Capricorn (Libra lagna) fight at work; boss versus subordinate friction.
Derived: Sun and Saturn together in 1st in Aquarius (Aquarius lagna) fight inside the self; ego versus discipline.

ambiguity: 'Vicinity' is later narrowed to degrees.
classical_check: Classical: Sun-Saturn conjunction is a bad yoga for father and for the Sun's houses; agrees.

hindi: अगर उनकी डिग्रीज अलग है तो नहीं या चलित में खिसक गए केपी में खिसक गए मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली में खिसक गए इसलिए साथ बैठा देखने से नहीं होगा
says: If their degrees are far apart, or they shift into different houses in the bhava chalit, KP or other chart, the conflict does not occur; merely seeing them sit together in the rashi chart is not enough.
cells_derived_method: Compare their house in D1 with house in bhava chalit and KP; the conflict is real only where both views keep them in one house with close degrees.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun at 2 degrees and Saturn at 28 degrees in 3rd in Gemini (Aquarius lagna) sit together in D1 but far apart in degree, so no strife by his rule.
Derived: Sun at 29 and Saturn at 1 degree of the next house (Capricorn) slip into different houses in bhava chalit; the conflict dissolves.

ambiguity: 'Munna Bhai ki kundli' is a joke for a custom or non-standard chart; likely another chart system.
classical_check: Bhava chalit shifts are classical; the degree-gap test is his emphasis.

hindi: लेकिन ये पिता पुत्र का क्लेश है
says: The Sun-Saturn conflict stands for father-son strife.
classical_check: Classical: Saturn is Sun's son and they are enemies; agrees.

hindi: बाकी कौन है काम करने वाले भी बच्चे के समान है
says: Workers are also like children under the same Saturn logic; employees stand in the son's place.
classical_check: Classical: Saturn is karaka of servants and workers.

hindi: राजा बनना है सूर्य रोशनी देखना पूरा संसार क्लेरिटी होनी चाहिए
says: To be a king, be like the Sun: give light, look at the whole world, and have clarity.
ambiguity: Garbled; the connection to the next sentence is unclear.
classical_check: Classical: Sun is karaka of kingship and clarity; agrees.

hindi: अपने संतान की चिंता करना छोड़ दो मेल पुत्र की चिंता करना छोड़ दो
says: Remedy: stop worrying about your children, especially your male child.
ambiguity: Fifth house is assumed from children; he does not say it.
classical_check: Silent; 5th house governs children classically.

hindi: आप चिंता की वाइब्रेशन भेज रहे हो उसके पास इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक सिग्नल्स जा रहे हैं चिंता के
says: Your worry sends vibrations to the child, like electromagnetic signals, and these signals reach him and affect him; worry itself harms.
ambiguity: Physical claim is not tested.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चिंता मम्मियों को बर्बाद कर देती है अक्सर क्योंकि उन्हें बच्चों की चिंता करनी है
says: Worry often ruins mothers because they have taken on the duty of worrying for their children.
ambiguity: Observation about mothers, not a chart rule; the Moon link is my context guess.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Skit of a mother with nothing left to do, no diapers or school or combing, so she worries for two hours.
Skit continues: after worry the next problem is let me teach him life.

hindi: अब आप उसे जिंदगी सिखा रहे हैं उसके अपने ग्रह उसने अपने आप सीखना है
says: You are trying to teach the child life, but the child has his own planets and must learn by himself; his own chart drives what he learns, not your lecture.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कुछ लोगों की कुंडली में पंचम भाव में यदि मंगल की दृष्टि होगी या मंगल का बैठना होगा उसको खबरदार किसी ने कुछ सिखाया वह आपसे ज्यादा सीखा हुआ निकलेगा इंटूटिव पावर्स देगा लॉटरी गस देगा
says: When Mars aspects or sits in the 5th house, the child already knows more than you; teaching him is useless. Mars gives intuitive powers and lucky guesses even for lotteries. The lottery claim is his only; it is not investment advice.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in 5th in Capricorn (Virgo lagna) gives disciplined, strategic intuition for exams and speculation.
Derived: Mars debilitated in 5th in Cancer (Pisces lagna) gives emotional gut feelings that often misfire; intuition is strong but erratic.
Derived: Mars in 11th in Scorpio (Capricorn lagna) aspects the 5th Taurus by 7th aspect and gives intuition tied to gains and networks.

ambiguity: 'Intuitive' and 'lottery guess' are not defined; only Mars is named.

classical_check: Classical: the 8th and 12th rule hidden diseases; Saturn owning undiagnosed pain is his view.

hindi: वो राहु केतु किसी ना किसी एजेंट से करा रहा है
says: Saturn gets this done through agents such as Rahu and Ketu, one agent or another.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ट्रीटमेंट क्या होगी आपकी ट्रीटमेंट आपकी होगी शनि की एक्सरसाइज क्योंकि पैरों का मालिक है एक्सरसाइज करो दौड़ो भागो मूवमेंट करो
says: Treatment is Saturn's exercise, because he owns the legs: exercise, run about, keep moving.
classical_check: Classical: Saturn rules legs; exercise is a modern remedy; agrees in spirit.

hindi: हैवी एक्सरसाइज करो मंगल की होती है लाइट एक्सरसाइज पैरों के चलने की शनि की है आपको बेस्ट है
says: Heavy exercise belongs to Mars; light exercise, the walking of the legs, is Saturn's and is best for you.
ambiguity: Caption order could attach 'heavy' to Saturn instead; the Mars link is taken from the ending.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चंद्रमा सेट करता है जो रात के अंधेरे में हटता है चंद्रमा के पास योगा है सूर्य के पास नेचुरोपैथी योगा करो आपके शनि में रिलीफ आएगा लचीलापन सेट करेगा
says: The Moon sets right what clears in night darkness; yoga is the Moon's, naturopathy the Sun's; do yoga and Saturn troubles will ease, as it restores flexibility.
classical_check: Silent; modern mapping.

hindi: वाटर कंटेंट सेट सारी हड्डियों के अंदर पानी हिसाब किताब ये करता है
says: The water content inside all the bones, its balance and accounting, is set by this planet, apparently the Moon.
ambiguity: The subject is unnamed; the Moon is inferred from the water link and preceding lines.
classical_check: Classical: Moon rules body fluids; agrees.

hindi: शनि के पास ही प्रजनन की क्षमता भी है
says: Saturn also holds the capacity for reproduction.
classical_check: Classical: Venus and Mars rule semen and fertility; Saturn rules delay of children; differs.

hindi: यदि शनि आपका पंचम भाव से लिंक है और खराब है तो आपका स्पर्म काउंट डाउन हो जाएगा और लेडी की कंसेप्ट पावर डाउन हो जाएगी इसके लिए भी आपको उपाय चाहिए
says: If Saturn is linked to the 5th house and is afflicted, a man's sperm count goes down and a woman's power to conceive goes down; remedies are needed. Medical claim recorded as tradition only.
cells_derived_method: Saturn links to the 5th by sitting there or aspecting it from the 3rd (3rd aspect), 11th (7th aspect) or 8th (10th aspect); the 5th sign shows how it is afflicted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in 5th in Aries (Sagittarius lagna) is the strongest case, with sharp loss of fertility.
Derived: Saturn in 5th in Capricorn (Virgo lagna) delays conception and gives slow sperm or ovulation trouble.
Derived: Saturn in 8th in Taurus (Libra lagna) aspects the 5th Aquarius by 10th aspect and delays children.

ambiguity: 'Kharab' is not defined; affliction by debilitation or malefic conjunction is assumed.
classical_check: Classical: Saturn in or aspecting the 5th delays or denies children; agrees.

gist: Sentence cut off: a small problem arrived, from the age of 19 Saturn..., with no completion.

hindi: एक्टिवेट होता है किसी व्यक्ति को छोटे तौर पर प्रॉब्लम आ गई 19 के बाद से
says: Saturn's influence switches on in a person's life from about age 19, and from then small problems begin to show up. The subject (Saturn) is implied from the next sentences.
cells_derived_method: none: an age-based trigger that applies to every chart; only the house Saturn links to decides which area gets the problem.
ambiguity: Sentence starts mid-thought; Saturn as subject is inferred from the later words about Saturn's 19 years.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts on a fixed age 19; Saturn maturing around 36 and 'Saturn return' ideas differ.

hindi: यदि य लिंकेज किसी भी घर से अपने अपने अनुसार आ गया वहां अंधकार दे देगा 19 के बाद
says: If Saturn is linked (by sitting, aspect or lordship) to any house in a given chart, that house's matters turn dark and blocked after age 19; which house is hit differs for each native.
cells_derived_method: Take the house Saturn is linked to, use its classical topic, then colour by the sign Saturn occupies: own/exalted sign gives a hard but structured block, debilitated sign gives a heavy block.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer): career and status feel dark and stalled after 19, recognition only after long delay.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries): partnership and marriage matters are slow and dark at first but become stable and disciplined.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra): home peace, mother and property area feel restricted yet durable.

ambiguity: 'Linkage' is not defined here: placement, aspect or lordship all possible.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn afflicting a house harms its significations; the fixed 'after 19' trigger is not classical.

hindi: मुझे 19 साल की उम्र के बाद इस क्षेत्र में वाकई पता नहीं चला यार क्या हो रहा है और शनि के 19 साल की ज से एक्टिव होने के बाद ... तीर तुक्के से ही हो रहा है
says: Most people, he says, cannot explain what happened in their field after age 19; once Saturn is active, life proceeds by trial and error with no clear direction.
cells_derived_method: none: general life-pattern claim, not house or sign specific.
ambiguity: Caption mixes his claim with a remark about 90 percent of listeners relating to it; the percentage is not a measured figure.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये ना मरने देता ना जीने देता ... रोटी से कम हमें कभी भगवान ने छोड़ा नहीं और रोटी से ज्यादा कभी दिया नहीं
says: Saturn's pressure leaves a person in a stuck middle: not dead, not really living; basic bread never goes short but nothing beyond subsistence comes, so no surplus or ownership.
cells_derived_method: none: describes Saturn's general nature of restricted supply.
ambiguity: Speech is figurative, no house stated.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as karaka of scarcity, delay and endurance.

hindi: मालिक तब बनोगे जब आप बाकी लोगों के साथ कलह कचहरी लड़ाई नहीं करोगे आप जब तक दूसरे की लाइफ में इंटरफेयर करते रहोगे ... वर्कर्स संतान घर के मेटल के इक्विपमेंट्स जंग लगा सामान
says: To rise to the owner/boss position Saturn offers, stop quarrelling, litigating and interfering in the lives of Saturn-ruled people and things: workers, children, metal equipment and rusted household goods.
cells_derived_method: none: lists Saturn significations (servants, metal, rust) as things not to harass.
ambiguity: Children as Saturn's matter is unusual (classically Jupiter); he attaches them here in the sense of dependants to be left alone.
classical_check: Differs for children (Jupiter is putra karaka); servants and iron are classical Saturn.

hindi: जब तक आप इन चीजों के पीछे हाथ धो केर पड़े रहोगे आपको खुद नौकर नहीं मिलेंगे आप खुद नौकरों की तरह काम करते रहोगे
says: If you keep hounding Saturn's people and things you will not get servants or subordinates and will end up working like a servant yourself.
cells_derived_method: none: consequence statement for Saturn significations.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Saturn as servant karaka.

hindi: आपको मालिक कैसे बनना है उसके लिए आपको इन सबका सम्मान करना है फालतू में चीजें नहीं देनी
says: To become a master, respect workers and dependants as they are, and do not hand them unnecessary gifts or favours.
classical_check: Silent; behaviour advice.

hindi: खुश करने की कोशिश नहीं करता शनि किसी को ना अपने बेटे को खुश करने के चक्कर में रहो ना अपने वर्कर्स को ... ड्यूटी निभाओ काम खत्म
says: Saturn never tries to please anyone, so do not try to please your son or workers; just do your duty and finish the work.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn's dutiful, unsentimental nature.

hindi: लल्लो चप्प करके मक्खन मलाई का काम करते हैं य सब शुक्र यूरेनस का है और किसी का नहीं है
says: Flattery and buttering up people belongs to Venus and Uranus, not to Saturn; Saturn pays no such attention.
ambiguity: Uranus as a flattery planet is his own scheme.
classical_check: Venus as charm agrees; Uranus is outside classical texts.

gist: Giving the boss a liquor bottle does not buy him; he drinks it and it is gone, what counts is the feeling behind it.

hindi: आपके जीवन में कहीं ना कहीं ब्लॉकेज है ऐसा है जो अंधकार सा रहता है वहां क्या करो अर्जुन बनो पीछे छोड़ो खत्म करो नीलम पहनो
says: Where a person senses a dark, blocked area in life, act like Arjuna: focus, leave it behind and finish it, and wear blue sapphire (Saturn's gem) to deal with it.
cells_derived_method: none: the blocked area is whichever house Saturn links to; remedy is generic sapphire.
ambiguity: Arjuna reference is metaphor for single-pointed effort.
classical_check: Sapphire for Saturn is classical, though classical texts caution testing first.

hindi: कितना नीला कितना साफ ये शनि के डिग्रीज पर डिपेंड करेगा उसकी प्रेजेंस प डिपेंड करेगा
says: How deep and how clear the blue of the sapphire should be depends on Saturn's degrees and strength of presence in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Stone shade follows Saturn's degree and strength: a strong, high-degree Saturn takes lighter, softer stone; a weak one a deeper blue.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign in the 10th (lagna Aries) is strong, so a lighter blue stone is enough.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus) is weak, so a deeper-colour stone might be needed, still tested carefully.

ambiguity: He gives no degree thresholds.
classical_check: Silent on shade-by-degree.

hindi: आपको पीला नीला तो नहीं चाहिए सफेद नीला तो नहीं चाहिए लाइट नीला तो नहीं चाहिए यह आपको एक्सपीरियंस के साथ आएगा ये बहुत लंबे टाइम की बात है
says: Whether you need yellowish, whitish or light blue is a judgement that comes only with long experience, not a quick rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वक्री है नीलम पहन लो अस्त है चांसेस है नीलम के द्वारा हेल्प होगी लेकिन हो सकता है अस्त होने की हमें जरूरत हो
says: If Saturn is retrograde, sapphire is fine; if it is combust there is a chance sapphire helps, but the combustion itself may be what we need.
cells_derived_method: none: condition of Saturn (retrograde, combust) not tied to a house or sign.
ambiguity: Retrograde clause starts at end of the previous caption chunk.
classical_check: Classical texts treat combust planets as weak and needing support; he reverses that for malefics.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे ग्रह जो अस्त है तो अच्छा ही है यदि बुरा ग्रह अस्त हो गया है सूर्य के प्रभाव में तो बहुत अच्छा भैया उसे मत छेड़ो उसे कुछ मत करो
says: A bad planet that is combust, under the Sun's influence, is a good thing; leave it alone and do not give it a gem or other remedy.
ambiguity: Which planets count as bad is not specified; context is Saturn.
classical_check: Differs: classical view says combustion weakens a planet and its results; he treats weakening a malefic as a benefit.

hindi: शनि की राशि हम 10 नंबर लेते हैं 11 उसी की है लेकिन वो यमराज की है तो प्लूटो के हिसाब से होगा
says: For sapphire he counts only Saturn's sign number 10 (Capricorn); sign 11 (Aquarius) is also Saturn's but he assigns it to Yamraj (Pluto), so it will be treated later in the Pluto class.
cells_derived_method: none: a definition of sign ownership in his scheme.
ambiguity: Sign numbers 10 and 11 read as sign numbers (Aries=1), consistent with the series.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Aquarius to Saturn; Pluto lordship of Aquarius is his scheme.

hindi: शनि महाराज की 10 नंबर राशि यदि यहां है यहां है या यहां है ... तो आपके लिए नीलम पहनना वर्जित है
says: If Saturn's sign Capricorn (number 10) falls in one of three specific houses of the chart (he points at the diagram), the native is forbidden from wearing sapphire. The houses are only gestured at in the caption.
cells_derived_method: Capricorn lagna-relative house decides the ban: the same sign sits in different houses for different lagnas, so the ban applies to the lagnas that place Capricorn in the three pointed houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 8th (lagna Gemini): this kind of chart falls in the sapphire-ban pattern if 8th is one of the pointed houses.
Derived: Capricorn in the 12th (lagna Aquarius): sapphire would be questionable if the 12th is among the pointed houses.

ambiguity: The three houses are not named in the caption; he later hints at the 8th and 3rd (8th from 8th). Cannot fix them.
classical_check: Silent; classical gem rules ban sapphire for lords of 6/8/12 but his list is different.

hindi: तीसरा यह आठवे घ से आठवा है मृत्यु की मृत्यु इस प्रकार मान के चले तो ये इसके लिए भी शायद नीलम पहनाना वर्जित किया जाए यह सिर्फ आउट ऑफ एक्सपीरियंस होगा
says: The third forbidden place is the 3rd house, being 8th from the 8th (death of death); sapphire may also be barred when Saturn's sign falls there, though he admits this comes only from experience.
cells_derived_method: Using 8th-from-8th logic, the 3rd house is a house of ending of endings; sapphire there may be unsuitable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 3rd (lagna Scorpio): sapphire is suspect by his 8th-from-8th logic.

ambiguity: Which of the gestured houses is the 'third' is inferred; the other two are not stated; 'यह' may refer to the 3rd house (8th from 8th = 3rd).
classical_check: Classical texts call the 3rd an upachaya growth house, so the ban there is his own reasoning.

gist: Munna Bhai example: suppose 8 is the number so 10 falls here and 11 there; gestures to diagram, caption cannot be resolved (continues in the next chunk).

hindi: य 7/8 भी हो सकता है 11 ब 12 भी हो सकता है बहुत कुछ है उससे कोई लेना देना नहीं
says: A house can be touched by two signs (7/8, 11/12 as examples), so the number he points at may be one of two signs; for this explanation he ignores those other possibilities to keep it simple.
cells_derived_method: none: a remark on multi-sign houses.
ambiguity: Could be read as house numbers or sign numbers.
classical_check: Agrees with multi-sign house idea in bhava chalit; classical D1 gives one sign per house.

hindi: मैं नेटिव कुंडली के अंदर मूल कुंडली में जो शुरुआत की कुंडली है उसमें अगर यहां 10 है ... तो आपको प्योर नीलम सूट नहीं करेगा भले शनी वक्री है
says: In the native's original birth chart, if sign 10 (Capricorn) sits in the pointed forbidden place, pure sapphire will not suit, even if Saturn is retrograde; he sets aside the complicated cases for now.
cells_derived_method: Same as the ban rule: Capricorn in the pointed houses removes pure sapphire as a remedy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 8th (lagna Gemini): pure sapphire not recommended; a mixed stone would be sought.
Derived: Capricorn in the 3rd (lagna Scorpio): same, pure sapphire avoided.

ambiguity: Which houses are 'here' is not captioned.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: करेक्शन करनी है इंपॉसिबल है अब इलाज क्या करें इसका बड़ा मुश्किल है तो हमें दूसरा उसका सपोर्टिंग प्लेनेट देखना है शुक्र है बृहस्पति है
says: When sapphire cannot be used the cure is hard; look instead for a supporting planet of Saturn such as Venus or Jupiter and work through it.
cells_derived_method: none: choose between Venus and Jupiter by their relation to Saturn in the chart.
classical_check: Silent; supporting-planet gems are not classical practice.

hindi: हमें ब्लू शेड का सफेद पुखराज पीला पुखराज ऐसे पहनना है नीलम की छटाक लेनी है
says: The workaround is a stone with a blue shade: white topaz or yellow sapphire with just a pinch of blue sapphire in the mix, not a full sapphire.
ambiguity: White topaz (Venus) and yellow sapphire (Jupiter) as 'pukhraj' are both mentioned.
classical_check: Silent; mixed gem settings are modern practice.

hindi: जब तक हम कॉमिनेशन नहीं समझेंगे कि बृहस्पति शनि का कैसे है शुक्र शनि कैसे है सूर्य शनि कैसे तब तक हम ये बता नहीं सकते ना समझा सकते
says: Gem advice cannot be given until the combinations are understood: how Jupiter-Saturn, Venus-Saturn and Sun-Saturn relate in the chart; that will come in later classes.
classical_check: Agrees that conjunction and aspect combos matter; no specific text.

hindi: लेकिन मुद्दा है कि नीलम चाहिए तो ब्लू शेड मिक्स करके लाइट लेनी पड़ेगी
says: If sapphire is needed at all in such a chart, it must be taken light, mixed with blue shades, not pure strong sapphire.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे लोग आते हैं ... इतना पावरफुल नीलम पहन आते हैं कि पांच किलो के आटे की बोरी में 10 किलो आटा डाल दिया और वो नीलम उनको फायदे के साथ-साथ नुकसान जरूर करता है
says: Some people wear an over-powerful sapphire, like stuffing 10 kg of flour into a 5 kg sack; it gives both benefit and harm. Gem strength must match what the chart can hold.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with caution about strong gems.

hindi: हर समय दूसरे प्लेनेट का सपोर्ट लेते हैं वास्तु में भी एक जोन बना होता है उसके साथ वाला जोन उसका सपोर्टिंग जोन होता है उसके दम पर चलता है
says: Always take another planet's support when remedying; the same holds in vastu, where each zone has a neighbouring zone that supports it and it runs on that support.
cells_derived_method: none: general design principle linking planets and vastu zones.
ambiguity: Which zone supports which is not named.
classical_check: Vastu link is his own; silent in classical Jyotish.

hindi: इसीलिए बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है कि नीलम यह सोच के विचार के पहने कि यहां है तो नहीं
says: So it is very important to wear sapphire only after checking whether Saturn's sign falls in the forbidden places; do not wear it without that check.
ambiguity: 'Here' refers to the gestured forbidden houses.
classical_check: Agrees with testing before wearing sapphire.

gist: Recently saw a child's chart whose Moon is debilitated here; audience member says it is his son; sponsor talk.
Wear a blue shirt, it is called a swag shirt, say it like that; banter about the sponsor giving 2000 rupees earlier and now 1100.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा मान लो नीच का है यहां दृष्टि है नीच की अब यह कहा जाता है यहां चंद्रमा पड़ा है शनि पड़ा है चंद्रमा के एग्जांपल से बताया जा रहा है क्योंकि बड़ा सौम्य ग्रह है
says: He explains the gem method with a debilitated Moon (a very gentle planet) with Saturn's debilitating influence on it, the example chosen because the Moon is mild.
cells_derived_method: Moon debilitated sits in Scorpio; its house changes with lagna, which changes which life area is weak.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo): mother and mental peace affected.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 10th (lagna Aquarius): public image and career moods unstable.

ambiguity: Sign is inferred from Moon debilitation (Scorpio); caption says only 'here'.
classical_check: Moon debilitated in Scorpio is classical.

gist: Wear a pearl? A pearl worth one lakh is needed, its owner is lying drunk over there; banter.

hindi: यह तरीका है स्टोन पहनाने का कि राशि का मालिक राशि कहां है मालिक कहां पड़ा है ... उच्च का है नशे में लेकिन बिल्कुल होश में है इसके अपने फल पॉजिटिव कर रहा है
says: Method for choosing a stone: look at the sign the planet is in, find that sign's lord, and see where the lord sits. In his example the lord of Moon's sign is exalted: 'drunk' yet fully alert, giving positive results of its own house.
cells_derived_method: Dispositor logic: gem goes to the planet that needs support; examples differ by where the lord sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): strong lord, so its own house results are positive and the Moon is lifted via that house.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo): Moon's sign lord strong in intellect and children house.

ambiguity: Which planet the 'lord exalted' is — he says only 'here'; Mars exalted in Capricorn is inferred from Moon in Scorpio.
classical_check: Dispositor strength is classical; gem choice by it is modern.

hindi: चंद्रमा के उठाने के लिए इस घर को जागृत करना पड़ेगा इसे सोया भाव और जागा भाव कहते हैं यह सोया पड़ा है इसका मालिक यहां है
says: To uplift the Moon, the house where its lord sits must be awakened; houses are called sleeping or awake (soya bhava / jaga bhava), and this one is sleeping because its owner is placed elsewhere.
cells_derived_method: A house is 'awake' when its lord is well placed and active, 'asleep' otherwise; examples differ by house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if the 4th house's lord sits far away it is a sleeping house, so mother and home matters stay inactive.
Derived: a 10th house with its lord away is sleeping, career results delayed.

ambiguity: His exact sleeping/awake test is not fully given; the lord location is only gestured.
classical_check: Soya/jaga bhava appears in some texts as house-lord strength, not identical.

hindi: यह व्यक्ति कभी भी जीवन में अपने कार्य से संतुष्ट नहीं होगा खुश नहीं होगा और मरा मरा महसूस करेगा इसको मोती पहनाओ
says: With this sleeping-house Moon, the person will never be satisfied with their work, will not be happy and will feel lifeless; the advised remedy is a pearl.
cells_derived_method: Dissatisfaction shows in the area of the house holding the Moon.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in the 6th (lagna Gemini): dissatisfaction in service and daily work.
Derived: Moon debilitated in the 10th (lagna Aquarius): never satisfied with profession.

ambiguity: No health or medical implication taken from 'feel dead'.
classical_check: Pearl for Moon is classical; pearl for debilitated Moon with sleeping lord is his logic.

hindi: मल्टीपल कारण बनते हैं लेकिन यह मोती पहनने मात्र से इसका यह प्लेनेट यह घर भी बहुत शानदार हो जाएगा यहां प्रॉब्लम आएगी
says: Several causes can be at work, but in his Moon example wearing a pearl alone can make the Moon and its house excellent; he adds that problems would still show up in the connected house if the pearl is skipped.
cells_derived_method: The house holding the weak Moon is the one that improves with a pearl; which life area that is changes with the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon in the 4th (lagna Leo): pearl would be aimed at mother, home and peace of mind.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 10th (lagna Aquarius): pearl would be aimed at career steadiness.

ambiguity: Caption does not say which house is meant by 'here'; sign Scorpio is carried over from the Moon debilitation example.
classical_check: Pearl for the Moon is classical; the guarantee of excellence is his claim.

gist: Caption music marker [संगीत] in the middle of the sentence.

hindi: इसके बाएं पैर के अंगूठे में डिपेंडिंग अपॉन मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली कौन सी राशि घुमा रही है लाल धागा डाल दो
says: Tie a red thread on the left big toe; which sign is driving the problem depends on the example native's chart, and the thread goes in accordance with that sign.
cells_derived_method: The sign that rotates (rules) the problem house in the chart decides whether red thread is the match; example differs by sign nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars-ruled Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries) fits a red thread, the colour of Mars.
Derived: Mars-ruled Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius) also fits a red thread.

ambiguity: Which sign 'rotates' the toe is not resolved in the caption.
classical_check: Silent; red thread on foot is folk remedy.

hindi: लाल धागा यहां के करेक्शन कर देगा लाल धागा यहां पांच नंबर राशि है करेक्शन कर देगा
says: The red thread corrects the spot in the chart he points at; he adds that where sign number 5 (Leo) is placed, the red thread will correct that too.
cells_derived_method: Leo (sign 5) lands in different houses depending on lagna; red thread corrects the area of that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in the 1st (lagna Leo): red thread works on self, vitality and confidence.
Derived: Leo in the 7th (lagna Aquarius): red thread works on partnership matters.

ambiguity: 'Five number' could be sign 5 (Leo) or house 5; he says rashi so Leo is taken.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: श्रेयस करें ऑटोमेटिक ये प्रोटेक्शन हो गई
says: The red thread is beneficial and gives protection automatically once worn.
ambiguity: Garbled start; 'shreyas kare' read as 'is beneficial'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके गले की सेंसिटिविटी रहेगी ... इस स्नोफिल काउंट ज्यादा बढ़ा रहेगा डब्ल्यूबीसी डाउन रहेगा इम्युनिटी डाउन रहेगी आयरन डेफिशियेंसी फेरोटिन आयरन होता है उसकी प्रॉब्लम पड़ेगी
says: For the weak-Moon example he lists throat sensitivity, raised eosinophils, low WBC, low immunity and iron or ferritin deficiency. This is a medical claim recorded only as what he said; it is not a diagnosis and must not be used as one.
ambiguity: Link to a specific planet or house is not stated; Saturn-Moon example inferred from context.
classical_check: Moon and Saturn rule blood fluid and immunity loosely in tradition; specific lab values are not classical.

hindi: मल्टीपल चीजें हैं तो एनीहाउ इस तरह से पहनाया जाता है तो हम अगर शनि को इस प्रकार देखते हैं
says: Many factors are involved; in any case this is how stones are assigned, and Saturn is to be examined in the same way.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि इसका मालिक जहां पर भी 10 नंबर अच्छा पड़ा हुआ है इसका मालिक अगर शराब पी के यहां पड़ा हुआ है ... नीलम पहना दो वक्री है नीलम पहना दो अस्त है नीलम पहना दो कैसा नीलम
says: Where sign 10 (Capricorn, owned by Saturn) is well placed, whether its owner Saturn sits 'drunk' somewhere, is retrograde or is combust, sapphire is given; the open question is only which kind of sapphire.
cells_derived_method: Capricorn's house decides the stone details; sapphire suits when Capricorn is not in the forbidden houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): sapphire acceptable, career-focused.
Derived: Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer): sapphire acceptable, stone aimed at partnerships.

ambiguity: Contradicts his earlier advice (1:21) not to touch a combust bad planet; here sapphire is allowed for a combust Saturn.
classical_check: Differs from classical view that combust planet gems need caution.

hindi: यह लफड़ा है लाइट ब्लू डार्क ब्लू कितना पांच सात रत्ती का काफी है
says: The complication is choosing light or dark blue and the weight; about 5 to 7 ratti is enough.
ambiguity: Unit ratti (about 0.9 carat in common usage) not defined by him.
classical_check: Classical rule of thumb for sapphire is 5 to 7 ratti or more; broadly agrees.

hindi: लोग अक्सर कहते हैं आपका वजन 10 किलो है 10 रत्ती का पत्थर पहन लो 100 किलो है 100 रत्ती का पहन लो ऐसे नहीं होता क्वालिटी होती है
says: He rejects the popular rule that stone weight in ratti should equal body weight in kg; what matters is the quality and power of the stone, not weight, so even 4 to 6 ratti can be right.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical weight rule being a rough guide; body-weight rule is folk, not classical.

hindi: आप कितना पावरफुल पत्थर पहन रहे हैं भले ही चार रत्ती का पहन रहे हैं पांच का छह का इसी से महंगा सस्ता है सारा स्यापा ये है कि महंगे उपाय
says: Price differences come from how powerful the stone is, not its carat size; the whole trouble is that good remedies are expensive.
classical_check: Silent on price logic.

gist: Remedies are costly by nature; life-saving medicine and surgery, trips to America or Canada, parties, a child's wedding and education are all expensive, so why would improving your life be cheap.
For a cough take a paracetamol tablet; if it lasts six months go straight for an MRI which costs thousands; people also do an X-ray first, and by the final test time has passed.

hindi: जब आप धन की बलि दे देते हैं आप समय को कमा लेते हैं इसलिए पैसा खर्च में कंजूसी ना करें
says: When you sacrifice money you earn back time, so do not be stingy about spending on remedies. This is a spending recommendation only, not financial or investment advice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो लोग स्वभाव वश ऐसा करते हैं उनका बारहवा भाव डिस्टर्ब होता है इसलिए उनका दोष भी नहीं
says: People who are naturally stingy about spending have a disturbed 12th house (the house of expenses and letting go); it is not really their fault, it is their chart.
cells_derived_method: A disturbed 12th house changes spending behaviour by the sign on it: earth signs hoard, fire signs spend impulsively. Sentence ends in next chunk.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 12th (lagna Aquarius): tight, fearful spending habits.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 12th (lagna Capricorn): expansive spending, stinginess less likely.

ambiguity: Starts at the end of the 1:26 chunk and ends in the 1:27 chunk; 'disturbed' means afflicted, not defined.
classical_check: 12th as house of expenses is classical; stinginess from its affliction is his reading.

hindi: हम सिर्फ यह कहते हैं ग्रह की ट्रीटमेंट कर लो नीलम पहनना मात्र एक बढ़िया उपाय है इसके अतिरिक्त क्या करना है
says: He only says to treat the planet; wearing sapphire is just one good remedy, and he now moves on to what else can be done for Saturn.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि के दोष के कारण यदि आपकी लाइफ में अंधापन आ रहा है यार सूझ ही नहीं रहा क्या करें कहां जाए क्या ना करें तो अंधों की सेवा करो अंधे व्यक्ति को खाना खिलाओ
says: If, because of a Saturn flaw, you feel blind in life, unable to see what to do or where to go, serve blind people and feed a blind person. This is a tradition remedy.
ambiguity: Blindness here is confusion in life, not eyesight.
classical_check: Serving the blind for Saturn is a traditional upaya.

hindi: एक साधारण उपाय अंध विद्यालय में जाओ उनके लिए भोजन भोजन सबसे सादी चीज है
says: A simple version: go to a school for the blind and give them food, which is the simplest offering.
classical_check: Traditional.

hindi: अगर अंध विद्यालय में देते हैं तो विद्यालय का विशेष स्थान पांचवा घर हो गया अब यहां की राशि के विपरीत चीज दी नुकसान करेगा राशि के साथ की चीज दी बहुत बढ़िया
says: A school is a 5th house matter, so what you give there must match the sign on the 5th house: a gift opposite to that sign's nature harms, a gift in tune with the sign is excellent.
cells_derived_method: Choose the gift from the sign on the 5th house: fire signs warm or red items, earth signs grain or clothes, air signs books or learning aids, water signs liquids or sweets.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) suits red or warm items, lentils; a cold or watery gift would oppose it.
Derived: Taurus on the 5th (lagna Capricorn) suits sweets, rice, cloth; a harsh metal item would oppose it.
Derived: Gemini on the 5th (lagna Aquarius) suits books, stationery.

ambiguity: Whether the item should match the sign or the sign's lord is not stated; 5th house as school is his own link.
classical_check: 5th is classically education; matching gifts to its sign is his method.

hindi: इसलिए कौन दुखी है जो ये दान के चक्र में रहता है बिना जाने कौन सुखी है जो करता ही कुछ नहीं कुछ नहीं करता वो ना मंदिर में देता ना गरीब को देता
says: The unhappy are those caught in a donation cycle without knowing what they are doing; the happy are those who do nothing, giving neither to temples nor the poor, so they cause no disturbance.
ambiguity: Said with irony; he is warning against blind donation, not praising inaction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कुछ पंगे ही नहीं वो छेड़ता ही नहीं ग्रह नॉर्मल लाइफ चलती है कॉन्शसनेस से चलता है लाजवाब लाइफ है
says: Someone who never meddles with the planets lives a normal life run by consciousness, and that life is superb; interfering without knowledge is what creates problems.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: खूब दान किया कहीं कर दिया कहां किया पता ही नहीं कोई दोष नहीं लगेगा
says: Someone who gives generously without keeping track of where, with no ego about it, incurs no fault from the donation.
ambiguity: Sentence completes in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees with the tradition that anonymous giving is best.

hindi: नहीं हम तो आज मंदिर गए थे हमने 200 लोगों को खाना खिला दिया सब पता लग गया अगर ग्रह ठीक है बढ़िया नहीं तो नास पिटेगा
says: If you proudly announce your charity (visited the temple, fed 200 people), the result depends on the planet: if the planet is fine it is good, otherwise the effort is ruined.
ambiguity: Which planet is not specified.
classical_check: Silent; tradition holds that charity with display loses merit.

gist: We built a water stall, you sold poison, you will die; sarcastic line about donations gone wrong.

hindi: अगर ग्रह ठीक है तो फायदा नहीं तो नहीं इसलिए सबसे बढ़िया कुछ भी कर दिया चुप पता ही मत लगने दो अंधकार में रखो कोई दोष नहीं है ओनली प्लस सिर्फ फायदा होगा
says: Benefit comes only if the planet is fine; so the best method is to do any remedy quietly and let nobody know, keeping it in the dark, and then there is no fault and only gain.
classical_check: Agrees with secrecy of remedies in tradition.

hindi: सारे वहम गए ऐसी की तैसी में शनि की पूजा जरूर करनी क्या जरूरत पड़ी है यहां से गुप्त रखो पुखराज जरूर पहनना है मत पहनो
says: Drop all superstition; do Saturn puja and wear yellow sapphire if needed, but keep it secret. Caption is mixed on whether yellow sapphire is required.
ambiguity: 'Pukhraj zaroor pehnna hai, mat pehno' is garbled between wear and do not wear; the stable point is secrecy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ना दाढ़ी रखो बढ़िया हो गया हमारा माथा खराब रहता है सिर दर्द रहता है परेशानी बाल सेट रखो गंदगी मत फैलाओ इधर उधर फेंको मत नाखून मत काट के फेंको राहु खराब नहीं होगा
says: For a mind and head that stays troubled (he mentions headache; this is not a diagnosis), keep hair tidy, do not spread dirt, do not throw things about, and do not discard nail clippings carelessly; then Rahu will not be spoiled.
ambiguity: The beard line is garbled; he seems to say keep tidy or no beard.
classical_check: Silent; cleanliness for Rahu is folk practice.

hindi: सिर ढक के रखो चुन्नी लेकर चलो शरीर को इस प्रकार रखो के दिखे ना ज्यादा
says: Keep the head covered, carry a dupatta, and keep the body covered so it is not shown much; this is another Rahu remedy.
ambiguity: Rahu as the subject carried from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ज्यादा चोंच बंद जबान बंद केतु खराब नहीं होगा व्यवहार के अंदर आता है हम बोलते ही रहते हैं बकबक करते रहते हैं बखान करते रहते हैं आपकी लाइफ में कहीं नुकसान नहीं होगा
says: Keep the beak and tongue shut, do not keep talking, chattering and boasting; then Ketu is not spoiled and there will be no loss in life. This is behaviour-based Ketu care.
classical_check: Silent; silence for Ketu is a common tradition.

hindi: मल्टीपल वेज है चक्कर सारा यही है
says: There are multiple routes to remedying one planet (gem, service, behaviour); that is the whole point he is making.
classical_check: Agrees with multiple upaya types in tradition.

gist: Ramdev Baba says give up samosa and kachori, wake at 5, juice by 7, yoga all day, lights off at 8; people recover there for a month, return, eat samosa and fall ill again.

hindi: फ्री के उपाय से ठीक होना कौन चाहता है ... खर्चा करो या धन पर डाल दो तन पर डाल दो मन पर डाल दो हाय हाय तो मत करो
says: No one wants a free cure, so pay for the remedy in money, body or mind, whichever you choose, but do not complain; some cost has to be borne.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए उपाय बहुत श्रेयस कर है सबसे जरूरी क्या है कि आपके शनि के लिए अंधों की सेवा हो
says: Remedies are very beneficial, and the most important one for Saturn is service of the blind.
classical_check: Traditional Saturn upaya.

hindi: अंधे कौन-कौन है जिनकी आंखें नहीं है वो तो गए फिजिकल अंधे ऐसे अंधे हैं जिन्ह पता ही नहीं
says: Blind people include the physically blind, but also those who do not know the way, who are blind in another sense; both count for Saturn service.
ambiguity: Sentence runs across chunk boundary.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब कई अंधे हैं गुरु का कार्य क्या गुरु के पास अंधे आते हैं सारे अंधा कौन है गुरु जी मुझे राह दिखाओ गुरु राह दिखा देगा
says: Many are blind in the sense of lacking direction; the guru's job is to show the way, since all such seekers come to the guru saying show me the path.
ambiguity: Guru here is both teacher and Jupiter.
classical_check: Agrees with Jupiter as guru karaka.

hindi: गुरु के पीछे पीछे चल रहा है ना शनि अंतरिक्ष में उसके आकर्षण में खींच करके तो सूर्य से भी बचा रहा है ताकि सूर्य ना खा जाए बृहस्पति को
says: Saturn follows behind Jupiter in space, pulling it by attraction and shielding it from the Sun so that the Sun does not swallow Jupiter; he uses this to show Saturn as the guru's protector.
ambiguity: A symbolic astronomy claim, not literally accurate orbital physics.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn and Jupiter as a pair is classical, this image is his own.

gist: A blind seeker who tries to teach the guru will get beaten or be trapped and die; the guru throws him far away; tale of the arrogant disciple.

hindi: आपके पास ऐसे ऐसे लोग होंगे जिनको आप शिक्षा नहीं कर रहे उनको सड़क पार करा रहे हैं एक छोटा बच्चा है आप उसे सड़क ही पार करा रहे हैं ... आपको परवाह नहीं है मतलब शनि सेट है
says: Saturn service means helping people without trying to teach them, like walking a small child across the road without caring whether he learns; if you do this without attachment, Saturn is set right.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपने कर दिया बेटा सीख जाएगा समय तो फिर हम बच्चों को ना सिखाए अनाथ बच्चों को कोई नहीं सिखाता अंधों की जिंदगी में आपने देखा होगा अंधों के एक्सीडेंट होते हैं हमने तो
says: Just do the help and the child will learn in time; he points out that orphans and blind people are the ones nobody teaches, and blind people have accidents, so helping them has real need. The sentence is cut at the chunk end.
ambiguity: Last words 'हमने तो' are cut off; continues in the next batch.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सारी दुनिया भर में अंधे घूम रहे सड़क पर ... अंधा लाठी लेकर चल रहा है कैसे चलता फिरता है कोई मरता नहीं कटता नहीं वह छटी इंद्रिय कार्य करती है और वो सड़क भी पार करते हैं
says: Blind people walk the roads with a stick and rarely come to harm; he says a sixth sense works for them, and presents this as the working of Saturn's protection in darkness.
ambiguity: The link to Saturn is made explicitly a few sentences later.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as significator of the blind and handicapped is traditional.

hindi: सारा दिन जीते हमें खबर ही नहीं पता अंधो के साथ क्या हो रहा है लेकिन जिंदगी चल रही है अंधे लड़के लड़किया खूब जीते हैं बढ़िया से यह शनि की कृपा है
says: Blind boys and girls live full, good lives and we do not even notice what they go through; this smooth running of life without sight is Saturn's grace.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि के पास सबसे बड़े संसार देवता का स्थान है वेस्ट का डायरेक्शन शनि का होता है
says: Saturn holds the seat of the greatest worldly deity, and in vastu the West direction belongs to Saturn.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-direction link; house mapping of West depends on the chart's lagna orientation, which he does not give.
