gist: In our country there is a big craze for a son; people keep trying, and daughters line up while they chase a son.

hindi: अब वो बेटियां कौन सी है जिनको पसंद नहीं कर रहे माता-पिता आशीर्वाद कौन सा जा रहा है उस बेचारी बच्ची का भी जीवन खराब पितृ तुमसे भी नाराज रहेंगे तुम्हारा बेटा भी तुम्हें डंडे मारेगा
says: Daughters who are born unwanted carry no blessing from their parents, that poor girl's life is also spoiled, the ancestors (pitrs) stay angry with such parents, and even the son may turn on them. Recorded as a tradition and moral claim.
cells_derived_method: none: a moral and karmic claim about attitude to children, not about a particular house or sign.
ambiguity: Whether this is a prediction or an exhortation is unclear.
classical_check: Pitr dosha is classical; the unwanted-daughter link is his own.

hindi: तुम कहते हो हमने बेटे के लिए इतना किया तीन बार इतना करने के बाद भी वो कित्ता भी नहीं कर रहा कहां से करेगा तुम तो लालच लोभ इंद्र लोभ के द्वारा बच्चा चाहिए
says: Parents complain that after all they did for the son he does nothing back, but a child wanted out of greed and desire (Indra's greed) will not return anything.
ambiguity: Indra is his Uranus; here it stands for greed and desire.
classical_check: Silent; Indra as Uranus is his scheme.

hindi: इंद्र ऑन किया आपने बच्चा क्या करेगा अप्सरा कहां है पापा क्या करेगा और बेटा बेटे यही तो करते हैं बाद में कितने लोग बेटों के कारण परेशान है
says: If you switched on Indra to get the child, the child will go looking for apsaras, and later many parents are troubled by their sons because of that.
ambiguity: A figurative claim; Indra and apsara stand for lust and pleasure seeking.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्यों आपकी शुरुआती कॉन्शसनेस क्या थी बीज आम का था केले का था करेले का था फिर कहते बच्चा अयाश हो गया
says: The nature of the child follows your starting consciousness, like the seed you sowed: mango, banana or bitter gourd; later complaining that the child turned into a debauchee ignores what seed you planted.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वैसा ही घर वास्तु संबंधित मिल जाता है वैसे ही घर के सदस्य बन जाते हैं वैसा ही पति मिल जाता है पत्नी आगे सास बह जोल फलाना डिमका क्योंकि आपका बीज ही आरंभ का ऐसा है
says: The same starting seed gives you the same kind of house and vastu, family members, husband or wife, mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, because the beginning seed of your consciousness was such.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बीज गुप्त होता है धरती के गर्भ में शनि प्लेस हुआ बीज गुप्त गुप्त रखो धन गुप्त रखो
says: A seed is hidden in the womb of the earth, and that is Saturn's placement; so keep things secret, including your wealth. It is a tradition rule on secrecy and not investment advice.
ambiguity: Continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: प्रेम गुप्त रखो शांति गुप्त रखो मन गुप्त रखो हर चीज गुप्त हम पीछे पड़ गए शनि ऑफ हो गया ग्रेविटी टूट गई आपकी लाइफ की बैंड बज गई
says: Keep love, peace and your mind secret; everything should stay hidden, and if we chase and expose, Saturn switches off, gravity breaks and your life falls apart.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: प्रथम संकेत कहीं ना कहीं गुप्त पेन नसों में खिंचाव दर्द तकलीफ कमर कमर से नीचे की प्रॉब्लम इसके लिए बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है कि अपने आप को स्वस्थ रखो
says: The first sign of Saturn going off is hidden pain, pulling and ache in nerves, and trouble in the lower back and below, so stay fit. The body-part signs are his claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Saturn on legs, nerves and lower body matches the tradition (Capricorn knees, Aquarius calves).

hindi: यदि शरीर के अंदर प्रॉब्लम्स है काला कुत्ता पालते हैं लोग वो एक हेल्प करता है
says: If the body has problems, people keep a black dog, which helps as a Saturn remedy; this is a tradition remedy and no medical claim.
classical_check: Black dog for Saturn is traditional.

hindi: ऐसे-ऐसे लोग हैं जिनको संतान लाभ नहीं हो रहा कुत्ता पालने मात्र से संतान हो जाता है बड़ा अजीब टोटका है यार यह केतु का है पर काला होगा तो वह शनि आ गया
says: For couples without children, merely keeping a dog is said to bring children, a strange totka; the dog is Ketu's animal but a black one brings in Saturn.
ambiguity: A fertility outcome claim; recorded as a folk remedy, not a guarantee.
classical_check: Dog for Ketu is traditional; the child link is folk.

hindi: आपके घर के सारे धातु का सामान किसी भी हालत के अंदर जंग लगा नहीं होना चाहिए तेल का बिखराव घर में कहीं नहीं होना चाहिए
says: Metal items at home must not be rusted under any condition, and oil must not be spilled or spread anywhere in the house, to keep Saturn happy.
classical_check: Silent; vastu rule.

hindi: कहीं भी ऐसी जगह घर के अंदर नहीं हो जहां लोहा लक्कड़ कूड़ा कबाड़ा सारा कबाड़ सारी स्टोरेज शनि होती है जो गंदे तरीके से रखी है अव्यवस्थित
says: There should be no corner at home holding iron, wood, trash and junk; all storage is Saturn, and storage kept dirty and disorganised harms him.
ambiguity: Continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent; vastu.

hindi: और बे फालतू में भगवान से उन उन चीजों के लिए भीख मत मांगो शनि की यहां दृष्टि है संतान बेटे का मेरा यहां एडमिशन हो जाए वहां एडमिशन हो जाए मत मांगो
says: Do not beg God for specific outcomes in areas Saturn aspects, such as a particular college admission for your son; asking for exact results there does not work.
cells_derived_method: Which areas Saturn's aspect touches depends on its house: aspects 3, 7, 10 from its place.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 3rd in Aquarius (lagna Sagittarius) aspects the 5th, 9th and 12th: children, education and higher study are the begging-prone areas.
Derived: Saturn in the 7th in Libra (lagna Aries) aspects the 9th, 1st and 4th: fortune, self and home matters are stubborn against specific asks.

ambiguity: 'यहां' points at the diagram; the house is probably the 5th (children and school).
classical_check: Saturn's 3rd, 7th, 10th aspects are classical.

hindi: आपके चॉइस के कॉलेज स्कूल में होएगा ही नहीं इसीलिए छोड़ना सीखो यह शनि ग्रह की पावर है
says: Admission in the college or school of your choice will not happen that way, so learn to let go; letting go is Saturn's power.
ambiguity: Not a prediction for any specific child.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience asks about starting sade sati and making a chart; banter about getting ready to leave this world, partying before going, 'we all have to go one day'.

hindi: शनि की साढ़े साती आपके जो जन्म की राशि होती है एक राशि होती है आपकी चंद्रमा की जो जन्म की राशि है
says: Saturn's sade sati is tied to your birth sign, the sign in which the Moon sat at your birth.
cells_derived_method: none: the definition names the Moon sign as the reference point.
ambiguity: Sentence ends in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees: sade sati is counted from the natal Moon sign.

hindi: मान लेते हैं चंद्रमा आपका चार नंबर राशि में यहां बैठा है आपके ह अक्षर से नाम की राशि निकल आती है ह और ड से निकलेगी ह अक्षर से चंद्रमा की चार नंबर की राशि
says: Taking the Moon in sign number 4 (Cancer), the name sign comes out of the first letter of the name: names starting with ha or da give Cancer, the Moon's sign number 4.
cells_derived_method: Name-letter to sign mapping ties the name sign to the Moon sign; example for Cancer only.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer): name sign Cancer matches lagna and Moon.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn): name sign Cancer sits on the partnership house.

ambiguity: The classical name letters for Cancer are Hi Hu He Ho Da Di Du De Do; he says 'ha and da'.
classical_check: Agrees in general (nakshatra pada letters); Ha alone for Cancer is loose.

hindi: पंडित जी ने देखी यह चंद्रमा में होना चाहिए वैसे पर ढैया के लिए बता देते हैं कि चंद्रमा की चार नंबर राशि है बच्चे का नाम ह से रखें आपने छठा ग्रह एक्टिवेट कर दिया है
says: Pandits tell parents the Moon is in sign 4 so the child's name should start with ha; he says that if a dhaiya of Saturn is running, naming the child from the Moon sign activates the sixth planet's trouble.
ambiguity: 'छठा ग्रह' is unclear: possibly Saturn, the 6th planet counted from the Sun, or the 6th-house trouble.
classical_check: Naming from the Moon sign is standard; avoiding it under dhaiya is his own caution.

hindi: चंद्रमा क्या इफेक्ट देगा चंद्रमा की क्लास में करेंगे पंगा डाल दिया यहां होना ही नहीं चाहिए इसका नाम राशि बदल दो इसकी नाम की राशि क से रख दो
says: The Moon's effect will be covered in the Moon class; for now, the name sign should not be the Moon sign during the trouble, so change the name sign, for instance to start with ka.
ambiguity: Ka is classically in Gemini, which is the sign before Cancer.
classical_check: Silent; changing the name sign is a folk upaya.

hindi: व से ब से उ से ई से ऐसे रख दो यह दो नंबर है तीन नंबर है एक नंबर है अ से रख दो च ल अमिताभ बच्चन वगैरह वाली एक नंबर राशि इससे रखो बदलो इसकी राशि बदलो
says: Other letters like va, ba, u and ee give sign 2 (Taurus), ka gives sign 3 (Gemini), and a, cha, la give sign 1 (Aries), the Amitabh Bachchan type name; pick one of these to change the name sign.
ambiguity: The mapping of each letter to a number is spoken loosely.
classical_check: Agrees with the nakshatra-pada letter table: Aries a/chu/che/cho/la, Taurus i/u/e/o/va/vi/vu/ve/vo, Gemini ka/ki/ku/gha/chha/ke/ko/ha.

hindi: पांच सिंह राशि म से रखो ट से रखो यह राशि बदल दो इस राशि को मत रखो अगर आपने नहीं बदली
says: Sign 5, Leo, is given by names from ma and ta; change the name sign to such a letter and avoid keeping the Moon's sign, otherwise the trouble stands.
classical_check: Agrees: Leo name letters are Ma Mi Mu Me Mo Ta Ti Tu Te.

hindi: मान लेते हैं और यहां पर शनि महाराज आ जाते हैं शनि की राशि अंतरिक्ष में गोल गोल घूमते घूमते यहां आ गई चार नंबर का चंद्रमा था ... तीन नंबर में मिथुन राशि का शनि आ गया गोचर में
says: If the name sign was not changed and Saturn, moving through the sky, reaches sign 3 (Gemini) by transit while the Moon is in sign 4 (Cancer), the sign before the Moon sign is entered.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the sign before the Moon sign starts the first phase; the same logic holds for any Moon sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer, Saturn transit in Gemini the 12th from the Moon, start of sade sati with expenses and sleep issues.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio, Saturn transit in Libra the 12th from Moon, start of sade sati.

ambiguity: Cells are houses counted from the Moon, not the lagna.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 12th from the Moon begins sade sati.

hindi: शनि ने यहां आते ही ढाई साल के लिए इसके साथ वाली राशि पर लपक लिया हमेशा साथ वाला जो होता है वह सपोर्ट करता है अब शनि चंद्रमा को सपोर्ट करने आया है
says: When Saturn enters the sign next to the Moon's sign, he stays two and a half years and, as the neighbour, comes to give the Moon support; the adjacent sign always supports.
ambiguity: 'Saath wali rashi' read as the neighbouring sign.
classical_check: Saturn stays about 2.5 years per sign, agrees.

hindi: करेगा तो सही सपोर्ट लेकिन सपोर्ट चाहिए ही नहीं क्योंकि चंद्रमा सौम्य ग्रह यह पानी है इस पर तेल चढ़ा दिया हमने गया काम से तेल निकल गया तो आपके मन के ऊपर डार्कनेस आनी शुरू हो जाएगी कालापन
says: Saturn comes to support, but the Moon, a gentle watery planet, does not need or want it; it is like pouring oil on water. Then darkness and blackness begin to settle on the mind.
ambiguity: Mind is meant in emotional and mental sense; no medical claim.
classical_check: Agrees: sade sati weighs on the mind through the Moon.

hindi: यह कब रुकेगी जब आपके पास गुरु होगा क्योंकि गुरु चंद्रमा की राशि में उच्च का होता है तो बृहस्पति इसलिए गुरु का बड़ा भारी महत्व है
says: The darkness ends when you have a guru, because Jupiter is exalted in the Moon's own sign Cancer; hence the guru has great importance during sade sati.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter exalted in Cancer lifts a Cancer Moon; the house where it falls decides the area helped.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio): fortune and guidance flow.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer): self-confidence and wisdom are strong.

ambiguity: Jupiter exalted in Cancer is correct.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter exalts in Cancer, the Moon's sign.

hindi: कोई ना कोई गुरु जरूर बनाओ और कुछ समय नहीं तो गुरुद्वारे चले जाओ खत्म करो आजकल जो गुरु जी की फोटोग्राफ लगी होती वो लगा लो
says: Make some guru in life; if no time, go to a gurdwara, or simply put up a guru's photograph as is common nowadays; this is a tradition remedy for the sade sati phase.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Banter about the bald guru's photograph and the bhajans sung for him; if no guru, put any photo; 'our own photo won't come out so good, his personality is something'.

hindi: शनि के लिए आपकी साढे सती की पहली ढैया यहां शुरू हो गई ढैया दूसरी ढैया आपकी यहां आएगी जब शनि चार नंबर राशि में आ जाएगा
says: The first dhaiya of the sade sati starts when Saturn is in the sign before the Moon's, and the second dhaiya comes when Saturn enters sign 4, the Moon's own sign Cancer.
cells_derived_method: Second phase is Saturn on the Moon sign, house 1 from the Moon, with any Moon sign alike.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo, Saturn in Leo as phase two, the heaviest on mind and self.
Derived: Moon in Aquarius with Saturn passing over it in Saturn's own sign: phase two is somewhat softened.

ambiguity: Cells are houses counted from the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees with the three phases of sade sati.

hindi: तीसरी ढैया जाती हुई ढैया अब आएगी जब पांच नंबर में शनि आ गया
says: The third dhaiya, the departing one, comes when Saturn moves into sign 5, Leo, the sign after the Moon's Cancer.
cells_derived_method: Third phase is Saturn in the 2nd from the Moon; for each Moon sign it is the next sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Virgo with Saturn in Libra, where Saturn is strong, as the departing phase: a milder exit.
Derived: Moon in Aquarius, Saturn in Pisces as the departing phase, spiritual wrap-up.

ambiguity: Cells are houses from the Moon, not the lagna.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 2nd from the Moon completes sade sati.

hindi: अब यहां ढैया चंद्रमा वक होने के कारण आपकी ऐसी की तैसी कर देगी
says: This departing dhaiya, because the Moon is weak, will wreck your plans; the caption says the Moon is weak, probably meaning a weak Moon makes it harsh.
ambiguity: 'वक' is garbled and may be 'weak' or 'vakri'.
classical_check: A weak Moon worsening sade sati is classical.

hindi: अब मान लेते हैं आपका चंद्रमा यहां कहीं बैठा है आपकी राशि है कोई भी तीन नंबर राशि लगा लो तो शनि यहां आएगा यहां आएगा और यहां तो इसकी साड सती चलेगी
says: Whatever sign the Moon is in, Saturn passes through three consecutive signs around it (the one before, the same, and the one after), and over these three the sade sati runs.
cells_derived_method: Take Saturn through 12th, 1st and 2nd sign from the natal Moon sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini, sade sati with Saturn in Taurus, Gemini and Cancer.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio, sade sati with Saturn in Libra, Scorpio and Sagittarius.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर राशि' read as 'any three consecutive signs'.
classical_check: Agrees.

hindi: अब यह बड़े शुभ स्थानों पर बैठा हुआ है राशियां इसकी तीनों ओके ओके हैं यह तो लाजवाब है यह मित्र की यह थोड़ी दूषित है तो ये जाती हुई ढैया मारेगी
says: Severity depends on the three signs involved: if all three are in good, friendly places the sade sati is fine, even wonderful; if one is a bit spoiled, the departing dhaiya hits hardest.
cells_derived_method: Grade each of the three signs by its friendliness to Saturn and by its house from the lagna; the afflicted one carries the damage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 9th (lagna Taurus), Saturn's own sign in a good house, a gentler phase.
Derived: Aries on the 8th (lagna Virgo), Saturn's debilitation sign in a hard house, a rough phase.

ambiguity: No grading scheme is given.
classical_check: Agrees that the result depends on the signs' quality and house placement.

hindi: तो शनि ने बेसिकली चंद्रमा पर इंपैक्ट डाला है
says: Basically Saturn's sade sati impacts the Moon, the mind and emotions, as the core of what happens.
classical_check: Agrees.

hindi: राम और रावण की कुंडली में राशि नंबर दो ही एक्टिवेट है लेकिन जन्म राशि यदि अलग है मान लो तो कहानी अलग हो गई
says: In Ram's and Ravan's charts the same sign number is active, but if the birth sign (Moon sign) differs the story turns out different; the birth sign decides the outcome of the same transit.
ambiguity: 'राशि नंबर दो' is unclear and may mean two charts share an active sign; caption garbled.
classical_check: Silent; the epic charts are traditional but data differ.

hindi: राम की कर्क राशि का है चंद्रमा चार नंबर का है राम भगवान का अब राम भगवान का चंद्रमा चार नंबर का है यहां शनि बैठा है उनका यहां बृहस्पति और चंद्रमा है अब
says: Lord Ram's birth sign is Cancer, so his Moon is in sign number 4; in his chart Saturn is placed elsewhere while Jupiter and the Moon sit together. The chart reading is cut at the end of the batch.
cells_derived_method: Ram's Moon is in Cancer; Jupiter with it is exalted there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ram's Moon and Jupiter in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer): exalted Jupiter with own-sign Moon.

ambiguity: Saturn's place is only gestured; Ram's Saturn exalted in Libra is traditional but not stated here. Sentence ends at 'अब'.
classical_check: Agrees with the traditional Ram chart: Moon and Jupiter in Cancer, Saturn exalted in Libra.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा एक्टिवेट की हुई है राम की राशि य राम तुला अब राम और रावण को ढैया इकट्ठा आई है फल दोनों का उल्टा क्यों है
says: Continuing the Ram example, he says the Moon is activated by the transit, and Ram and Ravan both had the dhaiya at the same time yet their results were opposite; the garbled words 'Ram ... Tula' probably point at Libra as one sign in play.
ambiguity: The Libra mention is garbled and may refer to Ravan's sign or to Saturn's exaltation sign.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कृष्ण और कंस को भी दोनों को ढैया एक साथ आई हुई है सासती भी एक साथ आई सेम राशि है भाई तो यह ऐसे नहीं चलता जन्म की राशि से चलता है
says: Krishna and Kansa also had the same dhaiya and sade sati at once, in the same sign, yet fared oppositely; so the transit does not act by sign alone but by the individual's birth chart.
cells_derived_method: none: a reason against reading transit results by Moon sign alone.
ambiguity: 'जन्म की राशि से चलता है' is a little contradictory to his own use of the Moon sign; he means the full chart context.
classical_check: Agrees that sade sati results vary by chart; the Moon-sign-only reading is a known weakness.

hindi: मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली में तीन चार नंबर का चंद्रमा तीन में तो नहीं चला गया है य तीन नंबर तो नहीं एक्टिव हो गया है यह पांच में तो नहीं खिसक गया बहुत खिचड़ी है ये
says: In a chart one must check whether a Moon taken as sign 4 has actually slipped into sign 3 or 5; sign boundaries and which sign is active make this a big muddle (khichdi).
cells_derived_method: A Moon near a sign edge can be read in the neighbouring sign and shifts the sade sati phases by one sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if the Moon is really in Gemini, Saturn in Gemini is phase two, not phase one.
Derived: if the Moon is really in Leo, Saturn in Leo is phase two while Cancer-based reading says phase three.

ambiguity: Cells are houses counted from the Moon, since the point is the Moon sign itself.
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon's exact degree affects which sign is used; a standard caution.

gist: Restaurant food is not made at home; we eat out, so the one whose job it is does the work; an analogy for leaving astrology to specialists.
This is only for information and understanding, so those who already know can move ahead; the detailed class comes later.

hindi: आपके राशि आपने चेंज कर दी उस पर इंपैक्ट पड़ता है अदर वाइज ढैया तो लाखों लोगों की आती है
says: If you changed your name sign, the effect falls on that new sign; otherwise the dhaiya of Saturn comes to millions of people at once, so a general dhaiya has no personal effect.
ambiguity: The first half is unclear: it may mean the impact is felt on the changed (name) sign.
classical_check: Name-sign effects are a folk idea; mass transit affecting millions identically is not classical.

hindi: जब शनि महाराज 12 नंबर राशि में आ रहे हैं तो मीन राशि वाले सारे संसार में रोने चाहिए कुंभ राशि वाले रोने चाहिए ऐसा नहीं होता
says: When Saturn enters sign 12 (Pisces), by a blunt sign-based reading all Pisces and Aquarius natives worldwide should cry, but that does not happen, which shows sign-only sade sati is not reliable.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Pisces is the 12th from Aquarius Moon, the 1st from Pisces Moon and the 2nd from Aries Moon.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aquarius, Saturn in Pisces is the first phase.
Derived: Moon in Pisces, Saturn on the Moon, the central phase.
Derived: Moon in Aries, Saturn in Pisces is the departing phase.

ambiguity: He names only Pisces and Aquarius, though Aries Moon also has the third phase.
classical_check: Agrees with sade sati counting; his objection is a critique, not a classical rule.

hindi: यह ढैया बदनाम है भैया शनि चढ़ा हुआ है असल में लोग पंडित
says: The dhaiya has a bad name and people say 'Saturn has mounted me', but in reality it is a name that is defamed more than it is felt; the sentence trails into the next chunk about pandits.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut off at the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: People drink the pandit's blood; a knowledgeable pandit is busy, has crowds of followers, and has no reason to answer everyone.
Recently someone asked a question and paid a fee; he returned it when they demanded an explanation of how they had pitr dosha: 'take your money back, bye'; explains that astrologers get called rude.
He will not teach a full astrology class to each questioner; a pitr class would take two and a half to three hours, and examples of pitr dosha will come later.

hindi: कैसे कस शनि ऑन करना है हमें तो पता करना है ब्लॉक आपका बृहस्पति ऑन नहीं हो पाएगा कभी भी
says: To switch Saturn on we must first find the block; until that block is found your Jupiter will never switch on.
ambiguity: Garbled at the start; the exact meaning of 'block' is inferred as the affliction to Saturn.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि सिर्फ सिर्फ सिर्फ बृहस्पति के आगे अपने क्रूरता और बुरे फल छोड़ता है
says: Saturn gives up his cruelty and bad results only in front of Jupiter, so Jupiter's presence is the one thing that softens him.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-relation rule; Jupiter's conjunction or aspect on Saturn in any house.
ambiguity: Whether this is conjunction, aspect or simply the guru's support is not said.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Jupiter's aspect on Saturn mitigates; 'only' is stronger than classical texts.

hindi: इसीलिए आपको कोई मन का पिता को बना लो गुरु माता को गुरु बना लो कोई फर्क नहीं है हमें एक गुरु चाहिए जिसके कारण बस एक गुरु चाहिए पालने के लिए
says: So take any guru of the heart; even your father or mother can be your guru, it makes no difference, you just need one guru to guide and nurture you.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके अंतर्गत ढैया का बहुत बड़ा वहम भी है और ढैया साक्षात भी है डिपेंड करता है आपकी राशि कहां रोटेट कर रही है आपकी मानसिकता क्या है
says: The dhaiya is partly a big superstition and partly real; whether it hits depends on where your sign is rotating in the chart and on your own mindset.
ambiguity: 'राशि कहां रोटेट' means the sign's placement in the chart (house).
classical_check: Agrees that sade sati results depend on the chart and conduct.

hindi: शनि की ढैया के टाइम सूर्य साथ लेकर चलो तेज सेल्फ कॉन्फिडेंस शनि कुछ बिगाड़े ही नहीं शनि चुपचाप देता ही रहेगा मैं सेवा कर रहा हूं हजूर
says: During Saturn's dhaiya carry the Sun with you, meaning brilliance and self-confidence; then Saturn cannot spoil anything and quietly keeps giving, with the attitude 'I am only serving, sir'.
ambiguity: Whether this means a Sun remedy such as arghya or simply attitude is not spelled out.
classical_check: Silent; Sun and Saturn are classical enemies, so this is an unusual remedy.

hindi: जिस कमरे में आते हैं वहां से भाग के दूसरे में पहुचा लगाई जा हूं मैं राहु केत लेके आपको तंग ना करूंगा क्योंकि राहु के फल देना शुरू कर देता है शनि मार देने के
says: Dramatising Saturn: he runs from room to room saying he will not trouble you with Rahu and Ketu, because when Saturn is troubled he starts handing over Rahu's results, which are the harsh ones.
ambiguity: The mock-dialogue is garbled and the sentence is cut at 'शनि मार देने के'.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as Saturn's agent is a common view.

hindi: अगर शनि को आपने परेशान किया पता किया पता किया सिखा रहे हैं सिखा रहे हैं क्लेश हो जाएगा मुंडी मुंडी का संबंध रहेगा शरीर खत्म केतु का फल शुरू हो जाता है
says: If you keep pestering Saturn by questioning and teaching, strife arises; the relationship stays head to head (talk only), physical closeness ends, and Ketu's results begin.
ambiguity: 'Mundi mundi' means only the heads, i.e. mental or verbal contact.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक दूसरे को सुनने बोलने बहस करने की जरूरत नहीं साथी बन के साथ चल रहे हैं जैसे ही आप उसको गुप्त रखते हैं इसलिए गुप्त का बहुत महत्व है
says: There is no need to keep hearing, talking and arguing with each other; walk together as companions, and the moment you keep things secret the bond holds, hence secrecy is very important.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप नाजायज भी गलती से कुछ कर दे नाजायज संबंध भी बना दें से भी गुप्त रखो भैया
says: Even if you did something improper by mistake, even an illicit relationship, he says keep it secret; this is his claim on secrecy under Saturn and not an ethical or legal endorsement.
ambiguity: Reads as practical counsel, ethically contestable; recorded as stated.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A girl came about ten years ago saying she would marry only a boy she could tell about her earlier illness; he told her not to tell, she did, and seven years into marriage she is heading for divorce as her husband says she was ill before.

hindi: तेरे को पोस्टर छाप के बड़े सत्यवादी बनना था गुप्त पास्ट को भुला दो मुन्ना को पंगे मत दो
says: Do not announce your past like a poster to look truthful; keep the secret past forgotten and do not hand people trouble. This follows the girl story; the past illness is not given as a medical point, only that disclosing breeds divorce.
cells_derived_method: none: the marriage consequence ties it to the 7th house in general.
ambiguity: Ethically contested advice and generalised from one anecdote.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: We speak in different languages; remark that he and the listener talk at cross purposes, then onto the next point.

hindi: सबसे बड़ी बात शनि गुप्त लोगों की एक बहुत बड़ी भ्रांति बहुत बड़ी प्रॉब्लम बहुत बड़ा कंफ्यूजन है कि हमारे को जब शनि पीटता है न्याय का देवता पीटना शुरू करता है करेक्शन करता है
says: The biggest confusion people have is that when Saturn beats us, the god of justice starting to hit us is really his way of correcting us.
ambiguity: Sentence runs from the 1:47 chunk into the 1:48 chunk.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn as karmic corrector.

hindi: प्रेम खत्म कर देता है और अंधकार में आ जाता है रिश्ता पता ही नहीं क्या होगा पता ही नहीं क्या होगा अगर वरी कर रहे हैं तो ये हड्डियां तोड़ देगा पैसा गायब कर देगा कंगाली करेगा
says: In correcting you Saturn ends love and puts the relationship in darkness; if you worry, he will break bones, make money vanish and bring poverty. This is his claim on Saturn's severity, not a prediction.
ambiguity: Breaking bones is figurative or health-related; recorded as stated.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn's harshness and affliction of bones and money.

hindi: और अगर कहेंगे करेगा यार परमात्मा क्या टेंशन कोई बात नहीं अगली बार से मैंने खुशी नहीं मनानी उम्मीद नहीं लगानी बताना नहीं है
says: If instead you say 'God will take care of it, no tension; from now I will not celebrate, not hold expectations and not tell anyone', Saturn stays set and gives plenty.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हाउ टू क्रिएट फ्यूचर जो हमने क्लास की है उम्मीद तसल्ली बताना खुशी नहीं करना हमारा शनि सेट रहेगा और खूब देगा
says: Referring to his earlier 'How to Create Future' class, he repeats: hold hope quietly, take comfort, do not tell, do not make a show of joy; then your Saturn stays set and gives plenty.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: रिश्तों में जब अंधकार की स्थिति आ रही है तो समझाने बताने के सपे से निकल जाओ शनि को अपना काम करने दो हर जगह प्रेम नहीं मिलेगा
says: When darkness comes in relationships, stop the habit of explaining and telling; let Saturn do his work, because love will not be found everywhere.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house relationship colours the dark patch: sign nature decides whether it is cold distance or forced duty.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius on the 7th (lagna Leo): a detached, idea-based partnership, love shown sparingly.
Derived: Capricorn on the 7th (lagna Cancer): duty-bound, reserved relationship.

ambiguity: 'Relations' includes all relationships; 7th is chosen as the main partnership house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि का मुख्य मुद्दा है वो धन देगा तो भोग नहीं देगा पति-पत्नी में सेक्स देगा तो प्रेम नहीं देगा प्रेम देगा तो सेक्स नहीं देगा प्रॉपर्टी देगा तो भोग नहीं देगा भोग देगा तो प्रॉपर्टी नहीं देगा
says: Saturn's main rule is trade-off: he gives wealth but not enjoyment; in marriage sex or love but not both; property or enjoyment but not both. He never gives everything together.
cells_derived_method: The house Saturn holds decides which pair of gifts is traded: 2nd (wealth vs enjoyment), 4th (property vs comfort), 7th (sex vs love).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign in the 2nd (lagna Sagittarius): money comes steadily, enjoyment of it is restricted.
Derived: Saturn in own sign in the 7th (lagna Leo): partnership is stable and physical but warmth is limited.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer): property and stability come, comfort and ease are traded off.

ambiguity: Sexual-relationship wording as he says it; no medical claim.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Saturn as denial and restriction in each house.

hindi: अगर सब कुछ चाहिए आपको तो पता करने के चक्कर में मत रहो चिंता चिंतन मत करो खुद का स्यापा मत करो करा हो मत बार-बार मत बोलो मुझे यह चाहिए
says: If you want everything, do not chase proof or keep worrying and brooding, and do not repeat 'I want this'; drop the self-made drama.
ambiguity: Crosses the chunk boundary at 'पता करने'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और बहुत आग लग रही है धासू सा पत्थर पहनो इसका स्टोन पहनो सेट करो
says: If the burning urge is very strong, wear a powerful stone for it and set the planet right instead of agonising; the stone here refers to Saturn's gem.
ambiguity: Which stone is meant is inferred from context (sapphire), subject to his earlier ban rule.
classical_check: Silent on 'powerful stone'; gems are classical.

hindi: आए दिन रोज शनि का तेल चढ़ाकर अगर आप आ रहे हैं और बृहस्पति सेट नहीं है आपका तो तेल चढ़ाने से भी शनि ब्लॉक हो जाएगा खराब हो जाएगा
says: If you offer Saturn oil every single day while your Jupiter is not set right, the oil offering itself blocks and spoils Saturn.
ambiguity: Whether Jupiter being 'set' is a chart condition or conduct is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not tie Saturn oil offerings to Jupiter's strength.

hindi: इसलिए शनि की पूजा करने के बावजूद भी आप दरिद्री रह सकते हैं पूजा पाठ सही करने से मनुष्य ठीक होता है लोगों को आती नहीं इसलिए गलत है
says: So you can remain poor even while worshipping Saturn; worship works only when done correctly, but most people do not know how and so it goes wrong.
classical_check: Agrees in general that remedies must be done correctly.

hindi: हम भेट चाल पर चलते हैं कि एक ने कर लिया सारे करो मंदिर का महत्व बन जाता है यह एक हमारे पास रैंडम कुंडली
says: We follow the herd: if one person did a ritual, everyone does it, and that is how temples gain importance; he points out that mass imitation replaces chart-specific remedy.
ambiguity: The last words about a random chart start the next thought.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A random chart whose owner he knows, so he has to speak about it carefully; keeping matters secret is Saturn's point.
We spoke in jest and fun; the listener cannot tell if it is true or a joke, whether he is serious or kidding; the talk flew off in fun and nobody learned what was really going on.
Opening words 'it is intact, no problem will come, we are busy assuring ... instead we are blowing it away' are a fragment from the previous chart; context is not recoverable.

hindi: शनी पावरफुल काम करेगा संसारी दौलत का मालिक है इस कुंडली के अंदर
says: In this example chart Saturn will work powerfully, as the owner of worldly wealth.
cells_derived_method: none: a statement on Saturn's role in this particular chart; the house is given later (2nd house).
ambiguity: Whether 'owner of worldly wealth' is a general karaka or a chart-specific lordship is not clear.
classical_check: Saturn as 9th and 10th lord for Taurus lagna is a yogakaraka, agrees in spirit.

hindi: इस कुंडली के अंदर हमारे पास दो नंबर का लगन है दो नंबर का लगन 24 डिग्री का है तो 24 डिग्री के लगन के लिए हमारे पास दो नंबर लगन में तीन नंबर राशि एक्टिवेट हो गई है
says: In the example chart the lagna is sign 2 (Taurus) at 24 degrees; because it is so far into the sign, sign 3 (Gemini) is also active in the lagna, so the first house is shared by two signs.
cells_derived_method: A lagna at 24 degrees of its sign spills into the next sign; each following house is also shared by two signs shifted the same way.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the lagna house reads Taurus, with Gemini's influence layered on because of 24 degrees.
Derived: the same house also reads Gemini (Mercury's sign), so speech and communication colour the self.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर' is read as sign number 3 (Gemini).
classical_check: Agrees with equal-house or bhava-chalit overlap; classical D1 gives only one sign per house.

hindi: ये दो बत्ती है 3 ब च भी चलेगी 4 बा पा 5 बा 6 भी चलेगी 6 बा सा भी चलेगी सा बा आ भी चलेगी 8 बान 9 बा 10
says: He walks through the houses saying each house is shared by two consecutive signs (2 and 3, then 3 and 4, 4 and 5, and so on up to 9 and 10); the caption is very noisy, so only the pairing pattern is recovered.
cells_derived_method: For lagna Taurus at 24 degrees, house n covers sign (n+1) and sign (n+2): house 1 is Taurus and Gemini, house 2 Gemini and Cancer, house 3 Cancer and Leo, and so on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: house 2 reads Gemini and Cancer, so wealth reads through Mercury's and the Moon's signs.
Derived: house 7 reads Scorpio and Sagittarius, so partnership reads through Mars and Jupiter.
Derived: house 10 reads Aquarius and Pisces, so career reads through Saturn and Jupiter.

ambiguity: The numbers are garbled; the exact pairs are reconstructed from the 24 degree lagna.
classical_check: Agrees with equal-house logic from a mid-sign lagna.

gist: This is a lot of homework you should have done; good that you came after washing your clothes early morning; banter with the audience.
Repeats that the lagna is at 24 degrees so these signs are running.

hindi: अब सूर्य है दो नंबर का 24 डिग्री डिग्री पे नहीं जाएंगे कठिन हो जाएगा दो नंबर नॉट गुड खास बढ़िया नहीं है अच्छा नहीं है
says: The Sun is in sign 2 (Taurus) at 24 degrees, the lagna position; he avoids degree-level analysis because it gets too hard, and rates the Sun in Taurus as not good, nothing special.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Taurus (a Venus sign, not friendly) is mediocre; its house changes which area is dulled.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo): authority and status delivered slowly and materially, without brilliance.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn): pride in intelligence is muted, stubborn.

ambiguity: 'Not good' is a rating of the Sun in Taurus, in contrast to Gemini next.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts class Taurus as an enemy sign for the Sun, partly agrees.

hindi: बुध है 24 डिग्री नो नॉट गुड
says: Mercury is also at 24 degrees in Taurus, and he rates it as not good in that sign.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Taurus (Venus sign) is average at best; the house decides the field affected.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries): speech is slow, steady and money-focused.
Derived: Mercury in Taurus in the 6th (lagna Sagittarius): service and analysis work is heavy and stubborn.

ambiguity: Taurus is not Mercury's debilitation; 'not good' is his rating and not a dignity term.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Taurus as friendly for Mercury, so this differs.

hindi: अब यहां तीन नंबर की राशि भी एक्टिवेटेड है सूर्य तीन नंबर लाजवाब बुध लाजवाब
says: The Sun and Mercury are also active in sign 3 (Gemini) through the 24 degree overlap; there the Sun is wonderful and Mercury, in its own sign, is wonderful.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in its own sign Gemini and the Sun in Mercury's friendly sign both read as strong in whichever house Gemini falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Mercury in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries): bold writing, communication, skill.
Derived: Sun and Mercury in Gemini in the 11th (lagna Leo): gains through networks and trade.

ambiguity: Sentence flows into the next chunk with 'Sun Mercury together'.
classical_check: Mercury in own sign Gemini is classical; Sun in Gemini is neutral classically.

hindi: सूर्य बुध साथ हो गए कमाल का योग है बुद्ध आदित्य योग कहते हैं इसे लाजवाब
says: With the Sun and Mercury together he names the Budha-Aditya yoga and calls it excellent.
cells_derived_method: The yoga operates in the house where Sun and Mercury sit; its field differs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Budha-Aditya in the lagna in Gemini: sharp intellect and authority of speech.
Derived: Budha-Aditya in the 10th in Virgo (lagna Sagittarius): professional analysis and public standing.

ambiguity: 'सात' in the caption is read as 'साथ' (together).
classical_check: Budha-Aditya yoga is classical: Sun and Mercury conjunct.

hindi: अब यार पहले बोला खराब है अब बोला अच्छा है फिर बोला कोई नॉर्मल है ऐसे कैसे निकाले ये एक्सपीरियंस से आएगा
says: When one planet reads bad in one sign, good in the next and normal in a third, how do you reach a verdict? He says this synthesis comes only with experience.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts use one sign.

hindi: यहां तीन और चार नंबर है चार नंबर साथ चल रहा है शुक्र है तीन नंबर नीच समान फल है
says: Venus is active in signs 3 and 4 (Gemini and Cancer, the 2nd house); in sign 3 it gives results like a debilitated Venus.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Gemini or Cancer gives weak results; the house decides which topic is weak.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius): partner is witty but restless, bonding is weak.
Derived: Venus in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries): comforts of home are emotional and clinging.

ambiguity: Venus is not actually debilitated in Gemini (debilitation is Virgo); he says 'like debilitated' loosely.
classical_check: Differs: Venus debilitates in Virgo; Gemini is friendly for Venus in classical texts.

hindi: शनि है तीन नंबर उच्च फल है लाजवाब यहां पर तीन नंबर का ये चार नंबर का भी शुक्र काम कर रहा है
says: Saturn, sitting with Venus, gives exalted-like results in sign 3 and works wonderfully, while Venus keeps working from both sign 3 and sign 4.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Gemini in friendly Mercury's sign is strong; effects shift by house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo): disciplined communicative career, rises steadily.
Derived: Saturn in Gemini in the 6th (lagna Capricorn): strong at overcoming debts and rivals.

ambiguity: Saturn is not exalted in Gemini (Libra is); 'exalted-like' is his loose rating.
classical_check: Differs on exaltation; Saturn is friendly with Mercury, so a good result is plausible.

hindi: ये भी ऐसे ही राशियां ऐसे ऐसे ऐसे ऐसे गोल चल रही है
says: The signs keep rotating in the same overlapping way for the other planets in the chart, each planet working in two neighbouring signs at once.
ambiguity: Vague gesture; no new content beyond the pairing.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: What will be the account of this person's life; we now look under it; this is the main lagna chart.

hindi: अब यहां चलित आ गई चलित कुंडली में हमारा कोई ग्रह खिसका ही नहीं है चलित कुंडली और लगन कुंडली सेम है इसमें कहीं कोई 1 पर भी फर्क नहीं आया
says: In the bhava chalit chart no planet has shifted house, so the chalit chart and the lagna chart are identical for this native, with no difference at all.
classical_check: Agrees with the chalit method: planets shift only when their degrees cross house boundaries.

gist: We will discuss that later; this is now our KP chart.

hindi: केपी चार्ट के अंदर हमारा राहु और केतु राहु और नेप्चून है यह राहु और नेप्चून दोनों यहां आ गए यहां यूरेनस था यूरेनस खिसक के यहां आ गया है काफी बड़ा चेंज है
says: In the KP chart Rahu and Neptune move together into a new house and Uranus shifts too, a big change from the lagna chart.
cells_derived_method: none: house names are gestured on the diagram.
ambiguity: The target houses are not named; only the fact of shifting is recoverable.
classical_check: KP uses Placidus cusps, so shifts between houses are expected.

hindi: हमारा सूर्य केतु सूर्य यहां आ गया केतु भी यहां पर आ गया सूर्य केतु और बुध थे तीनों खिसक कर के यहां पहुंच गए इन दोनों में से ये आ गया बुध यही रह गया बड़े वास चेंजेज आ रहे हैं
says: The Sun and Ketu also move house in the KP chart; Sun, Ketu and Mercury were together, two moved and Mercury stayed, so a large change appears in this person's life reading.
ambiguity: Which houses they move to is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब हमारे पास क्या हो रहा है हम ये दो लेते हैं क्योंकि ये दोनों तो लगभग सेम ही है
says: For the reading he works with the lagna and chalit views together, since those two are almost the same, and sets KP aside for now.
ambiguity: 'ये दो' is a gesture; read as lagna and chalit.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति का तीन नंबर का बुध हो गया वाणी की जबरदस्त जबरदस्त अथॉरिटी रहेगी
says: With Mercury in sign 3 (Gemini) in the lagna overlap, this person will have a tremendous authority of speech.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Gemini gives strong speech; the house decides where it is applied.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 2nd (lagna Taurus): family speech and negotiation are authoritative.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries): writing, media and skill with the hands.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury in own sign is strong in speech.

hindi: सूर्य साथ में यह अथॉरिटी देगा व्यक्ति को सफल है असफल है कोई पता नहीं लेकिन अथॉरिटी लाइफ के अंदर रहनी रहनी है
says: The Sun with Mercury adds authority; whether the person is successful or not cannot be told, but authority will remain in his life throughout.
ambiguity: He explicitly separates authority from success.
classical_check: Silent; Sun gives authority classically.

hindi: शुक्र शनि साथ बैठा है पत्नी का पूर्ण साथ रहेगा लेकिन शुक्र तीन नंबर का है पत्नी के साथ झिक झिक रहनी बहुत जरूरी है क्योंकि शुक्र डिस्टर्ब है लेकिन शनि पूर्ण रूप से मदद करके देगा
says: Venus sits with Saturn, so the wife's full support remains, but because Venus is disturbed in sign 3 there will be constant bickering with her; Saturn still helps fully.
cells_derived_method: Venus-Saturn together gives a loyal but strained wife; effect shifts by house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus with Saturn in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius): loyal but argumentative spouse.
Derived: Venus with Saturn in Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini): family wealth slow but supported, with emotional friction.

ambiguity: Wife is read from Venus as karaka, not from the 7th house, since the planets are in the 2nd.
classical_check: Venus as wife karaka is classical; Venus-Saturn conjunction giving loyalty with friction fits.

hindi: इसकी सात नंबर प्लूटो छ नंबर का है प्लूटो छ नंबर बुध की राशि में लाजवाब होता है और यही सात नंबर उच्च समान हो गया
says: Pluto is in sign 6 (Virgo, Mercury's sign) and also active in sign 7 (Libra), the 5th house; Pluto in Virgo is wonderful and sign 7 gives exalted-like results.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius): strong authority in analytic, service roles.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' is read as sign 7 (Libra); Pluto's lordship of Aquarius is his scheme.

hindi: अब प्लूटो यमराज क्या है यमराज धर्मराज भी है यह व्यक्ति प्लूटो धर्म यमराज क्या कह रहा है सात नंबर का उच्च फल दूंगा उच्च शनि समान
says: Pluto is Yamraj and also Dharmaraj, the judge of dharma; in sign 7 he says he will give an exalted result, like an exalted Saturn.
cells_derived_method: none: dignity-like rating tied to Libra.
ambiguity: Exalted Saturn is in Libra, matching the claim.
classical_check: Pluto is outside classical texts; Saturn's exaltation in Libra is classical.

hindi: यह धर्मराज की तरह सारे टाइम डिक्टेटरशिप चलाएगा व्यक्ति यह सही होता है यह गलत होता है ऐसे ही करना चाहिए चाहिए यह तरीका है
says: Like Dharmaraj, this person will run a dictatorship all the time, pronouncing what is right and wrong and how things must be done.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन इसकी बात जायज होगी कैसे जायज होगी क्योंकि पंचम भाव में है पितरों की असीम कृपा है इस व्यक्ति पर

Derived: strong planet in Sagittarius in the 5th (lagna Leo): ancestral merit shows as wisdom and guidance.

ambiguity: 5th as pitr house is his own approach.
classical_check: Differs: 5th is purva-punya, past merit; pitr is usually the 9th.

hindi: यानी यह व्यक्ति रॉकेट की तरह मल्टीपल सक्सेस पाएगा जहां भी पाएगा और दूर की सेंस बहुत तगड़ी होती है बिल्कुल ईगल आई कहते हैं इसको क्योंकि पित कृपा है
says: So the person will achieve multiple successes like a rocket, and will have a very strong far-sight, an eagle eye, because of ancestral grace.
ambiguity: A positive claim, not a measured one.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब ये यहां पर प्लूटो की बात हो गई कोई भी ग्रह अच्छा है तो उस व्यक्ति की मल्टीपल मैनीफोल्ड सक्सेस होगी और इंटूटिव पावर्स होंगी
says: Generalising from Pluto: any well-placed planet in this position brings the person many-sided success and intuitive powers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries): leadership success and strong intuition.
Derived: Jupiter in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio): wisdom success and deep intuition.

ambiguity: Whether it applies to the 5th only or to any house is not stated; read as the 5th.
classical_check: Agrees roughly with the 5th as house of intellect and merit.

hindi: कोई भी य कोई भी ग्रह नीच है पितृ दोष है शुक्र नीचे बुध नीचे मंगल नीचे कोई भी नीच है पितृ दोष हो ही गया गारंटी हो गई फिनिश हो गई बात
says: Any debilitated planet (Venus, Mercury, Mars or any other) means pitr dosha is present, guaranteed; no other test is needed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus): pitr dosha affecting children and creativity.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio): pitr dosha affecting fortune and father.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries): pitr dosha affecting sleep and expenses.

ambiguity: Whether this covers only the 5th or all houses is not stated; read as all.
classical_check: Differs: classical pitr dosha uses Sun or 9th house afflictions, not any debilitated planet.

hindi: उसका कोई लेनदेन नहीं है ये चीज अब यहां सात यहां पर आ गए चंद्रमा और इंद्र चंद्रमा सात नंबर का बहुत अच्छा बैठा है
says: Pitr dosha has no give and take, it is fixed; now the Moon and Indra (Uranus) have arrived in sign 7 (Libra), where the Moon sits very well.

Derived: Moon in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn): public balance and a popular career.

ambiguity: Leading phrase about 'no exchange' belongs to the pitr dosha sentence.
classical_check: Moon in Libra is neutral in classical texts, so 'very good' is his rating.

hindi: इंद्र सात नंबर का बहुत ज्यादा गंदा बैठा है ऐश अयाशी का ग्रह यहां बैठ गया ऐश याशी से नफरत कर देता है ऐसा आदमी क्लेश मार दूंगा ये शत्रुता है जिस जिस से शत्रुता

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries): marriage and partnerships prone to sharp enmity.
Derived: Uranus in Libra in the 6th (lagna Taurus): fights with rivals and workplace quarrels.

ambiguity: The caption merges two sentences; 'I will kill' reads as an angry threat, not a literal death claim.
classical_check: Uranus is outside classical texts.

hindi: चंद्रमा यह शत्रु में स्वयं का भी शत्रु मन बहुत कड़ेगा चिड़चिड़ा हट बहुत ज्यादा रहेगी इरिटेशन बहुत यहां दृष्टि वहम शक कड़वे शब्द सपाट बोल देना यह नेचर में रहेगा
says: The Moon here turns enemy even to himself; the mind hardens, irritability, suspicion and doubt are high, with bitter words and blunt speech as the person's nature.
cells_derived_method: Moon afflicted by Uranus gives irritability and distrust; effect depends on house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Uranus in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer): restless home life and emotional edge.
Derived: Moon with Uranus in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries): suspicious, blunt in partnerships.

ambiguity: Not a mental-health claim; describes temperament in his terms.
classical_check: Moon with a malefic giving irritability is classical.

hindi: चंद्रमा यहां आठ नंबर राशि भी एक्टिवेट है ... आठ नंबर राशि एक्टिवेट है चंद्रमा की इसको पीठ में तकलीफ आनी व्यक्ति को पीठ में रीड की हड्डी में ए4 ए5 में गैप आएगा
says: The Moon is also active in sign 8 (Scorpio, its debilitation sign) through the overlap, which he says brings back and spine trouble, a gap in the lower vertebrae. This is his body-part claim, recorded and not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Moon debilitated in Scorpio weakens the area ruled by the house it falls in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini): the sixth house body and daily-health themes are strained.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 10th (lagna Aquarius): public image hit, strain through work.

ambiguity: 'ए4 ए5' read as lumbar L4 and L5; vertebral claim is from his example, no medical authority.
classical_check: Silent on vertebral levels; Scorpio rules the pelvic region classically.

hindi: अब क्या व्यक्ति बेड रिडन हो जाएगा या चलता फिरता रहेगा जैसे ही आठ नंबर की राशि की एक्टिवेशन हम यहां ले रहे हैं तो हम यहां देखते दो नंबर उच्च बैड रि डन रहना है नहीं बैड रि डन नहीं होगा चलता फिरता भी रहेगा
says: Will the person become bedridden or stay mobile? Looking at the sign 2 position, which he calls exalted-like, he concludes he will not be bedridden and will keep moving about despite the condition. Recorded as his claim, not a medical prognosis.
cells_derived_method: Moon exalted in Taurus shows resilience; the effect appears where Taurus falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the lagna (lagna Taurus): body resilience and recovery.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius): emotional steadiness at home.

ambiguity: It is unclear which planet the 'sign 2 exalted' refers to; Moon exaltation in Taurus is assumed.
classical_check: Moon exalted in Taurus is classical.

hindi: बड़ी विचित्र स्थिति फिर अल्टीमेटली होगा क्या तो हम यहां देख रहे कॉमिनेशन के चंद्रमा कह रहा है मार दूंगा अच्छा यही बृहस्पति यह बहुत अच्छा हो गया
says: A strange situation: the Moon in its debilitation sign says it will strike, but Jupiter's presence in the combination makes things much better; the outcome is read from the combination.
cells_derived_method: none: combination logic; the house of Jupiter is not named.
ambiguity: Jupiter's position is not captioned; 'kill' is a figure for harm.
classical_check: Jupiter easing a debilitated Moon is consistent with neecha-bhanga ideas.

hindi: इंद्र इंद्र आठ नंबर का हो गया वो कह रहा मार कैसे दूंगा अरे यार दर्द में भी चलूंगा क्योंकि इंद्र का घर है आठ नंबर
says: Indra (Uranus) in sign 8 (Scorpio) says 'I will keep walking even in pain', because sign 8 is Indra's own home in his scheme.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries): hidden resilience, survives through crises.
Derived: Uranus in Scorpio in the 3rd (lagna Virgo): courageous effort despite hardship.

ambiguity: Uranus owning Scorpio is his scheme (alternate lord of Scorpio).
classical_check: Differs: Mars rules Scorpio classically; Uranus is outside classical texts.

hindi: मंगल यहां से दृष्टि डाल के कहता है ऐसी की तैसी तुम्हारी संभालूं मैं जाने नहीं दूंगा
says: Mars casts its aspect from its place and says it will protect and not let him go, giving protection to the person against the condition.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th from its house, so the protected area depends on where Mars sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 2nd (lagna Pisces) aspects the 5th, 8th and 9th, protecting those houses.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) aspects the 1st, 4th and 5th, protecting body and home.

classical_check: Mars's special aspects (4, 7, 8) are classical.

hindi: तो एक तो शत्रु भी खूब बनाएगा य व्यक्ति और शत्रु से ही यह पार्टी भी करेगा व्यक्ति और शत्रु ही इसके हाथ भी जोड़ेंगे ऑटोमेटिक ऐसी स्थिति होगी
says: The person will make many enemies yet also party with them, and the enemies themselves will end up folding their hands before him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 6th (lagna Taurus): rivals handled with charm and negotiation.
Derived: Scorpio on the 6th (lagna Gemini): rivals fought hard and finally yield.

classical_check: Agrees: planets in the 6th conquer enemies.

hindi: शत्रु बनाने में भी कसर नहीं है हर जगह शत्रु बना के चलता है ऐसा व्यक्ति बहुत शानदार तरीके से लेकिन मजे भी पूरे
says: He leaves no gap in making enemies and carries enemies everywhere, yet lives in a grand style and enjoys fully.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां राहु और नेप्चून नेप्चून यहां बिल्कुल तबाहीदार है तो गृहस्थ को लेकर के बड़े जबरदस्त तान और परेशानिया है
says: With Rahu and Neptune together in the 7th, Neptune is utterly destructive there, so there is severe tension and trouble in married household life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with Neptune in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus): intense, secretive tension in marriage.
Derived: Rahu with Neptune in Sagittarius in the 7th (lagna Gemini): idealistic illusions around partnership.

ambiguity: The house is inferred as the 7th, with signs 8 and 9 from the 24 degree lagna; the caption only says 'here'.
classical_check: Rahu in the 7th troubling marriage is classical; Neptune is outside classical texts.

hindi: साथ के साथ यहां अगर हम वैसे देखें राशि दूसरी तो राहु नौ नंबर का भी एक्टिवेट है अच्छा नेप्चून अगर हम इसको छोड़ दें
says: Looking at the second sign of the overlap, Rahu is also active in sign 9 (Sagittarius); he then sets Neptune aside to read Rahu alone.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Sagittarius shifts tone to wisdom-seeking; house decides area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries): unconventional beliefs and foreign links.
Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 3rd (lagna Libra): bold, unorthodox effort.

ambiguity: Continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Rahu in Sagittarius is considered debilitated by some texts, in contrast to his reading here.

hindi: नेप्चून कहता तलाक होगा राहु कहता नहीं होगा क्योंकि राहु नीच नहीं है राहु खराब नहीं है
