ambiguity: Whether Rahu is debilitated depends on school; he says it is not here.
classical_check: Differs by school on Rahu's exaltation and debilitation signs.

hindi: अगर हम इसको परिवर्तन करते हैं राशि राहु कहता है य तलाक करके छोडूंगा नेप्चून कहता है किसी हालत में नहीं होने दूंगा नौ नंबर तो भाई बृहस्पति का है
says: If we change the sign to 9 (Sagittarius), Rahu says it will end in divorce, while Neptune refuses to allow it at any cost; sign 9 is Jupiter's, so the pull and push continue.
ambiguity: The two planets are said to swap positions on the sign change; wording is unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बृहस्पति और मैं दोनों देवता यानी झिक झिक झिक चलती रहेगी परेशानी झिक झिक जिंदगी भर चलेगी
says: Jupiter and Neptune are both divine planets, so a constant bickering will continue for life, a recurring nuisance that does not break the bond.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: समस्या क्या यहां केतु नीच हो जाता है बुध इसको संभाल रहा है देखो कॉमिनेशन कैसे चलते हैं एक ग्रह संभालता है एक मार रहा है ये खिचड़ी बनानी है हमें
says: The problem is that Ketu becomes debilitated in the lagna area, while Mercury steadies it; in combinations one planet saves and another hits, and we must blend them into a khichdi.
cells_derived_method: Ketu debilitated in the lagna shows a shaky self, steadied by Mercury in the same house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Taurus in the lagna (lagna Taurus) is weak, with Mercury in the house giving steadiness.
Derived: Ketu in Gemini in the lagna (lagna Gemini) carries doubt, Mercury as lord anchors it.

ambiguity: Ketu's debilitation sign varies by school; he calls it debilitated here.
classical_check: Differs by school; many give Ketu debilitation in Taurus or Scorpio.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिक केतु कहता है मारूंगा अब ये पेट है ये सिर है पेट या सिर की प्रॉब्लम या तो खुद को रहेगी या पत्नी में से एक को रहेगी यानी माथा ही मारते रहेंगे
says: Ketu says it will strike; in this chart stomach or head trouble will fall either on the native or on his wife, and they will keep banging heads in arguments. These are body-area claims, not diagnoses.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in the lagna touches head and body; Rahu opposite in the 7th touches the wife, so troubles split between the two.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Taurus in the lagna (lagna Taurus): head or throat strain for the native.
Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus): stomach or lower-abdomen strain for the spouse.

ambiguity: Stomach vs head assignment is gestured on the chart.
classical_check: Aries and the lagna as head, Ketu in the lagna weakening the body, partly agrees.

hindi: और कुछ नहीं होगा तो बहस करेंगे सडन एक्यूट डिप्रेशन सडन एक्यूट टेंशन सडन एक्यूट परेशानी चंद्रमा इसमें फुल हेल्प कर रहा है
says: If nothing else happens they will argue, and sudden acute depression, sudden acute tension and sudden acute worry can arise, with the afflicted Moon helping the pattern fully. Recorded as his claim and not a clinical statement.
ambiguity: 'Depression' is used in a loose sense, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Moon afflicted by nodes giving mental turbulence is classical.

hindi: 10 नंबर राशि इनकी यहां पड़ी है मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली में और 10 नंबर यहां पड़ी है ये दो खाने हैं जो शनि के पास
says: In the example chart sign 10 (Capricorn), Saturn's sign, falls in two boxes (houses 8 and 9 on the overlap), and these two houses are the ones Saturn controls.
cells_derived_method: Capricorn spans the 8th and 9th for this 24 degree Taurus lagna, so Saturn's two houses are secrecy-in-laws and fortune.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 8th (lagna Gemini): hidden matters, in-laws and inheritance under Saturn.
Derived: Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus): fortune, father and dharma under Saturn.

ambiguity: The houses are inferred from the overlap, since 'here' is gestured.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give Saturn 9th and 10th for Taurus lagna, not 8th and 9th.

hindi: अब बाय द रूल क्या करना है यह सीक्रेसी है लाइफ की और ससुराल है यह व्यक्ति ससुराल के साथ और अपने भाग्य के साथ जितना सीक्रेट और है नहीं है चलता है उतना शनि
says: By his rule, this person must keep secrecy in life, with his in-laws and about his fortune; the more he keeps hidden, the better Saturn runs for him. The sentence is cut at the batch end.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's houses are the 8th (in-laws, secrets) and 9th (fortune), so secrecy applies to those areas.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Capricorn in the 8th (lagna Gemini) keep in-law dealings and secrets private.
Derived: for Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus) keep fortune and father-related plans private.

ambiguity: Ends mid-sentence; 'है नहीं है चलता है' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent; in-laws as the 8th follows the classical 8th from the 7th reasoning.

gist: Garbled opening about fortune, interference in two matters and the in-laws side; no clear rule can be read.

hindi: सीक्रेट खाना ये होता है हमारा आठवा घर सीक्रेसी का है क्या आप कितना सीक्रेट रखते हो
says: The 8th house is the house of secrecy: it shows how much of a secret-keeper the person is and what he keeps hidden.
cells_derived_method: Secrecy topic of the 8th is coloured by the sign on it: fixed/water signs keep secrets hard, air/mutable signs leak them through talk, fire signs hide by bluntness or by hiding in action.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 8th makes secrecy deep and tight; secrets are held and used as leverage.
Derived: Gemini on the 8th makes secrets slip through talk, messages and writing even when he intends to hide them.
Derived: Leo on the 8th hides things behind pride and image; secrets are about status and reputation.

classical_check: Agrees: 8th is the house of hidden matters (gupta vishaya).

hindi: इस व्यक्ति ने अपने सीक्रेट अगर शेयर नहीं किए कभी भी लाइफ में कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं आएगी
says: For this chart he promises that as long as the person never shares his own secrets, no serious trouble will come in life; sharing secrets is what invites problems.
cells_derived_method: Applies to this native's chart with a strong 8th-house secrecy factor. For other charts the amount of secrecy needed would scale with 8th house strength and affliction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with Cancer on the 8th, emotional confidences (family, mother matters) are the secrets whose sharing causes trouble.
Derived: with Capricorn on the 8th, secrets about work, money and authority are the risky ones to share.

ambiguity: Specific to Munna Bhai's chart; not stated as a general rule for every native.
classical_check: Silent; secrecy as a protective habit is a folk-practice claim, not in the classics.

hindi: सेविंग प्लेनेट बहुत स्ट्रंग है शत्रुता कितनी बन जाए लेकिन सेविंग प्लेनेट बहुत स्ट्रंग है तो सीक्रेसी रेगुलर चाहिए
says: Even if the protecting planet is very strong and enmity builds up around the person, he still needs regular secrecy; strength of the protector does not remove the need to keep quiet.
ambiguity: 'Saving planet' is not named in this sentence; the next sentence points to Saturn, but this could also mean the strongest benefic of the chart.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि महाराज बैठे कहां है शनि य सामने बैठा है दूसरे घर में
says: Chart fact for the example native: Saturn is sitting in the 2nd house.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 2nd house reads as restraint on wealth, family and speech; sign decides whether it is comfortable (Capricorn/Aquarius/Libra) or strained.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra on the 2nd is strong (exalted sign); savings are built slowly but steadily and speech is measured.
Derived: Saturn in Aries on the 2nd is in its debilitation sign; money comes late and with effort, speech may be harsh.

ambiguity: Sign of Saturn is not given in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn in the 2nd gives delay in wealth/family and harsh speech; here it is used for a positive reading.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति ने अगर कभी भी जीवन में अपना धन नहीं गिना तो अंधा धन आएगा
says: With Saturn in the 2nd, if the native never counts or audits his own money, unseen or windfall wealth will flow in; counting the money blocks it. A habit remedy, not a rule from the classics.
cells_derived_method: For Saturn in other houses the 'do not count' idea would attach to that house topic: Saturn in the 11th would mean not tallying gains, in the 10th not measuring career results.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Aquarius on the 11th, the same 'do not count' discipline would apply to income and gains.
Derived: Saturn in Capricorn on the 10th, do not keep tallying professional wins and losses.

ambiguity: 'Andha dhan' (blind money) is not explained; could mean cash that arrives without effort or money whose source is not seen.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical Saturn remedy.

hindi: यह यहां दृष्टि है पांच नंबर नेगेटिव प्रॉपर्टी नंबर पॉजिटिव प्रॉपर्टी
says: Saturn's aspect lands on a place numbered five; he links the five-number and another number to negative property and positive property respectively. The exact mapping is garbled.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspect on a house makes that house's matters slow or heavy; if the aspected house is a property house (4th) or sits in the 4th's trine the property result is mixed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn watching a Scorpio 5th gives heavy, delayed results from children or speculation, pushing the person toward property instead.

ambiguity: Whether 'five number' is the 5th house or sign number 5 (Leo) is unclear; the second number is not caught in the caption.
classical_check: Saturn's 3rd, 7th and 10th aspects from the 2nd house fall on the 4th, 8th and 11th, not the 5th, so the stated target does not match the plain aspect rule.

hindi: कुछ प्रॉपर्टी ऐसी बनेंगी इस व्यक्ति के लिए जो जिंदगी भर यूज नहीं कर पाएगा कुछ प्रॉपर्टी ऐसी बनेंगी जो सुख देंगी
says: He predicts the native will acquire some properties he can never use in his lifetime, and some that will give him comfort; property outcome is split into useless and useful holdings.
cells_derived_method: Property split would follow the 4th house and its lord; houses 3, 6 and 12 influences make a holding unusable (disputed, rented away, abroad), while 2, 4, 11 influences make it usable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Libra 4th gives property through partnership or deals; some holdings are shared and unusable alone.
Derived: a Pisces 4th gives property that is far, institutional or tied up, which he may hold but not live in.

ambiguity: He does not say which house he reads for property in this sentence; 4th is assumed. This is a prediction about this native, not a general rule.
classical_check: Silent on usable/unusable property; 4th house is the classical property house.

hindi: जैसे ही पता करने लगेगा इस प्रॉपर्टी के बारे में व्यक्ति के यह करूंगा वो करूंगा यहां बिल्डिंग बनाऊ महल बनाऊ कुछ नहीं होगा कुछ नहीं बन पाएगा उसका वहां पर
says: For the unusable property: the moment the native starts enquiring and announcing big plans (I will build a building, a palace), nothing will materialise and nothing can be built there under any condition.
cells_derived_method: The 'plans collapse' reading applies when the property house is afflicted; where the 4th is strong the same plans would succeed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 4th gives impatient, loud planning of land projects, which the rule says will stall.
Derived: Virgo on the 4th gives detailed planning on paper; the rule says it still will not get built on that particular plot.

ambiguity: Applies only to the 'bad property' he has just separated; the plot is not located in the chart.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He defers the question of where the lords of the 12 signs sit to a longer class later.

hindi: यह हमारा है 11वां घर एक नंबर में बृहस्पति 12 नंबर का मित्र राशि है अपनी ही समझो किराए पर दी हुई है
says: In the 11th house Jupiter sits in a friend's sign; treat it as practically its own, like a property of his that has been given on rent, so Jupiter works comfortably there.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in a friend's sign (Sun, Moon or Mars signs) gives near-own strength; the house decides what is strengthened. In the 11th it strengthens gains and elder-sibling and friend networks.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Mars's sign Aries on the 11th gives bold, energetic gains from friends and networks.
Derived: Jupiter in Sun's sign Leo on the 11th gives gains through authority and well-placed contacts.

ambiguity: 'Number 1' and 'number 12' could be sign numbers (Aries, Pisces) or house numbers; Jupiter in the 11th with sign Aries as friend of Jupiter is the likeliest reading.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter in a friend's sign is strong; the 'rented-out house' image is his own.

hindi: इसने केतु को मंगल भी केतु की राशि का लाजवाब बृहस्पति लाभ बहुत होगा
says: The rented-out sign has been given to Ketu, and Mars is also in Ketu's sign, which is excellent; Jupiter then gives a lot of gain (11th house).
cells_derived_method: Gains follow from Jupiter's strong 11th placement; Mars and Ketu in this arrangement add push to those gains. Other houses would receive their own topic's gain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter on a Scorpio 11th (Mars/Ketu-type sign) gives gain through research, joint resources and hidden channels.
Derived: Jupiter on a Pisces 11th is in its own sign and gives gains through spiritual, foreign or charitable networks.

ambiguity: In his scheme Ketu's sign is Pisces or Scorpio, which is not fixed here; the caption is also noisy about who 'gave' to Ketu.
classical_check: Ketu has no sign lordship in the classics; this is his own scheme. Jupiter in the 11th giving gains is agreed.

hindi: अब इसको और रिफाइंड करते हैं कुंडली को इसके आगे एक स्टेप और लेते हैं कि फदर रिफाइंड कैसे होगी यह आ गई केपी कुंडली
says: Method: to refine the reading further he adds one more step and moves from the ordinary chart to the KP chart, which gives a finer verdict.
classical_check: KP is a 20th-century system, not classical; layering it on D1 is his own method.

gist: A run of house numbers in the KP chart (3, 12, 10, 11, 1, 2) with the playful 'Munna Bhai' remark; the caption does not say what is claimed about them.

hindi: यहां एक्चुअली बुध है जो सबसे पवर फुली काम कर रहा है दो नंबर में बुध शुक्र की राशि लाजवाब है
says: In the KP chart Mercury is the planet working most powerfully: it sits in the 2nd house in a Venus sign, which he calls excellent for wealth and speech.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in a friend's sign (Venus signs) is comfortable; in the 2nd it supports earnings through speech, trade and accounts. Elsewhere the same friendly-sign strength supports that house's topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Taurus on the 2nd gives steady, practical money through trade and a pleasant, calm voice.
Derived: Mercury in Libra on the 2nd gives earning through negotiation, contracts and balanced speech.
Derived: Mercury in Libra on the 6th would turn the same friendly strength to dispute resolution and service.

ambiguity: 'Do number' could be 2nd house or sign Taurus; he says Venus's sign, so Taurus or Libra.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is friendly to Venus; Mercury in the 2nd is classically good for wealth and speech.

hindi: तीन नंबर में फरदर दृढ़ हो गया ना ये नेप्चून है ना राहु
says: At number 3 things become even firmer: Neptune and Rahu are placed there, which hardens the matter further.
cells_derived_method: Neptune and Rahu together in a house make that house's matters expansive and hard to dislodge; effect depends on which house topic applies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune and Rahu in a Gemini 3rd make effort, writing and short travel unusually durable but fuzzy.
Derived: Neptune and Rahu in a Sagittarius 3rd inflate courage and siblings' matters and are hard to remove.

ambiguity: 'Three number' could be a house or a KP sub-lord reference; what exactly becomes firm is clear only from the next line (marriage).
classical_check: Neptune is not classical; Rahu in the 3rd is classically good for courage.

hindi: तलाक तो भूल जाओ जिंदगी में होएगा ही नहीं
says: Divorce can be forgotten: the Neptune and Rahu setting means separation will not happen in this person's life.
cells_derived_method: A marriage-protecting arrangement; for other charts divorce risk would depend on 7th lord condition and affliction to the 7th house, not on Rahu/Neptune alone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Libra 7th with Rahu and Neptune would be held together by social and image pressure.
Derived: a Capricorn 7th would hold the marriage through duty and reputation, not warmth.

ambiguity: He does not name the 7th house in this sentence; marriage is clearly the subject but the house reference is implied.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not use Neptune. A flat 'divorce will never happen' is a strong prediction that should be treated as his claim only.

hindi: रोते रहो पिटते रहो लड़ते रहो ना लड़ो क्या करो ज्ञान करो ना करो यहां पर पूर्ण रूप से सुरक्षित कर दिया इसने
says: Whether the couple cries, quarrels or does not, the marriage is made completely secure by this arrangement; quarrels are possible but the bond is not endangered.
cells_derived_method: Same marriage-protection reading; quarrels remain possible but the structure holds. Sign on the 7th changes how the quarrels look.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an Aries 7th shows loud and quick quarrels that burn out without breaking the bond.
Derived: a Scorpio 7th shows long, intense silences and clashes within a bond that still holds.

ambiguity: Which house is meant by 'here' is not said.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और इसके ऊपर बृहस्पति की दृष्टि है यह क जाने नहीं दूंगा मैं तो बिना लड़े प्यार नहीं करेंगे हम जब सेम लड़ेंगे तभी प्यार करेंगे तो यह बृहस्पति यहां पर एक्टिवेट कर दिया इसने
says: Jupiter's aspect falls on the same spot, which activates and protects it further; he jokes about the couple who show love only after fighting, with Jupiter holding the bond.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's aspect on a house protects and expands it; its effect on that topic depends on Jupiter's own dignity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter aspecting a Gemini 7th supports communication and shared learning in the relationship.
Derived: Jupiter aspecting a Sagittarius 7th (its own sign) gives a sincere, philosophical and long-lasting partner.

ambiguity: The sentence is mixed with a joke; the target house is implied by context.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter's aspect protects the house it sees.

hindi: अब जो बचा कुछा था नेप्चून वो यहां चला गया चंद्रमा यहां चला गया राहु यहां
says: The remaining planets fall in place in the KP chart: Neptune, Moon and Rahu all go into the 6th house.
cells_derived_method: The 6th house is the house of enemies, disease and service; three planets there change what each one does (next sentences).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon, Rahu and Neptune on an Aquarius 6th give enemies and service matters of a crowd or network type.
Derived: the same three on a Gemini 6th make disputes talk-based and paperwork-heavy.

ambiguity: The 6th house is deduced from the later sentence about Rahu 'sitting in the sixth'.
classical_check: Moon and Rahu in the 6th is classically a fair placement for defeating enemies.

hindi: नेप्चून कहता है मैं शत्रु के हाथों मार के खत्म कर दूंगा
says: Neptune in the 6th says it will finish things by getting the enemy destroyed through his own side's hands; read as Neptune ending enemy problems by indirect means.
cells_derived_method: Neptune on the 6th works through indirect, hidden, confusing means; sign decides whether the enemies undo themselves through illusion, addiction or secrecy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune on a Pisces 6th dissolves enemies through their own confusion and escapism.
Derived: Neptune on a Virgo 6th makes rivals undone by their own sloppy details.

ambiguity: The phrase is garbled; it could mean Neptune destroys the native's enemies or that enemies destroy each other. Read in light of the next lines, it is the first.
classical_check: Silent; Neptune is not a classical planet.

hindi: चंद्रमा कहता है पीठ दर्द का कलेजा निकाल के नाश पीट दूंगा
says: Moon in the 6th would give back pain, he says (a health claim, flagged: it is a traditional association, not a diagnosis). Violent wording is rhetorical.
cells_derived_method: Moon on the 6th is read as mental and bodily discomfort in the area of the sign on the 6th; the body part follows the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon on a Capricorn 6th points to joint and bone discomfort.
Derived: Moon on a Leo 6th points to the back and heart region.

ambiguity: Body-part association is his; no diagnosis should be drawn.
classical_check: Moon in the 6th classically gives digestive and emotional troubles; back pain is not specifically classical.

hindi: मोती डाल दो चंद्रमा का मामला खत्म हो गया कोई नुकसान परेशानी नहीं है
says: Remedy: wear or place a pearl, and the Moon issue is finished with no loss or trouble.
cells_derived_method: Pearl remedy suits an afflicted or weak Moon in any house; here it is applied to the Moon in the 6th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Scorpio 6th is the Moon's debilitation sign, so a pearl is a standard first remedy there.
Derived: for Moon in Taurus on the 4th (exalted) a pearl is optional and only supports a strong Moon.

ambiguity: Metal, weight and day of wearing not given.
classical_check: Agrees: pearl is the Moon's gemstone.

hindi: राहु है पित कृपा लगाते रहो राहु और नेप्चून के साथ ही गुरु पाल लो ऑटोमेटिक छठा घर ओके
says: Remedy for Rahu: keep the ancestors' grace (pitru kripa) activated; for Rahu and Neptune together adopt a guru, and the 6th house becomes fine automatically.
cells_derived_method: Guru-adoption remedy would suit Rahu or Neptune on any house where Jupiter support is needed; the topic of the house tells what it settles.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Rahu on a Sagittarius 9th the same guru-and-ancestor remedy settles belief and teacher matters.
Derived: for Rahu on a Cancer 6th the remedy settles worry about enemies through emotional support from elders.

ambiguity: 'Pit kripa' is read as pitru kripa; the caption cuts the word.
classical_check: Pitru-grace remedies for Rahu and guru support exist in tradition, though not in the main classics.

hindi: राहु छठा बैठा ही शत्रु खत्म कर देता है चुप बैठने से ही खत्म
says: Rahu seated in the 6th by itself destroys enemies; the native only needs to sit quietly and the enemies end on their own.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in the 6th: enemy type changes with sign. Sign decides how enemies fall away.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu on a Taurus 6th makes enemies in money and possessions fade through their own greed.
Derived: Rahu on a Sagittarius 6th makes enemies in belief and legal matters lose their footing.

classical_check: Agrees: Rahu in the 6th is classically a good placement to destroy enemies.

hindi: केतु ऑन मत करो जबान है केतु शत्रु खत्म अभी राहु की क्लास प आएगा के मौन में ही समाप्त
says: Ketu is the tongue, so do not switch on that tongue (keep silent) and enemies end by themselves; silence is the way Ketu and Rahu finish enemies.
cells_derived_method: Ketu as tongue means speech discipline matters most in houses where Ketu sits: Ketu in the 2nd or 3rd makes words the main risk.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu on a Scorpio 2nd makes sharp words costly; silence protects wealth and family ties.
Derived: Ketu on a Sagittarius 3rd makes careless statements and messages the main source of trouble.

ambiguity: Rahu's class is deferred; Ketu as the tongue is his own association.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu is not the tongue in classical karakas (Mercury and the 2nd house rule speech).

hindi: पितर उड़ा देते हैं सब कुछ ऑटोमेटिक
says: Ancestors (pitras) blow away everything bad automatically, so ancestral grace removes the problems without the native doing more.
ambiguity: Context is the pitru kripa remedy for Rahu.
classical_check: Silent in classics; pitru-grace as a general remedy is a popular tradition.

hindi: यहां पर यह आ गया दो सूर्य एक नंबर उच्च और ये नीच तुल्य दोनों के बीच घमासान लड़ाई चलेगी ऑटोमेटिक न्यूट्रलाइज्ड
says: Sun appears with two conditions at once: one number gives it an exalted position and the other makes it like debilitated. The two fight hard and automatically cancel each other, leaving a neutral result.
cells_derived_method: When a planet has exaltation-type strength by sign and debilitation-type weakness by house or other count, the two cancel; the net is neutral.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries on the 7th is exalted by sign but weak by direction (setting side), so partnership matters give a mixed, cancelled result.
Derived: Sun in Aries on the 10th is exalted and strong in direction, so nothing cancels and career shines.

ambiguity: Which number is which is garbled: 'do' (2) could be house 2 and 'ek number' sign Aries, but the caption does not settle this.
classical_check: Classical neecha-bhanga concept resembles this cancellation idea but is defined differently.

gist: He remarks that multiple such factors run at once in a chart.
He says the next step is the navamsha chart.

hindi: अब देखो मजे की बात अब यहां पर हमने सात आठ और 10 नवांश और यह मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली और सारी राशियां देखते हैं
says: In the navamsha, he examines the 7th, 8th and 10th houses along with all the signs of this native's chart before deciding on a thread colour.
cells_derived_method: The 7th, 8th and 10th of the D9 serve as checking houses for a remedy: marriage, hidden harm and work. Each house's sign decides which colours fit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Taurus 7th in D9 would favour Venus-type colours such as white or pastel for the thread.
Derived: a Capricorn 10th in D9 would favour dark Saturn-type colours such as blue or black.

ambiguity: Why exactly 7, 8 and 10 is not explained here.
classical_check: Silent; thread colour from navamsha houses is his own method.

hindi: अब धागा डिसाइड होता है यहां कौन सा धागा डले काला डले हां काला डले नो नो नो नुकसान करेगा नुकसान करेगा
says: The thread to be worn is decided at this stage; first he tries black and rejects it, because black would harm.
cells_derived_method: Black stands for Saturn (and Rahu); it is rejected where tested houses are harmed by Saturn-type colour. Colour verdicts differ chart to chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Scorpio 8th might accept black because it supports hidden strength, so the same colour could pass in another chart.
Derived: a Libra 7th would usually reject black because it dulls partnership harmony.

ambiguity: He says yes then no no no for black; the final verdict in this first test is that black harms.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यहां देख ले हम काला हां काला डल सकता है पीला डले का नुकसान करेगा नो नेवर लाल डल सकता है यस लाल डल सकता है
says: Testing again, black can go on, yellow must never be used because it would harm, and red can be used: red passes the test.
cells_derived_method: Colours map to planets: black Saturn, yellow Jupiter, red Mars. The result depends on which planets are strong or harmful for the tested houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: red (Mars) suits a Mars-sign 10th and supports work energy.
Derived: yellow (Jupiter) would normally suit a Jupiter-sign 9th, so rejecting it needs a special reason such as Jupiter being afflicted.

ambiguity: Contradicts his previous verdict on black (rejected in the sentence before, allowed here); possibly two different charts, KP versus navamsha.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लाल लाल ओके दोनों में लाल ओके है दोनों में लाल ओके है इसको हम रिफाइन कर सकते हैं
says: Red is approved in both the charts tested; the red thread is then refined further.
ambiguity: 'Both' could mean KP and navamsha or two navamsha checks.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस लाल के यहां डाल देने से क्या होगा लाल यहां पर प्रोटेक्ट करेगा बृहस्पति यहां प्रोटेक्ट करेगा दोनों घर सेट है
says: Red thread protects Jupiter at one place and protects the other place as well; the two houses involved are both set right by red.
cells_derived_method: Mars colour supports Jupiter when Mars aspects or joins Jupiter's house; the two houses are settled by the same thread.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: red supports Jupiter in an Aries 5th, a friendly Mars sign, and steadies children and learning.
Derived: red supports Jupiter in a Scorpio 9th, a friendly Mars sign, steadying fortune and teacher matters.

ambiguity: Which two houses are 'both houses' is not named.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is a friend of Jupiter, so Mars colour helps rather than harms Jupiter.

hindi: इस लाल को डाइल्यूट करना है हल्का सा ब्लू कलर ले लो क्या ब्लू यहां सूट है यस राहु के साथ सेट हो गया
says: The red is too strong, so he dilutes it by adding a little blue. He tests blue and finds it fits, since it sets properly with Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Blue is read as Rahu/Saturn type colour; mixed with red it softens Mars. It fits where Rahu is well placed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a little blue on top of red suits a Gemini 6th with Rahu, which handles enemies through cleverness.
Derived: blue also suits an Aquarius 3rd with Rahu, a friendly Rahu sign for courage and effort.

ambiguity: 'Blue' is mapped to Rahu here; elsewhere blue is usually Saturn.
classical_check: Silent; classical colours for Rahu are smoky or dark blue-black, so close.

hindi: मंगल चंद्रमा और नेप्चून राहु इज ओके लाल धा ब्लू धागा यहां ब्लू ठीक है लेकिन लाल तो हमें चाहिए
says: With Mars, Moon, Neptune and Rahu all checked, the combination is fine; blue is acceptable here but red is still wanted in the mix.
ambiguity: Which placement of these four planets he is checking is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि अकेले ब्लू से अगर हमने डाल दिया तो बृहस्पति को नष्ट कर देगा इसलिए पर्पल कर दिया
says: A blue thread alone would destroy Jupiter, so the thread is made purple (red plus blue) so Jupiter is protected.
cells_derived_method: Colour of Rahu/Saturn damages Jupiter if used alone; the Mars colour in the mix protects Jupiter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Jupiter in its own Sagittarius 9th, pure blue would damage dharma and luck; purple avoids this.
Derived: for Jupiter in its own Pisces 5th, pure blue would weaken children and learning matters; purple avoids this.

classical_check: Silent; Jupiter-Rahu is classically guru chandala, in line with his worry.

hindi: इस ध्यान से हमें कलर चेंज करने है पर्पल कर रहा लाली ज्यादा ब्लू कम
says: Colour mixing rule: when changing colours keep this in mind and make purple with more red and less blue.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बृहस्पति के साथ अगर हमने राहु सेट कर दिया तो उस घर के अंदर अकेली मुंडी वाले बुद्ध की मूर्तियां घूम रही होंगी देवता आता है बुद्ध ऐसे भगवान है कोई बॉडी है ही नहीं
says: If a thread or colour sets Rahu together with Jupiter, the home will fill with head-only Buddha statues; Buddha's head is Rahu-like (head without a body).
cells_derived_method: A Jupiter-Rahu mix by remedy shows up as head-only idols in the house: the Vastu link is that headless images are Rahu items.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter and Rahu mixed on a Sagittarius 4th would put such head-only statues in the home.
Derived: Jupiter and Rahu mixed on a Pisces 9th would affect the prayer room and shrine objects.

ambiguity: The Buddha-has-no-body comment is a rhetorical point on Rahu as the head; not a claim on the Buddha himself.
classical_check: Silent; Vastu link is his own. Jupiter-Rahu is classically guru chandala.

hindi: आपने राहु का नास पीट दिया पितृ दोष हो गया ये भी ये छोटे तौर पर ऑटोमेटिक
says: Ruining Rahu this way also produces a pitru dosha automatically, at a small level.
ambiguity: Caption is rough; he means Jupiter with Rahu, treated as a mild ancestral defect.
classical_check: Classically pitru dosha comes from Sun or the 9th with Rahu/Saturn; Jupiter-Rahu is a different yoga.

hindi: जहां जुपिटर के ऊपर राहु आपने प्लेस कर दिया कहीं ना कहीं गलती से कलर से धागे से आपके घर के अंदर मुंडी वाला घोड़ा होगा
says: Wherever Rahu is placed over Jupiter by mistake through colour or thread, the home will contain a horse-head statue; the object shows the error.
ambiguity: 'Mundi wala ghoda' is read as a horse-head item.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अकेले घोड़े की मुंडी दो दो आदमी स्त्री पुरुष की मुंडिया लगा रखी है गणपति बिकते हैं मुंडी बिक रही है खूब बिकते हैं बुद्ध भगवान की मूर्तियां बिकती है मुंडी बेच रखी है
says: People keep head-only items: horse heads, man and woman heads, Ganapati and Buddha busts, all sold widely as head-only decor, which are Rahu items.
ambiguity: A commentary on market products, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent; a Vastu-type claim.

hindi: हटा दो सारे हटा दो हाईली नेगेटिव क्योंकि आपका जुपिटर डाउन हो रहा है सूझना बंद हो जाएगा
says: Remove all head-only idols and busts: highly negative, because Jupiter is pulled down and the person loses clarity of thinking.
classical_check: Silent; Vastu-style remedy claim.

gist: A garbled phrase about something going 'into a station'; no rule can be read from it.

hindi: जुपिटर के बिना शनि भी कुछ ना कर पाएगा
says: Without Jupiter's support even Saturn cannot deliver anything, so Jupiter is the base of results.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn's results are classically not dependent on Jupiter, so this is his own principle.

hindi: मंगल राहु शनि ये सब जुपिटर के साथ-साथ खेलते हैं इसीलिए गुरु का स्यापा है
says: Mars, Rahu and Saturn all work along with Jupiter, which is why guru matters so much; the Jupiter problem holds up the whole system.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गुरु का मतलब कौन है पिता है उसको बना लो गुरु भाई को बना लो मित्र को बना लो गुरु मित्र मित्र गुरु किसी रूप में हो
says: Who is the guru? The father, a brother or a friend can be taken as guru, in any form; a friend can be guru and a guru a friend.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter's karakatva includes father and teacher in some traditions.

hindi: गुरु का गुरुजी नहीं है गुरुजी लगे हुए हैं आप कहीं ना कहीं जहां छोड़ सको एक छोटा बक्सा बना लो तू ही मेरा गुरु है छोड़ दिया
says: If there is no formal guruji, make a small box somewhere to surrender your worries to, saying you are my guru, and leave it.
ambiguity: The sentence starts garbled ('guru ka guruji nahi hai'); the box remedy is clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कॉस्मस को गुरु बना लो कॉस्मस पे छोड़ दिया यह करने मात्र से सेट हो जाएगा
says: Make the cosmos your guru and leave everything to it; doing just this will set Jupiter right.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब आज की डेट में यह देखो मंगल यहां शिफ्ट हो गया है यह सेनापति है मंगल
says: On today's date the transit Mars has shifted to this place; Mars is the commander (senapati) of the planets.
cells_derived_method: Transit Mars gives energy, action and conflict in the house it passes, and aspects 4th, 7th and 8th from there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: transit Mars in the 3rd gives courage, effort and drive for short journeys.
Derived: transit Mars in the 10th gives action and push at work.

ambiguity: The target house is not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the army commander in classical lore.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति ने जॉब कौन सी करनी है उच्च का है मंगल य 11 नंबर भी उच्च समान होता है
says: What job should he do: Mars is strong, and the 11th place is also like an exalted position, so the job fits the Mars type.
cells_derived_method: The 11th house counts as an exalted-type place for gain. Mars in the 11th supports earning through authority roles.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Capricorn on the 11th is exalted and doubly strong for gains through command roles.
Derived: Mars in Taurus on the 11th is in an enemy sign, so gains come through hard effort.

ambiguity: Mars is exalted only in Capricorn; whether Mars is in Capricorn here is not said.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars in the 11th is a good placement, an upachaya house.

hindi: जॉब कौन सी करनी है सेनापति की यानी यह इसके ऊपर व्यक्ति के ऊपर एक बॉस है लेकिन यह व्यक्ति स्वयं भी बॉस है इस व्यक्ति के ऊपर भी एक बॉस है
says: The job is a commander's job: someone sits above him as boss, but he is himself a boss for others, a middle-chain commander.
cells_derived_method: Mars-type work shows as a rank role. The pattern changes if Mars is in the 10th (top commander) or the 6th (service roles).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars on the 10th in Aries gives a leader role with few seniors.
Derived: Mars on the 6th in Scorpio gives a service role with a clear boss above him and subordinates below.

classical_check: Agrees that Mars suits army, police, command roles.

hindi: लेकिन इस व्यक्ति ने स्वयं भी बॉस वाली जॉब करनी है एक नंबर का सूर है तो गवर्नमेंट जॉब होगी
says: He must take a job where he is himself the boss. With the Sun at number one, a government job is indicated.
cells_derived_method: Sun at the lagna or in Aries points to authority and government roles; the sign of the Sun adjusts the type.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo on the 1st gives authority and a government or leadership role.
Derived: Sun in Aries on the 10th gives a strong government or administrative career.

ambiguity: 'Ek number ka sur' could be Sun in the 1st house or in sign number 1 (Aries, exalted).
classical_check: Agrees: Sun well placed gives government work.

gist: He declines to detail this now and says these topics come in the next class.

hindi: तीन नंबर का आजकल देखो गोचर ऐसे ले रहे हैं मुफ्त में हम छोटा सा तीन नंबर का गोचर चल रहा है दो नंबर का गोचर जब था और तीन नंबर का गोचर
says: As a free demonstration he takes the current transit: a transit through the 3rd is running, after the earlier one through the 2nd.
cells_derived_method: A transit planet in the 3rd works by effort, courage and communication, then aspects 6th, 9th and 10th for Mars.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a transit through Leo on the 3rd gives confident initiative and bold messaging.
Derived: a transit through Virgo on the 3rd gives careful effort and detail-heavy communication.

ambiguity: Which planet is transiting the 3rd is not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees that the 3rd is an upachaya house where transits do well.

hindi: तो इसकी दृष्टि ना यहां है मंगल की दृष्टि भी यहां है इस व्यक्ति को प्रॉपर्टी का लाभ चल रहा है अभी छ नंबर तीन और छ ना
says: The transit's aspect is on this place and Mars's aspect is here as well, so the native is now getting a property gain; the aspect involves the 3rd and 6th places.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th from itself; from the 3rd it aspects the 6th, 9th and 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars from the 3rd aspecting a Capricorn 6th gives gain through effort in service or disputes.
Derived: transit Mars in an Aries 3rd is in its own sign, strong in its aspect on the 6th.

ambiguity: Which place the aspect lands on and why it gives property gain is not clear; it is a current-time prediction about this native.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars aspects 4th, 7th and 8th from itself; property gain via 3rd and 6th is not a classical link.

hindi: मुन्ना भाई का पांच नंबर में भी तो जब अभी मंगल आएगा पांच में मई के बाद आ जाएगा मई के मिड में जैसे ही मंगल पांच में आएगा इस व्यक्ति की प्रॉपर्टी डील होएगी अगले चार चार महीने के अंदर
says: When transit Mars enters the 5th place, around mid-May, the native's property deal will happen within the next four months. A dated prediction about a property transaction; flag it, no investment advice to be drawn.
cells_derived_method: Transit Mars in the 5th supports speculative, creative and property moves; the sign decides the type of deal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: transit Mars in Leo on the 5th supports bold, prestigious property decisions.
Derived: transit Mars in Scorpio on the 5th supports deals through inheritance or joint property.

ambiguity: 'Five number' is read as the 5th house or the 5th sign; the year of May is not given.
classical_check: Silent; Mars transit timing for property deals is his own method.

gist: He says the future has not arrived yet; the class cuts off.
Opening clause is garbled ('if it does not happen for them so that I am not hit by stones'); the meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: क्योंकि मंगल कह रहा है ये प्रॉपर्टी का कुछ करूंगा कंस्ट्रक्शन करा दूंगा या दिलवा दूंगा
says: Transit Mars in this position says it will do something about property: it will get construction done or get a property delivered to the native.
cells_derived_method: Mars influencing the 4th house or its lord gives construction and acquisition of land; sign decides whether it comes through self-effort (Aries, Scorpio) or through family (Cancer).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars on an Aries 4th gives fast, self-driven construction of a home.
Derived: Mars on a Cancer 4th (debilitation sign) makes property matters come with family friction and delay.

ambiguity: The 4th house is implied by 'property'; the actual house Mars is transiting is not named.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is the karaka of land and construction.

hindi: शनि यहां है पांच नंबर शनि छ नंबर हो जाएगा मार्च के बाद यहां से दृष्टि शनि यहां शिफ्ट हो रहा है
says: Saturn is now at number 5 and after March it will shift to number 6, so its aspect will also shift to new places.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's aspect points move with its transit house: from the 6th it aspects the 8th, 12th and 3rd houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn on the 6th aspects the 8th, 12th and 3rd, steadying service and effort.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Aquarius on the 5th aspects the 7th, 11th and 2nd, steadying partnership and gains.

ambiguity: Five and six could be houses or signs; the caption does not say, and the year is not given.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn's special aspects are 3rd, 7th and 10th from its placement.

gist: He says only listeners who already know a little jyotish will catch this point.

hindi: तो शनि की यहां से दसवीं दृष्टि आ जाएगी इस घर पे यहां यहां से तो आएगी 12 नंबर से यहां भी आएगी
says: From the new position Saturn's tenth aspect will reach this house, and from number 12 it will fall on another place too.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's 10th aspect is counted 10 houses ahead; from the 6th it reaches the 3rd, from the 12th it reaches the 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn's 10th aspect on an Aries 3rd slows initiative and short travel.
Derived: Saturn's 10th aspect on a Sagittarius 9th tests fortune and teachers.

ambiguity: Target house is not named; 'number 12' could be house or sign.
classical_check: Agrees that 10th aspect is one of Saturn's three special aspects.

hindi: तो यह घर भी एक्टिव होगा ये भी एक्टिव होगा शनि दो साल के लिए रहेगा
says: Both the houses Saturn aspects become active, and Saturn stays there for two years, so these effects last about two years.
ambiguity: Saturn stays about two and a half years in a sign; he says two years.
classical_check: Differs slightly: Saturn's transit is about 2.5 years per sign.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति के बच्चे के एडमिशन के लिए भी परिवर्तन आएगा कॉलेज की और नहीं तो कुछ पढ़ाई में एडमिशन लेकर छोड़ेगा
says: For the native's child, a change will come in admission: either a change of college, or the child will take admission in a course and then leave it.
cells_derived_method: Children and education follow the 5th house; Saturn's activity there brings change, delay or dropping of courses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn active on a Gemini 5th brings change of subject or course for the child.
Derived: Saturn active on a Virgo 5th brings detail-driven shifts in admission, with a switch of stream.

ambiguity: This is a prediction for this native's family, not a general rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति के घर का भी कार्यक्रम होगा और गाड़ी का भी होगा अगले दो साल में चाहे घर कर ले चाहे गाड़ी एसेट बनेगी
says: In the next two years there will be activity around a home and a vehicle; whether he buys the house or the car, an asset will be created.
cells_derived_method: The 4th house covers home and vehicles; Saturn aspect there brings delayed but lasting assets.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn on a Libra 4th (exalted sign) brings a solid, lasting home or vehicle asset.
Derived: Saturn on an Aries 4th (debilitation sign) brings assets only after delays and struggle.

ambiguity: Dated prediction about a purchase; flag it, no investment advice to be drawn.
classical_check: Agrees that the 4th house is home and vehicles.

hindi: हां पर ये प्रीव करके मार सकते हैं इस चीज को क्या ये प्री लिव करके इसको परिवर्तन दे सकता है
says: A question he raises: can the person pre-live (pre-empt) the event and thereby kill or change it? Can pre-living change the planet's promise?
ambiguity: 'Pre-live' is read as acting out or living the event beforehand; the caption is garbled.
classical_check: Classical texts debate karma versus remedy; this specific idea is not covered.

hindi: ग्रह देगा तो देगा तो है ही चाहे कुछ भी उखाड़ लो प्री लिव करके इसको परिवर्तित कर सकता है य व्यक्ति यह बहुत बड़ा प्रश्न है
says: If the planet is going to give, it will give, whatever you try; but whether the person can alter it by pre-living is a very big question that he leaves open.
ambiguity: He leaves the question open and then answers fatalistically in the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical fatalist view that strong dasha results cannot be avoided.

hindi: लेकिन देने वाला देवता दे के रहेगा चाहे कुछ भी कर लो एक तरह जीवन के बाद हम यह समझने पर निष्कर्ष पर आ जाते हैं देर इज नथिंग लाइक फ्रीविल
says: The deity who gives will give regardless of what you do; after studying life he concludes there is nothing like free will.
ambiguity: A philosophical stance, not a computable rule.
classical_check: Consistent with prarabdha karma ideas; the strict no-free-will claim is his own.

gist: Everything is running by itself, nobody knows who runs it or how, and we are not the ones running it.

hindi: हम तो यह कला जान रहे हैं कि कौन से ब्रेन से जाने कि छोड़ना है पकड़ना है जो आज हम बात कर रहे हैं कि कुछ खाने छोड़ दो किस पर छोड़ दो कैसे छोड़ दो
says: The art he is teaching is knowing when to hold and when to let go: which matters to leave, to whom to leave them and how; this is the basis of his surrender-style remedies.
ambiguity: 'Khane' (compartments) is read as the 12 houses to be left to a planet.
classical_check: Silent; his own remedy method.

gist: He says this will be understood a little more in the next class, and not everything needs to be understood fully.
He opens a question-and-answer round and invites the audience to ask.
An audience member asks what Saturn-Mercury in the 12th gives.

hindi: मुझे क्या पता ये कोई बात हुई पूरी कुंडली से होता है एक चीज गांठ बांध लो
says: A single combination cannot be judged alone: the result comes from the whole chart, so what Saturn-Mercury gives in the 12th depends on everything else.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn and Mercury in Gemini on the 12th (Mercury's sign) lean to foreign and quiet intellectual work.
Derived: Saturn and Mercury in Capricorn on the 12th lean to heavy expenses and disciplined isolation.

classical_check: Agrees: classical texts judge yogas in the context of the whole chart.

gist: A comic phone call about a man standing on a bridge who cannot say which of five bridges or which side, used to show that location without context is useless.

hindi: प्रश्न को समझो कोई जो अगर आपको ऐसे बता रहा ना बना रहा है लोग कहते हैं जी मेरे साउथ साउथ वेस्ट में यह है टॉयलेट है बहुत अच्छी बात है पार्टी करो

hindi: अरे पूरा घर देखना पड़ेगा हमारा तो एंट्री द्वार नॉर्थ ईस्ट है हमारा तो बहुत अच्छा ईस्ट नॉर्थईस्ट बच्चे ऐसे पूरा देखे बिना कभी पता नहीं चलेगा

ambiguity: A Vastu parallel; no zone-by-zone rule is given.

hindi: घर में भी वास्तु में जोन बड़ा है छोटा है देवता है वास्तु का बाप है ये वास्तु बहुत छोटी चीज है यह बहुत ज्यादा बिग चीज है

says: Vastu is limited because the house is fixed and it has only about 10 percent effect, being built on land; he says a long discussion of its rules is not for now.

classical_check: Silent; the percentage is his own claim.

gist: He invites the next audience member to ask and one begins a question.
Audience member recalls he once said 'keep your son happy, never worry about...' and asks about it.
He jokes that his statements contradict each other, that he is not a reliable witness and that one should not take him to testify.

He asks what the question was, having forgotten it.

hindi: आपने अपने बेटे को खुश करना है नहीं खुश नहीं करना है आपने अपने बेटे का ध्यान रखना नहीं ध्यान नहीं रखना है आपको अपना शनि खराब नहीं करना है बेटा एक बहाना है
says: For this person the aim is not to please the son or to fuss over him; the real aim is not spoiling his own Saturn, and the son is only a pretext.
cells_derived_method: Child-related Saturn duty applies when Saturn touches the 5th; the remedy shifts to the native's own Saturn discipline instead of pleasing the child.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign on the 5th makes a duty-bound relationship with the child; the remedy is calm detachment.

classical_check: Silent; Saturn as karaka of detachment fits, but the advice is his own.

hindi: आपने अपने पुत्र को खुश करना नहीं नहीं नहीं नहीं नहीं खुश कोई ना होता नहीं लिखा तो नहीं होएगा आपने अपने बेटे को दुख देना नहीं उसकी चिंता करनी नहीं आपको अपना शनि सेट करना है
says: Nobody can make another happy: if it is not written it will not happen. Do not give your son sorrow either, do not worry about him, and set your own Saturn.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए उसको आशीर्वाद दो और बोलो बेटा जब तूने सीखना होगा तेरी यात्रा सीख जाएगा
says: Remedy: give the son a blessing and say that when he has to learn, his own journey will teach him; leave his learning to his path.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लाड कर लिया प्यार कर लिया दफा करो जो होएगा साथ है खत्म करो क्या करना आपको उसको ना सुख देना है ना दुख देना है
says: Once you have shown affection, drop the matter: whatever will happen will happen with him; give him neither comfort nor pain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप यह सोचो पिता की बहुत बड़ी समस्या और गलतफहमी होती है कि पुत्र मेरी सेवा करेगा मां की करेगा वो पिता की विरासत लेगा उल्टा चाबी भी लेगा
says: A father's big misconception is that his son will serve him: the son may serve the mother, will take the inheritance and may even take the keys.
cells_derived_method: Father (9th) and son (5th) relations are read through Sun and Saturn; service from a son is not promised by the chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Leo 9th makes the father proud and demanding, so he expects more service than the son gives.
Derived: a Scorpio 5th gives an intense, self-willed son who takes the inheritance but not the service role.

ambiguity: A general observation more than a computed rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उल्टा कहेगा कि मरे ये बुड्ढा तो गोदाम की चाबी मिले मुझे पिता पिता के पुत्र सेवा करे इसलिए नहीं होता ये शनि और सूर्य का दोष है ये इंपॉसिबल है होता ही नहीं
says: The son may even wish the old man would die so he gets the warehouse keys. A son serving his father does not happen because of the Saturn-Sun fault, which makes it impossible.
cells_derived_method: Sun (father) and Saturn (son's work/duty) are natural enemies, so father-son service is blocked; no other house or sign changes this.
ambiguity: A sweeping 'impossible' claim; he states it as general.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun and Saturn are enemies and father-son friction is a known theme; 'impossible' is stronger than any classical text.

hindi: ऐसा सास और बह का लफड़ा दूसरा होता है व हमने बताया ना यह खाना बीवी का है वो सास का है अलग अलग होते हैं वो रिश्ता बीमार है इसलिए वो तनाव रहना ही है
says: Mother-in-law and daughter-in-law is a separate issue: the wife's house and the mother's house are different compartments, the relationship is sick by nature and tension stays.
cells_derived_method: Wife is the 7th and mother the 4th; the two being unrelated houses explains why the bond has built-in strain. Signs on the 4th and 7th decide intensity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an Aries 7th wife is assertive and clashes openly with the 4th-house mother.
Derived: a Capricorn 4th mother is strict and formal, creating distance and tension with the wife.

ambiguity: 'Khana' is read as house; which houses he means is read from context.
classical_check: Silent; 4th mother and 7th wife are classical.

hindi: इसलिए पिता पुत्र से उम्मीद रखे नेगेटिव पिता अपनी पत्नी के बेटे से उम्मीद रख सकता है पकड़ में आया जायज ही होगा यह है स्मार्ट
says: A father should not expect from his son: it is negative. He may expect from his wife's son; that is legitimate. It is the smart move.

gist: He retells a story about a man who goes to an ashram by the river hoping the guru will make him meet Krishna.
The man sees a crowd of devotees, is annoyed at his queue number and complains to Guru Ananda that he found no joy there.
The guru says meet me first, the one in front of you; the man says he is surrendered to him and Krishna can wait, and the guru lets him go.
On the way back the man slips into a deep river, struggles until exhausted and, about to die, wonders whether to call Ram or Krishna.
Story continues: nothing happens when he calls out; finally he cries to Ananda to save him and a hand pulls him out.
He looks up and sees Ananda pulling him while himself chanting Krishna, Krishna and rising upward; the man then cries out to Krishna.
At the moment he calls Krishna the hand slips, he falls back into the river and reaches Dharmraj, who explains the outcome.
Dharmraj says only one whose reach extends to Krishna reaches him; yours reached Ananda, so hold Ananda, hold your own account, and walk holding yourself.

hindi: अपने पुत्र द्वारा सुख मिलेगा सपे मत रखो कि बेटा सुख देगा आपको सुख आपका शनि देगा मंगल देगा बुध देगा बेटा कैसे दे देगा
says: Do not hope that your son will give you happiness: your own Saturn, Mars and Mercury give it, so how can the son give it? Happiness from children is not guaranteed by the child.

ambiguity: Which of the three planets governs which kind of happiness is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts read happiness from the 4th house and Moon, not Saturn/Mars/Mercury.

hindi: आपका बेटा सही संभालेगा नहीं संभालेगा आपको बेटे को संभाल के देना नहीं देना तो हमें किसी और को दे जाओ
says: Whether your son will manage things properly or not, hand over carefully, and if he will not manage, leave your wealth to someone else; inheritance should follow capability, not birth.
ambiguity: The caption is rough ('hamen kisi aur ko de jao'); read as advice on bequest.
classical_check: Silent; practical advice, not a classical rule.

says: Father and son still cannot become friends, because even with Mars's power it is a different matter; Mars rules even over Saturn.

hindi: शनि भी हा पानी धोता है मंगल के आ हाथ जोड़ता है पानी धोता है पानी भरता है पानी धोता है

An audience member lists three or four questions and asks how he can speak of atheists at one time and believers at another.

hindi: किसी को नास्तिक होना नास्तिक होले आस्तिक होना आस्तिक होले जिस रास्ते जाना है जाओ यह आपको रीड कराना पड़ेगा कुंडली देख कर के कि आपके जीवन में क्या सूट करता है

classical_check: Silent; classical texts treat the 9th house and Jupiter as the indicators of belief.

gist: He says he cannot have everyone come to him, there is no time, so people should learn to read themselves.

hindi: आपके शनि की प्लेसमेंट बताएगी और स्वयं जीवन से एक्सपीरियंस लो क्या मुझे कोई फायदा हो रहा है
says: Your Saturn placement will tell whether belief or practice suits you, and you should test it against your own life experience: ask whether it is actually bringing you benefit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn on a Capricorn 9th inclines to duty-based, structured faith and doubt of ritual.

ambiguity: Which Saturn placement means which stance is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as the judge of devotion is his own method.

hindi: क्या मेरा भगवान बह रहा है या मेरा भगवान साथ तो नहीं बैठा पद्दी पर तो नहीं चढ़ा हुआ मैं बोलता हूं काम हो जाता है एक बार में
says: Test of faith: is my god deaf, sitting beside me or on my back? For some people a request works in one ask; this practical result shows whether the practice suits them.

says: Other people ask a hundred times, even their ancestors, and are reduced to begging with no result: for them the deity does not listen, which shows the path or deity they chose does not suit them.

says: Remedy: stay in silence and forgive within; better still, stop even the act of forgiving and clear everything inside the mind.

hindi: अगर हम नीलम पहनाते हैं तो ना उससे शनि स्ट्रांग होता है ना शनि वीक होता है नीलम से शनि करेक्ट होता है
